jobs.title: Business Controller*in
jobs.description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Business Controller*in---Business Controller\*in=======================DauerstelleStadtspital ZürichFür das Strategische Controlling im Departement Finanzen suchen wir ab sofort oder nach Vereinbarung eine engagierte Persönlichkeit.### Aufgaben* In dieser spannenden Funktion innerhalb des Strategischen Controllings bist du Mitglied des Teams Planung und Steuerung.  * Kernaufgabe dieser Abteilung ist die finanzielle Steuerung der Business Einheiten sowie die Sicherstellung der Kosten\- und Ergebnistransparenz und die Erarbeitung von Massnahmen zur Verbesserung der finanziellen Situation.  * Du unterstützt die operativen Führungskräfte in den medizinischen Bereichen als Sparringpartner. Weiter berätst du die Kliniken in der Strategischen Entwicklung. Darüber hinaus arbeitest du eng mit dem Medizincontrolling und der Betriebsbuchhaltung zusammen.  * Du erstellst aussagekräftige Analysen und Wirtschaftlichkeitsrechnungen und arbeitest an der jährlichen Budgeterstellung mit.  * Du nimmst eine aktive ein bei der Weiterentwicklung der Controlling\-Instrumente und Reporting\-Tools.  * Du arbeitest mit und/oder leitest Projekte bei betriebswirtschaftlichen und fachübergreifenden Themen (Einführung Centerrechnung, Ambulante Tarife, etc.).  ### Profil* Hochschulabschluss in Betriebswirtschaftslehre oder eine gleichwertige Ausbildung  * Mehrere Jahre Berufserfahrung im Controlling  * Analytisches und konzeptionelles Denkvermögen  * Fähigkeit zur verständlichen Darstellung und Vermittlung komplexer Zusammenhänge  * Ziel\- und Ergebnisorientierung  * Initiative Persönlichkeit mit Durchsetzungsvermögen und hoher Eigenverantwortung  * Du bist es gewohnt stufengerecht zu kommunizieren und verstehst dich als Teamplayer  * Hohe IT\-Affinität und Erfahrung im Umgang mit SAP sowie BI Systemen runden dein Profil ab  * Erfahrung im Gesundheitswesen und branchenspezifisches Wissen der Daten\- und Wertströme nach REKOLE sind von Vorteil  ### Wir bietenWir bieten dir mehr als nur einen ! Unsere Stadtspital\-Welt ist geprägt von einer offenen Du\-Kultur, einem unkomplizierten, persönlichen Miteinander und der nötigen Prise Humor im Alltag. Als Team aus über 120 Berufsgruppen setzen wir uns täglich auf ganz unterschiedliche für das Wohl unserer Patient\*innen ein. Darüber hinaus profitierst du von attraktiven Anstellungsbedingungen, flexiblen Arbeitszeitmodellen einschliesslich Homeoffice und ausgezeichneten Sozialleistungen der Stadt Zürich.### Über unsDas Stadtspital Zürich zählt mit über 36'000 stationären und rund 455'000 ambulanten Patient\*innen pro Jahr zu den Top 10 der Schweizer Spitäler. Als modernes Zentrumsspital an mehreren Standorten in der Stadt Zürich bieten wir die gesamte Bandbreite der medizinischen Grundversorgung, inklusive 24\-Stunden\-Notfall und Intensivmedizin an. Unsere 4'500 Mitarbeitenden setzen sich täglich mit viel Engagement und Herzblut für eine exzellente Patientenversorgung ein.### Interessiert?Für weitere Informationen steht dir , Teamleiterin Planung und Steuerung, Telefon , gerne zur Verfügung.Referenz\-Nr.: 52022******jid81b072ajm jit1044jm jiy26jm

Collaborateur / technicien SAV \- Machines à café \& Matériel de fête
=========================================================================

**Collaborateur / Technicien SAV – Machines à café \& Matériel de fête**

**Lieu de travail :** Chavannes\-les\-Forts  
**Taux d'activité :** 100%  
**Entrée en fonction :** de suite ou dès le

**À propos de nous :**  
Nano Coffee Sàrl est un acteur clé de la région dans la fourniture, la location et l'entretien de machines à café professionnelles et de matériel événementiel. Pour renforcer notre équipe technique et garantir un service d'excellence à nos clients (entreprises, fêtes), nous recherchons un collaborateur SAV polyvalent et passionné.

**Vos missions principales :**

**Suivi clients \& relevés mensuels :** Effectuer les visites mensuelles auprès de nos entreprises partenaires pour réaliser les relevés de compteurs des machines à café et évaluer l’état général des fourniture.

**Maintenance et réparation :** Assurer le diagnostic, l'entretien préventif et le dépannage (en atelier et chez les clients) de machines à café de différentes marques ainsi que du matériel de fête (friteuses, grills, etc.)

**Préparation et logistique :** Contrôler et tester le matériel de fête avant chaque mise à disposition et au retour des locations pour garantir leur parfait fonctionnement

**Service client \& urgences :** Conseiller les clients sur l'utilisation du matériel et intervenir rapidement en cas de panne, notamment lors d'événements durant la saison haute

**Gestion administrative :** Rédiger les rapports d'intervention

 

**Votre profil :**

Formation technique (CFC d'électromécanicien, électricien, mécanicien sur appareils ou formation jugée équivalente)

Expérience confirmée dans le dépannage (une expérience sur les machines à café est un sérieux atout)

Permis de conduire de catégorie B obligatoire

Autonomie, rigueur et sens de l’organisation

Flexibilité dans les horaires (disponibilité pour des piquets le week\-end en période de fêtes)

Maîtrise du français (oral et écrit).

 

**Ce que nous offrons :**

Une activité variée au sein d’une petite entreprise familiale

Travail dans des locaux entièrement rénovés

Un véhicule de service équipé

Autonomie dans le travail

 

**Vous vous reconnaissez dans ce profil ?**  
Envoyez\-nous votre dossier de candidature complet (CV, lettre de motivation, certificats de travail) par mail ou contactez\-nous au 079 654 32 70 pour plus d'informations.

Nous répondrons uniquement aux dossiers correspondant au profil demandé.

jobs.title: Administratör i Norrfjärdens församling
jobs.description: Är du en nyfiken och noggrann person som längtar efter ett socialt och varierat arbete? Välkommen att söka tjänsten som administratör i Norrfjärdens församling! Sista ansökningsdagen är 19 november.Om församlingenNorrfjärdens församling, i Piteå kommuns norra del, är en del av Svenska kyrkan. Arbetsplatsen har ett femtontal anställda på helår och dessutom fem säsongsanställda. Även om vi, män och kvinnor i olika åldrar, har olika uppgifter i församlingen så arbetar vi nära varandra. I församlingsverksamheten arbetar präster, diakon, musiker och pedagoger. Dessutom finns administrativ personal, värdinnor inom lokalvård och servering samt anställda i vaktmästeri och kyrkogårdsarbete. Arbetsplatsen präglas av tillsammanskraft och utvecklingsanda inom alla verksamhetsområden. Men, vi behöver dig!Om tjänstenDenna administratörstjänst är en bred tjänst. Du är kontaktperson till ekonomiservice och lönetjänst som vi är anslutna till. Du ansvar för bokningar av gudstjänster och kyrkliga handlingar (dop, vigsel och begravning), kyrkobokföring, digitalt arkiv och ser till att vi följer GDPR. Dessutom är du kyrkoherdens och de förtroendevaldas stöd i styrelsearbetet. Du är anställd för församlingsverksamhetens behov och har en kollega som är begravnings-administratör. Ni ingår i teamet för begravningsverksamhet och stöd och är underställda kyrkogårdschefen. Arbetet är förlagt till församlingsexpeditionen i Norrfjärden.  Vi söker dig som gillar ordning och reda och brinner för service både inom och utom organisationen. Du har en positiv grundsyn och är lösningsorienterad och kommunikativ. Arbetet ställer höga krav på din förmåga att uttrycka dig väl i både tal och skrift. Om du har förmåga och erfarenhet av att utbilda, underlätta och understödja anställda och förtroendevalda i administrativ kompetens så är det välkommet! Då vi är en organisation som jobbar med dubbel ansvarslinje, den kyrkliga och den förtroendevalda, så kan det vara bra att ha erfarenhet av arbete i sådan miljö. Öppenhet för att arbetet sker i en värdestyrd verksamhet där tro och liv har sin givna plats är viktigt för att du ska landa rätt. Du delar kyrkans värdegrund om alla människors lika värde och är medveten om att du i mötet med församlingsbor och medlemmar uppfattas som en ambassadör för kyrkan.  Vi söker dig som:     Har lätt för att skapa och underhålla goda relationer.    Är en utpräglad teamspelare i relation till andra anställda och församlingens ideella.    Har vana att jobba i olika typer av digitala system.    Har goda kunskaper i Officepaketet.    Har tidigare erfarenhet av diarieföring, tex Public 360.    Är en van sekreterare som kan hantera det som sägs i styrelserum med integritet och lojalitet. Vi erbjuder dig:    En trivsam arbetsplats i en fin omgivning    En plats att växa på och introduktion till olika uppgifter.    En blandad arbetsgrupp där vi stödjer varandra.     Livsvårdstimme, friskvårdsbidrag och personalaktiviteter. Norrfjärdens församling vill vara en hållbar arbetsplats såväl ekonomiskt, personellt och miljömässigt. Vi sätter stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet och tillämpar fri prövningsrätt. Anställningen avser 80-100% med månadslön från 1 januari 2027 eller enligt överenskommelse.AnsökanVälkommen att skicka in din ansökan med följande bilagor: CV, personligt brev och intyg på utbildningar/kurser/kompetens senast 19 nov till: Norrfjärdens församlingHelgenäsgatan 19945 31 Norrfjärdeneller via mail:norrfjarden.jobbansokan@svenskakyrkan.seIntervjuer sker v. 48 och planen är att tillsvidaretjänsten tillsätts av kyrkorådet 2 december. Två referenspersoner kräver vi av dig som kallas till intervju. Om du är intresserad - vänta inte!

jobs.title: Staff Site Reliability Engineer, Environment Automation
Produktions- och logistikchef till Orkla Foods Sverige i Kungshamn
jobs.description: FöretagsbeskrivningOrkla Foods Sverige tillagar mat och dryck i Sverige med kärlek och omtanke om människor, hav och land. Vi är en lokal samhällsaktör som med över 1400 medarbetare gör skillnad och bidrar till en mer hållbar och hälsosam vardag. Ca 90 procent av den mat och dryck vi säljer i Sverige tillagar vi lokalt på någon av våra 8 anläggningar runt om i landet. Vi går i täten för hållbar produktutveckling och innovation genom våra välkända varumärken som Felix, Grandiosa, Abba, Kalles, BOB, Ekströms, Risifrutti, Önos, FUN Light, Anamma, Krögarklass, och Paulúns. Vi har en omsättning på cirka 6 miljarder kronor och vårt huvudkontor i Malmö. Vår vision är att vi vill skapa ”En god framtid” genom att leva upp till våra värdeord – modig, pålitlig och inspirerande.Om rollen Vill du leda produktion och logistik i hjärtat av svensk matproduktion?Vi söker nu en produktions- och logistikchef till vår verksamhet i Kungshamn – en nyckelroll för dig som vill kombinera strategiskt ledarskap med operativ utveckling i en miljö där kvalitet, matsäkerhet, effektivitet och människor står i centrum. Här får du leda chefer, utveckla arbetssätt och driva förbättringar som gör skillnad både i vardagen och för framtidens produktion.Om rollenSom produktions- och logistikchef ansvarar du för den operativa verksamheten kopplat till inkommande råvara, mognadsprocess, beredning, tillverkning och materialflöden. Du leder större delen av fabrikens operativa organisation, med ansvar för cirka 140 medarbetare av totalt 185–200 anställda på anläggningen. Rollen omfattar direkt ledarskap för sex produktionsledare med olika ansvarsområden inom produktion, logistik och råvarucentralen samt planerings- och avropschefen, som i sin tur leder ett team om tre medarbetare. Du leder operationsfunktionen mot kort- och långsiktiga mål inom EHS, kvalitet, leveranssäkerhet och kostnadseffektivitet. Rollen är placerad i vackra Kungshamn, rapporterar till fabrikschef och är en viktig del av fabrikens ledningsgrupp. Du får ett brett mandat att utveckla både människor, flöden, processer och struktur inom ditt ansvarsområde.Vad du får möjlighet att arbeta med    Leda, coacha och utveckla chefer och direktrapporterande tjänstemän inom operationsfunktionen.    Sätta mål, skapa struktur och säkerställa tydliga förväntningar och förutsättningar för framgång.    Driva strategisk planering, målsättning och genomförande för hela funktionen.    Utveckla och implementera standardiserade arbetssätt, metoder och processer.    Säkerställa effektiva material- och informationsflöden samt optimal produktions- och bemanningsplanering.    Leda förändrings- och förbättringsarbete, inklusive projekt kopplade till produktivitet, kvalitet, miljö och arbetsmiljö.    Följa upp och analysera KPI:er inom bland annat EHS, matsäkerhet, kvalitet, leveransprecision, produktivitet, OEE och kostnader.    Driva förbättringsarbete med tydligt fokus på att öka OEE, effektivitet och stabilitet i produktionen samt inom övriga ansvarsområden.    Ta fram och använda relevant data, analysera resultat, dra slutsatser och omsätta insikter till konkreta rekommendationer och beslut.    Kommunicera analyser, initiativ och rekommendationer på ett strukturerat och tydligt sätt, exempelvis genom beslutsunderlag och presentationer.    Ansvara för budget, lagervärde, inventeringsprocess och identifierade kostnadsbesparingar inom funktionen.    Säkerställa att verksamheten följer gällande lagar och krav kopplat till arbetsmiljö, matsäkerhet och kvalitet. KravspecifikationVi söker dig somFör att lyckas i rollen ser vi gärna att du i grunden har en relevant utbildning, exempelvis inom industriell ekonomi, produktionsledning, ledarskap, supply chain, Lean production eller motsvarande erfarenhet som vi bedömer likvärdig. Du har dokumenterad erfarenhet av att leda chefer på strategisk nivå, personalledning och förändringsarbete i en tillverkande verksamhet.    Erfarenhet av att leda chefer och utveckla medarbetare genom andra.    Erfarenhet från tillverkande industri och av produktionsledning.    Erfarenhet av ekonomistyrning mot budget och andra måltal.    Erfarenhet av att driva organisationsutveckling, större förändringsarbete och projekt.    God kunskap inom industriell styrning, budget, ekonomistyrning, flöden och materialprocesser.    God kunskap inom Lean Production, logistik, produktionsplanering och ständiga förbättringar.    Förmåga att skapa sammansvetsade team, bygga struktur och hantera komplexa samarbeten.    Stark analytisk förmåga och vana att arbeta datadrivet, från insamling och analys till slutsats, rekommendation och presentation.    Förmåga att leda genom andra, samtidigt som du är trygg i att själv kliva in, driva uppgifter framåt och avgöra när du ska delegera respektive själv ta ansvar för genomförandet.    Mycket god kommunikativ förmåga på svenska och engelska.Det är även en fördel om du har erfarenhet    från livsmedelsindustrin.    Kunskap inom SAP eller MES.Varför du kommer trivas härOrkla Foods är ett av Sveriges största livsmedelsproducenter, med lokal tillagning på sju orter i Sverige. I vårt bolag får du unika möjligheter att förvalta och utveckla många av Sveriges starkaste och godaste varumärken inom livsmedel., med omtanke om människor, hav och land. Vår kultur bygger på värdeorden modig, pålitlig och inspirerande. Vi arbetar målmedvetet för säkra, hälsosamma och attraktiva arbetsplatser.Att arbeta i Kungshamn är att kliva in i en av Sveriges historiska och mest unika produktionsmiljöer, precis vid havet, med en kultur som präglas av hantverk, stolthet och hög kvalitet. Här tillagar vi produkter som är djupt förankrade i svenska matvanor och som många känner igen sedan barndomen. På anläggningen produceras bland annat ABBA, Kalles Kaviar, Grebbestads, Svennes och Ejderns, varumärken som står för tradition, kvalitet och smakupplevelser som håller över tid.Läs mer om hur det är att jobba hos oss: Presentation Produktions & Logistikchef KungshamnYtterligare informationInformation och ansökanLåter det här som nästa steg i din karriär? Då ser vi fram emot att höra från dig. Ansök gärna så snart som möjligt eller tipsa någon i ditt nätverk som du tror skulle passa för rollen.För att säkerställa en rättvis och GDPR-säker rekryteringsprocess har vi tyvärr inte möjlighet att ta emot ansökningar via e-post. Har du specifika frågor som är viktiga för att kunna ta ställning till en ansökan är du varmt välkommen att kontakta vår HR Business Partner på nadine.tehyrell@orklafoods.se.

willingness to ask questions, challenge unsupported assumptions and escalate risks early    Ownership of feature quality through implementation, deployment and user feedback, with effective collaboration across product and engineeringNice to have    Experience with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) or managed cloud AI services, particularly on Azure    Experience with identity and access management, event-driven integrations or enterprise application modernization    Deeper experience with Kubernetes, infrastructure as code or application observability    Experience in automotive or other enterprise environments, and participation in client workshops or user acceptance sessionsWe offer/Benefits    EPAM Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)    Company’s pension plan    Private healthcare insurance    Safety & life insurance    Gym discounts    Wellness Grant (SEK 2000)    Corporate Programs including Employee Referral Program with rewards    Learning and development opportunities including in-house training and coaching, professional certifications, and courses*All benefits and perks are subject to certain eligibility requirements

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.employer: H & M Hennes & Mauritz GBC AB
jobs.description: Job DescriptionAs a key member of our team, you'll design, develop, and maintain backend solutions for our Stores. Working in an agile environment, you'll collaborate with product managers, business and frontend engineers to deliver high-quality, scalable software, driving initiatives from problem definition through rollout. The ideal candidate is passionate about backend development, has a track record of driving technical initiatives and making the team around them better, proficient in C# and .Net  WHAT YOU’LL DO In addition to the above, your role will involve:     Technical Leadership & Ownership: Taking end-to-end ownership of key initiatives — from architecture and design through delivery — setting technical directions and making the trade-off calls that keep the team moving.     Mentorship & Force Multiplication: Actively raising the technical level of the team through code reviews, pairing, and design discussions; unblocking colleagues and making the people around you more effective, not just shipping your own code.     API Design: Shaping the design and implementation of APIs that facilitate seamless communication between the Mobile Application and backend, ensuring an efficient flow of data in the headless ecommerce environment.     Azure Cloud: Leveraging your expertise in Azure Cloud services to enhance the scalability, reliability, and performance of our backend systems, ensuring a seamless integration with our headless ecommerce applications.  WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH At Store Lens, we work closely with Portfolio Brands and H&M Brand to design and provide technical solutions. We contribute to product development at every stage, from setting requirements to rollout and testing. From day one, we focus on improving by listening, building, and refining as we go. Even as we define requirements, we are already thinking ahead, using early designs, first developments, and new learnings to continuously make the product better. We are curious, active listeners and hands-on doers. Beyond your work with Store Lens, you will also be part of our Engineering/QA community, where you will have access to a network of experts, resources, and opportunities to grow.  WHO YOU ARE We are looking for people with…     Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience), and at least 5-8 years of experience as a Software Engineer with backend focus, including demonstrated experience leading technical initiatives, mentoring engineers, or acting as a technical lead on a team.     Proficiency in C# and .NET.     Proficiency in Azure concepts and native development using Azure functions.     Experience in concept as Always up and message queuing.     Experience of CI/ CD pipelines using Azure DevOps / GitHub Actions.     Experience of containerization technologies like Kubernetes and Docker.     Experience in Database (e.g. Cosmos Db).     Experience in POS, Payment and Checkout area is a plus.     Experience in SignalR is a plus. And people who have:     Continuous learning mindset to stay updated on emerging trends and technologies.     Ability to collaborate effectively in a team environment and communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.     Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail A track record of conducting code reviews, identifying areas of improvement, and providing constructive feedback to maintain code quality and consistency across a team, not just their own work.     Familiarity in backend testing with a focus on ensuring the reliability and performance of backend systems.     Familiarity with Agile development.     Comfort operating with ambiguity — able to take a loosely defined problem and shape it into a concrete technical plan.     Excellent communication and collaboration skills.  WHO WE ARE H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make. We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future.  WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE  We offer all our employees at H&M Group attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. All our employees receive a staff discount card, which is usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online. Brands covered by the discount are H&M (Beauty and Move included), COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories, ARKET. In addition to our staff discount, all our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP. You can read more about our H&M Incentive Program here. In addition to our global benefits, all our local markets offer different competitive perks and benefits. Please note that they may differ between employment type and countries.  JOIN US Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are. Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here. *We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter in your application.

jobs.title: Chargé d'insertion (H/F)
jobs.description: APPRENTIS D'AUTEUIL OCÉAN INDIEN recrute un Chargé d'insertion F/H à Saint-Louis en CDD de 18 mois.Sous la responsabilité de la coordinatrice du bassin sud, vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec le Booster, dans une logique de binôme complémentaire, afin d'accompagner les jeunes dans la construction et la réalisation de leur projet professionnel. Vous identifiez leurs besoins, les aidez à lever les freins à l'emploi et mobilisez les ressources nécessaires à leur insertion.Votre action repose sur une démarche de proximité, avec une présence importante hors les murs, sur les lieux de vie et dans les espaces fréquentés par les jeunes, afin de créer du lien, favoriser leur mobilisation et faciliter leur accès à la formation, à l'emploi et aux dispositifs d'insertion.1. Accueillir et accompagner les jeunes- Repérer les jeunes en lien avec les prescripteurs et partenaires du territoire.- Réaliser des entretiens individuels pour évaluer leur situation, identifier leurs besoins et les freins à leur insertion.- Construire avec chaque jeune un plan d'action individualisé et assurer le suivi de son parcours.- Accompagner les démarches vers l'emploi, la formation et l'autonomie.2. Animer des actions collectives- Concevoir et animer des ateliers favorisant le développement des compétences et l'insertion professionnelle.- Organiser des actions hors les murs, au plus près des jeunes et de leurs lieux de vie.- Favoriser la découverte des métiers par des visites d'entreprises, des forums et des immersions professionnelles.3. Développer le réseau de partenaires- Entretenir des relations avec les entreprises, organismes de formation, associations et acteurs institutionnels.- Mobiliser les dispositifs et ressources du territoire selon les besoins des jeunes.- Développer des coopérations facilitant l'accès aux opportunités professionnelles et la sécurisation des parcours.4. Assurer le suivi des parcours- Suivre les jeunes après leur sortie du dispositif.- Assurer la traçabilité des accompagnements, le reporting et la mise à jour des dossiers.- Collecter les justificatifs et transmettre les informations nécessaires à la coordination.Vous travaillez en lien avec les équipes internes : coordination de bassin, Boosters, chargés de relations entreprises, psychologues et équipes formation.Profil recherché :- Bac+2 minimum, idéalement en insertion professionnelle, accompagnement social ou domaine équivalent.- Au moins 2 ans d'expérience dans l'insertion, le social ou l'éducatif.- Connaissance des acteurs et dispositifs d'insertion des jeunes à La Réunion.- Maîtrise des entretiens individuels, de l'animation d'ateliers et du suivi administratif.- Bon relationnel, écoute, capacités rédactionnelles, rigueur, autonomie et esprit d'équipe.- Capacité à mobiliser un réseau de partenaires et à s'adapter à des publics variés.- Sensibilité à l'interculturalité et adhésion aux valeurs de solidarité, de respect et d'engagement auprès des jeunes.Conditions du poste : - Lieu : Saint-Louis (La Réunion)- Contrat : CDD de 18 mois- Temps de travail : 35 heures par semaine- Rémunération : 2 036 € à 2 378 € brut mensuel selon expérience et grille en vigueur, + prime vie chère de 16 %- Prise de poste : novembre 2026

jobs.title: Conseiller commercial / Conseillère commerciale sédentaire (H/F)
jobs.description: Vous souhaitez mettre votre énergie au service d'un groupe qui bâtit un avenir durable ? Rejoignez le groupe EDF pour exprimer votre énergie au service des enjeux climatiques.Au sein du Centre de Relation Clients de Chatou, vous rejoignez des équipes (environ 15 conseillers par équipe) engagées et solidaires, mobilisées chaque jour pour accompagner les clients particuliers à distance. Ensemble, elles cultivent une relation de confiance avec les clients et contribuent activement à la performance commerciale du Groupe dans un environnement collaboratif, dynamique et bienveillant. En tant que Conseillère/Conseiller commercial, vous créez une relation personnalisée à distance avec les clients particuliers. Vous accompagnez chaque client avec écoute et réactivité afin de répondre à ses besoins et lui proposer les solutions les plus adaptées. Au quotidien, vous accueillez les clients par téléphone et via les outils digitaux, gérez leurs demandes et réclamations, développez la fidélisation, valorisez les offres énergétiques et les services EDF et contribuez aux objectifs commerciaux de l'équipe grâce à votre sens du conseil et de la vente.Le poste est situé à Chatou (78). Une formation sera mise en place dès votre arrivée.Vous travaillez uniquement du lundi au vendredi, sans activité le week-end. Le télétravail est possible selon votre niveau d'autonomie et les besoins de l'activité.Rémunération brute annuelle de base hors primes : de 26000 € à 36000 €, selon diplôme et expérience professionnelle. Package global comprenant : prime individuelle de performance, intéressement et épargne salariale.Avantages selon conditions d'éligibilité : tarif préférentiel sur l'électricité et le gaz, aides aux familles et à la parentalité, dispositifs de mobilité durable, activités sociales et culturelles .  Vous êtes titulaire d'un diplôme bac +2 ou bac +3 dans le domaine commercial, de la relation client ou de la vente. Vous justifiez d'une expérience minimum de 2 ans dans un environnement commercial ou de relation client à distance.Vous aimez relever des défis commerciaux, convaincre avec justesse et développer une relation de confiance durable avec vos clients. Votre sens de l'écoute, votre aisance relationnelle et votre goût du résultat vous permettent d'identifier les besoins des clients et de leur proposer des solutions adaptées.Vous faites preuve de capacité d'adaptation, collaboration, communication, sens du client, sens du résultat.La diversité alimente notre performance. Notre objectif est d'ouvrir nos portes à toutes les compétences, toutes les énergies et toutes les personnalités sans exclusion. Le poste proposé est donc ouvert à toutes et à tous.Une fois votre candidature présélectionnée, nous vous proposerons un premier entretien téléphonique. Si cette étape est concluante vous rencontrerez ensuite le manager et le responsable RH.En rejoignant EDF, vous contribuez à la transition énergétique aux côtés de celles et ceux qui partagent la même ambition. Votre énergie est notre force !

jobs.title: Technicien spécialisé / Technicienne spécialisée CVC (H/F)
jobs.description: Rejoignez Dalkia et devenez un acteur clé de la transition énergétique ! Nous recrutons des Technicien.nes en alternance via des contrats d'apprentissage ou de professionnalisation. Prêt.e à relever le défi climatique avec nous ?  Certificat de Spécialisation Technicien des Services à l'Énergie - Un tremplin vers le contrat !Vous avez un Bac Professionnel en initial ou en alternance et souhaitez approfondir vos compétences avant d'intégrer le marché du travail ? La Mention Complémentaire TSE est la formation idéale pour renforcer vos connaissances et vous spécialiser davantage. Vos tâches :Optimiser la performance des équipements thermiques et électriques ;Réaliser la maintenance et le suivi des installations énergétiques ;Appliquer des solutions d'amélioration énergétique ;Assurer une relation client de qualité et garantir la sécurité des installations. and collaborative team where people work together and take a practical approach to getting things done.* An international and interdisciplinary working environment connected to the Basel Area innovation ecosystem.* Flexible working arrangements, including the possibility to work remotely for part of your working time.### Interested?We look forward to receiving your application and learning more about you.**Workload:** 100%  **Location:** Basel, Switzerland  **Start date:** As soon as possible or by agreement  *Please note that our recruitment process is managed using Bloomie, our application support tool.*![BaselArea]()* BaselArea  Dufourstrasse 11  4052 Basel*jid4c4cb69jm jit1044jm jiy26jm

jobs.title: Information Security Director
jobs.description: Ref 2587951 \| Date: 28 Oct 2026![Michael Page]( )Our client is seeking an experienced and hands\-on Information Security Director to define, implement, and continuously enhance its enterprise security program. Reporting to the VP of IT, this role combines strategic leadership with operational execution across cybersecurity governance, risk management, cloud security, identity management, compliance, and incident response.Information Security DirectorOur client is an innovative and fast\-growing biopharmaceutical company focused on developing transformational therapies for patients with ophthalmic and neuro\-ophthalmic diseases. Operating internationally in a highly regulated industry, the organization leverages a modern, cloud\-first technology environment and is committed to investing in cybersecurity, digital transformation, and operational excellence to support its long\-term growth ambitions.**Description**Our client is seeking an experienced and hands\-on cybersecurity leader to define, implement, and continuously enhance its enterprise security program. Reporting to the VP of IT, this role combines strategic leadership with operational execution across cybersecurity governance, risk management, cloud security, identity management, compliance, and incident response. The successful candidate will play a critical role in protecting the organization's digital assets, supporting business growth, and ensuring a robust security posture within a highly regulated environment.* Develop, implement, and continuously enhance the company's cybersecurity strategy, ensuring alignment with business objectives, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices.* Lead cybersecurity governance, risk management, and compliance programs, including policy development, risk assessments, internal controls, and audit readiness.* Own the security architecture across cloud, infrastructure, applications, endpoints, and collaboration platforms, with a strong focus on Microsoft 365 and Entra ID environments.* Oversee identity and access management (IAM) processes, ensuring secure user provisioning, privileged access controls, and authentication standards.* Direct security operations, including threat detection, vulnerability management, incident response, and remediation activities in collaboration with internal and external partners.* Manage cybersecurity third\-party service providers, including MSSPs, security consultants, penetration testing firms, and technology vendors.* Lead business continuity, disaster recovery, and cyber resilience initiatives to ensure operational preparedness and rapid recovery capabilities.* Establish and monitor cybersecurity KPIs and metrics, providing regular executive\-level reporting and recommendations to leadership.* Drive data protection, privacy, and information security initiatives, ensuring appropriate safeguards for critical business and research data.* Evaluate emerging technologies, including AI\-related risks and controls, to ensure secure adoption and governance.* Promote a strong cybersecurity culture through awareness programs, employee education, and stakeholder engagement across the organization.**Profile*** Bachelor's or master's degree in information security, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.* Minimum 10 years of progressive experience in cybersecurity and IT, including at least 3\-5 years in a leadership or management role.* Proven track record of developing and executing enterprise cybersecurity programs within complex and highly regulated environments.* Strong expertise in cybersecurity governance, risk management, security operations, incident response, and vulnerability management.* Hands\-on experience securing Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Azure, endpoint protection platforms, and cloud\-based infrastructures.* Deep understanding of identity and access management, 0\-trust principles, network security, and modern cybersecurity architectures.* Experience leading security audits, regulatory assessments, and compliance initiatives aligned with frameworks such as ISO 27001, NIST CSF, SOC 2, or similar standards.* Previous experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, healthcare, medical device, or other regulated industries is highly desirable.* Demonstrated ability to communicate technical and cyber risk topics to executive leadership, board members, and non\-technical stakeholders.* Strong project management and vendor management capabilities, with experience leading cross\-functional initiatives.* Relevant professional certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CCSP, CRISC, or Microsoft Security certifications are highly valued.* Excellent leadership, communication, problem\-solving, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence decision\-making across all levels of the organization.**Job Offer*** Attractive package and environment* Flexibility with 2 days of Home Office per week* A unique opportunity to build, lead, and shape a growing cybersecurity function within an innovative and international organization.* Ownership of high\-impact cybersecurity, compliance, and digital transformation initiatives.* A collaborative and dynamic work environment that values innovation, continuous improvement, and professional development.* Exposure to cutting\-edge technologies, cloud environments, and evolving cybersecurity challenges.* Competitive compensation package, comprehensive benefits, and attractive long\-term career growth opportunities.jpida216b3fjm jpit1044jm jpiy26jm

jobs.title: Compliance and Risk Support Officer
jobs.description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Compliance and Risk Support Officer---Compliance and Risk Support Officer=================================== **Company Description**Lanschot Kempen is the leading Dutch private bank with Private Banking as its core and supporting Investment Management and Investment Banking services. With a family heritage and nearly 300 years of experience, the bank employs around 2,000 colleagues worldwide. In Switzerland, the group has a fully licensed Swiss bank for 30 years. It focuses on international wealth management, serving demanding clients with a team of around 45 employees and in the Compliance and Risk Team 4 employees.   **The Role**To strengthen our Compliance and Risk team in Switzerland, in a growing organisation we are looking for an organized and reliable Compliance and Risk Support Officer. In this role, you will apply a strong understanding of compliance and risk to facilitate accurate record\-keeping, process follow\-up, deadline monitoring and the smooth coordination of compliance day\-to\-day activities. The position supports effective compliance and risk processes, with less focus on independent assessments or approvals.  You will support the Head of Compliance and the Head of Risk. You will report to the Head of Compliance and your place of work will be Zurich.   **Your Tasks*** Provide day\-to\-day operational and coordination support to the Compliance and Risk team, including scheduling, correspondence and meeting preparation* Maintain Compliance and Risk registers, monitoring tools, trackers and electronic files, ensuring accurate records and effective document control* Monitor deadlines, outstanding actions and control requirements; follow up with stakeholders and escalate delays or issues to the responsible Risk or Compliance officer* Assist with risk assessments and ongoing risk monitoring by gathering relevant information, documenting results and tracking agreed mitigating actions* Perform defined Compliance and Risk controls, document the results, identify exceptions and escalate findings to the responsible officer* Support client due diligence and periodic reviews by collecting documentation, checking completeness and identifying gaps against established requirements* Compile Compliance and Risk data, management information and supporting documentation for reports, prepare reports presentations and committee materials* Coordinate Compliance and Risk training, maintain attendance records and follow up on outstanding completion requirements* Support audits and regulatory requests by organizing evidence, maintaining request lists and coordinating timely responses* Support policy and procedure updates, document version control and process improvements; escalate substantive assessments and decisions to the responsible Risk or Compliance officer* Support process development and improvement, including exploring and implementing AI tools to enhance the efficiency of compliance and risk activities. **Your Profile*** Commercial education or an equivalent qualification, with experience in an administrative or coordination role, ideally in banking or financial services* A hands\-on approach, strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage varied tasks, maintain accurate documentation and track deadlines* working knowledge of Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook; familiarity with banking systems such as Finnova and an interest in AI tools are an advantage* An interest in compliance and client due diligence; previous experience supporting a Compliance, Legal or Risk team is an advantage* A reliable, discreet and service\-oriented approach, with sound judgement when handling confidential information and recognizing when to escalate issues* Strong communication skills, a collaborative mindset and a willingness to learn* Fluency in English; is a strong advantage, and Dutch is an additional asset **Our Offer**Turning talent into value \- that?s what we do. Because if you create value, you can expect the same from us. Our employees are our most valuable asset, and we want them to grow both personally and professionally. With us, you can count on:* A varied administrative support role in a collegial, international team* Opportunities to develop your skills, your knowledge and gain practical exposure to banking Compliance and Risk fields* Attractive and transparent working conditionsMs. Maraki, our Head of Compliance, looks forward to receiving your complete application (including CV, cover letter, references and certificates) by email at .   ![ Lanschot Kempen (Schweiz) AG]()* Lanschot Kempen (Schweiz) AG  Mittelstrasse 10  8008 Zürich** ![ Lanschot Kempen (Schweiz) AG]()* Lanschot Kempen (Schweiz) AG  Mittelstrasse 10  8008 Zürich**jidacbdd43jm jit1044jm jiy26jm

Management.* Exploiter et faire évoluer l'environnement CrowdStrike : migration du tenant européen, retrait de Cortex XDR, intégration des sources de logs dans Next\-Gen SIEM, développement de règles Sécuriser les déploiements GenAI et leur intégration au cycle de vie produit en réalisant les threat models, en définissant les guardrails avant mise en production et en intégrant les contrôles de sécurité aux différentes étapes du Product Lifecycle Framework.Ton profil----------* Minimum 5 ans d'expérience pratique en security engineering ou security operations, dont au moins 2 ans dans un priorisation selon CISA KEV et EPSS, suivi des correctifs et reporting. Une expérience de migration de plateforme de vulnerability management est appréciée.* Bonne maîtrise de CrowdStrike Falcon, EDR et Next\-Gen SIEM, ou d'un environnement équivalent, avec une expérience de l'intégration de sources de logs, de la création de détections et du traitement d'incidents.* Solides connaissances des environnements Fortinet et/ou Palo Alto ainsi que de TLS, PKI et de la gestion des certificats. Bonnes bases en sécurité AWS : IAM, SCP, Security Groups et lecture de findings CSPM avec Wiz ou une solution similaire.* Expérience concrète de la sécurisation d'au moins un déploiement GenAI ou LLM en production : threat modelling, prompt injection, risques de fuite de données, excessive agency et conception de guardrails.* Expérience d'un environnement produit ou SDLC intégrant des contrôles de sécurité aux différentes étapes du cycle de vie, avec de très bonnes capacités de documentation et de coordination transverse ; Anglais et Français courant requis.#### **Notre proposition*** Conditions de travail avantageuses : 6 semaines de vacances par an et un plan de prévoyance attractif* Développement et mise en valeur du potentiel : vaste gamme de formations professionnelles et personnelles proposées par l'Académie Bechtle* Diversité : des tâches intéressantes et changeantes dans un secteur tourné vers l'avenirNuméro d'emploi : LVYML388  Kevin Brosse \| \|  Bechtle Suisse SA-----------------Bechtle Suisse SA dispose de compétences certifiées dans les domaines stratégiques : Infrastructure IT, Virtualisation, Information Management, Managed Services, Skills Management, Data\& Analytics, Printing Solutions et E\-Commerce. Grâce à ces compétences et à de solides et durables partenariats avec les principaux acteurs du marché, nous proposons une gamme modulaire et parfaitement cohérente de produits et de services pour couvrir l'ensemble des besoins de nos clients. Fachspezialist:in Rechnungswesen, 80\-100%
==========================================

HEKS beschäftigt über 1500 fest angestellte Mitarbeiter:innen. An 24 Standorten in der Schweiz und weltweit in 35 Ländern ist HEKS mit 290 Programmen und Projekten im Umfang von rund 144 Millionen Franken tätig. Im Jahr 2024 erreichte HEKS rund 16 Millionen Menschen mit seiner Arbeit.  

HEKS verfolgt die Vision einer gerechten Welt, in welcher die Würde aller Menschen respektiert wird, Frieden herrscht und die natürlichen Lebensgrundlagen bewahrt werden. Ziel ist eine Transformation auf sozialer, wirtschaftlicher und politischer Ebene. HEKS leistet einen Beitrag zur Verbesserung der Lebensumstände von Menschen in der Schweiz und weltweit, fordert ihre Rechte ein und sensibilisiert und mobilisiert zu diesem Zweck.  


Wir verstärken unser Finanzteam in Zürich und suchen nach Vereinbarung eine:n

Fachspezialist:in Rechnungswesen, 80\-100%
------------------------------------------

### Das sind deine Hauptaufgaben:

* Du trägst im Tagesgeschäft die Verantwortung für das Führen des Hauptbuches nach den Vorgaben von Swiss GAAP FER und dem schweizerischen Obligationenrecht, insbesondere\- Bearbeitung und Verbuchung von Abgrenzungen, Bewertungsfragen, Rückstellungen und weiteren komplexen Einzelsachverhalten\- Sicherstellen der korrekten und vollständigen Abbildung aller Nebenbücher (Kreditoren, Spendenbuchhaltung, Anlagebuchhaltung etc.)\- Führen der Anlagebuchhaltung

jobs.title: Principal Scientist I Crop Protection Research Chemistry (m/f/d)
jobs.employer: Syngenta Crop Protection AG Forschung & Entwicklung
jobs.description: Company DescriptionSyngenta Group, a global leader in agricultural technology and innovation, employs 60,000 people across more than 100 countries to transform agriculture through tailor-made solutions for farmers, society, and our planet. Our diverse portfolio encompasses seeds, crop protection, nutrition products, agronomic solutions, and digital services, all designed to help farmers produce healthy food, feed, fiber, and fuel while conserving natural resources and protecting the environment. Our mission is to address critical challenges such as climate change and food security through sustainable practices and cutting-edge solutions, while safeguarding the planet's resources. At our R&D Center in Stein AG, Switzerland, the Crop Protection Research (CPR) Chemistry team is at the forefront of innovation. Here, you will design and synthesize novel products that promote crop health and contribute to the evolution of agricultural practices. Your work will play a crucial role in advancing our mission to ensure global food security through sustainable solutions. Syngenta has been ranked as a top employer by Science Magazine and it has been awarded with the "Friendly Work Space" label to all its Swiss sites.Job DescriptionYour responsibilities:Lead and contribute to research projects, applying state-of-the-art research programs to identify and optimize novel bioactive ingredients interacting with relevant biological targets for crop protection.Collaborate with multidisciplinary project teams with local and global experts to drive research programs to develop sustainable crop protection solutions.Advance project delivery through scientific investigations, applying expertise in molecular design, physical organic chemistry, and synthetic problem-solving.Formulate and experimentally test data-driven hypotheses, deconvolute complex structure–activity relationships (SAR) by integrating empirical and predictive data to drive Multi-Parameter Optimization toward key project milestonesDrive scientific advancement and technological innovation in modern agrochemical discovery by proactively developing and applying cutting-edge skills and technologies, while fostering a culture of continuous learning, creativity, and strategic foresight.Embed digital, data, and AI capabilities into project workflows to accelerate discovery and improve predictive decision-making.QualificationsWhat we are looking for:Scientific Foundation: Ph.D. in Organic Chemistry or Medicinal Chemistry; postdoctoral or industry experience is an advantage.Technical Expertise: Deep expertise in synthetic organic chemistry; direct application to bioactive small molecule research is strongly preferred and highly valued.Cross-Functional Collaboration & Leadership: Strong interpersonal skills with demonstrated success in steering multidisciplinary scientific teams, driving consensus, and delivering project milestones across complex matrix environments.Innovation Mindset: Self-driven and curious, with a proactive approach to adopting emerging technologies and advancing project goals.Communication: Excellent command of English, adept at conveying complex scientific findings to diverse technical and non-technical audiences.What you bring to our team:Technical curiosity for life sciences, including small molecules and new chemical modalities.Enthusiasm for applying and championing cutting-edge science and digital technologies.Creativity, curiosity, and strong decision-making skills with a commitment to continuous learning.Excellent organizational and time management abilitiesCollaborative mindset with strong communication skills to build productive relationships within Syngenta and with international collaboratorsDedication to welcoming different perspectives and fostering a diverse, inclusive and open work environmentAdditional informationWe provide access to state-of-the-art research facilities and technologies, enabling you to apply and expand your expertise in agrochemical design principles, synthetic organic chemistry, and active ingredient optimization.We cultivate a superb working environment with an open culture and diverse workforce, where new ideas are always welcome. We embrace flexible work arrangements and foster work-life balance.We foster a digitally enhanced research environment throughout our R&D processes. This offers you the opportunity to develop digital data analysis skills, positioning you at the forefront of drug discovery.We invest in your professional growth and development through a multidisciplinary training program tailored to foster a rewarding career in crop protection.We are part of a strong regional Science hub, offering you the opportunity to interact with a rich community of scientists in life sciences, further enhancing your professional network and knowledge exchange.You will profit from a competitive pension fund plan, attractive bonus system, onsite doctor, fitness room, canteen, and other benefits (Family friendly initiatives, Child and Family allowance…)Are you interested? Please send your complete application with CV in English, diploma and work certificates (if applicable).Syngenta is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate in recruitment, hiring, training, promotion or any other employment practices for reasons of race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, marital or veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.

jobs.title: Pomocníci v kuchyni

Obsluhuje jednoduché kuchynské stroje a zariadenia. Zabezpečuje udržiavanie čistoty vo všetkých priestoroch prevádzky, suchých skladov, mraziacich boxov a šatne. Zabezpečuje pomocné práce v kuchyni: pomoc pri uskladňovaní potravín do kuchyne pod dohľadom kuchára, pomoc pri vyskladňovaní potravín z kuchyne. Rovnako pomáha pri hrubej príprave potravín pod dohľadom kuchára, za podmienok splnenia prísnych hygienických podmienok (čistá a nečistá práca). Zabezpečuje umývanie riadu ručne alebo pomocou umývacích zariadení a jeho následné triedenie a uskladnenie. Spolupracuje s kuchármi a ostatným personálom. Zabezpečuje obsluhu a umývanie chladiacich zariadení, regálov, pracovných a výdajných stolov i veľkokuchynských zariadení. Zároveň zodpovedá za komplexné upratovanie kuchynskej prevádzky, okolitých priestorov, skladov či miestností súvisiacich s kuchynskou prevádzkou. Pomáha pri triedení odpadu, recykláciu obalov a skladovanie použitého oleja. Dbá na bezpečnosť pri práci, dodržiava zásady osobnej hygieny a hygieny na pracovisku. Nadriadeným pomocného pracovníka/pomocnej pracovníčky v kuchyni je zväčša kuchár/kuchárka, v závislosti od tipu a veľkosti výrobného strediska to môže byť šéf kuchár/kuchárka prípadne aj prevádzkar zodpovedný za úsek stravovania, kde títo zamestnanci preberajú kompetencie vyššieho riadiaceho pracovníka.

jobs.title: Špecialisti v oblasti reklamy a marketingu
jobs.description:
☎️ „Dobrý deň, máme problém.“

„Aký?“

„Technický.“

„A čo presne nefunguje?“

„No... ono.“

Výborne. Máme prvú stopu. 

Ak dokážeš z takéhoto rozhovoru dostať použiteľné informácie, možno máme prácu presne pre teba.

Prijímanie technických incidentov – „Môžete mi to stručne opísať?“ Nasleduje audiokniha.

Kontrola monitorovacích systémov – sleduješ, čo funguje, čo nefunguje a čo sa len veľmi presvedčivo tvári, že funguje.

Riešenie jednoduchších technických problémov – keď problém vyriešiš za minútu, zvyšných 59 nemusíš predstierať, že to bolo náročné.

Posúvanie zložitejších prípadov na vyššiu podporu – keď problém potrebuje väčšieho odborníka, pošleš ho ďalej. Nie však s popisom „nejde to, veľa šťastia“.

Komunikácia so zákazníkmi a technickými tímami – vieš zostať slušná/ý aj pri vete „Ale susedovi to funguje“.

Práca s Excelom a evidencia incidentov – keď ti Excel napíše #HODNOTA!, neodpovieš mu niečím, čo by HR muselo cenzurovať.

Sledovanie otvorených požiadaviek – nenecháš incident ležať v systéme tak dlho, až dostane nárok na dôchodok.

Dokumentovanie vyriešených problémov – aby sa rovnaká chyba nemusela vyšetrovať každý pondelok ako nový kriminálny prípad.

Výhody:Pracovný pomer bez dátumu spotreby – nie sme reality šou. Každý piatok nikoho nevyraďujeme.  Zmluva na dobu neurčitú 

Permanentka na dobrovoľné sebatrýznenie – fitko, bazén, sauna... Vyber si, kde sa budeš potiť a ešte za to poďakuješ.  MultiSport karta 

Decembrové úplatky za celoročné dobré správanie – darčeky dostaneš, aj keď si občas zanadávaš na pondelok.  Vianočné balíčky 

Keď je problém, nehráme schovávačku – kolegovia ti pomôžu. Nikto zázračne neodíde na obed na tri dni.  100 percent podpora zo strany firmy 

Kolektív bez povinného firemného úsmevu – môžeš byť normálny človek, nie nadšený komparzista z reklamy na jogurt.  Rodinná atmosféra 

Žiadna výroba zamestnancov cez kopirák – každý máme svoje muchy. Niektorí rovno celé safari.  Individuálny prístup

jobs.title: Inštruktori a cvičitelia športových rekreačných aktivít
jobs.description:
Predstavte si, že nastúpite do tímu 30 mladých ľudí a vašou najťažšou pracovnou úlohou bude... nájsť si medzi nimi nových kamarátov a kolegov. Cez deň budete v Ski school Strachan učiť ľudí prvé (alebo posledné pred pádom) oblúky na lyžiach či snowboarde, a večer, keď sa lekcie skončia, sa z vás aj z celého personálu Strachan Resortu stanú hviezdy parketu, teda skôr stola, v Medveďom brlohu.

Inštruktorom lyžovania alebo snowboardingu sa môžete stať aj bez skúseností, po kurze, na ktorý vám finančne prispejeme, pretože veríme, že najlepšia motivácia je zalyžovať si zadarmo na svahoch Ski centra Strachan aj Ski centra Strednica (a nie len teoreticky vedieť, kde je tá modrá zjazdovka). Máte radi voľnosť a flexibilitu? Do práce vás u nás nikto naháňať nebude, k nám sa chodí s nadšením, a to je presne to, čo na vás naši hostia uvidia už na prvom kruhu.

Zamestnanecké výhody a benefity:

práca v tíme mladých ľudí, s ktorými sa dá prežiť aj lyžovačka, aj afterpárty,

nádherné prostredie Belianskych Tatier, kancelária s výhľadom, o akom sa iným môže len snívať,

flexibilný pracovný čas, žiadne nútené vstávanie, len dobrovoľné,

mzda od 8 €/hod. v čistom

zľavy na služby v Strachan Resorte,

možnosť absolvovať inštruktorský kurz s dotáciou a zvýhodnením, takže sa naučíte lyžovať aj zarábať súčasne.

Ak vás táto predstava neodstrašuje, ale naopak láka, poznáte odpoveď. Prihláste sa k nám a staňte sa súčasťou tímu, ktorý cez deň učí a večer tancuje.Výhody:ubytovanie

jobs.description:
Túžiš po práci, ktorá by ti dávala zmysel? Staň sa súčasťou nášho Deapul tímu a maj prácu, ktorá inšpiruje a pomáha!

Ako pomáhajúci pracovník/pomáhajúca pracovníčka budeš s tímom skúsených kolegov a kolegýň pracovať v nízkoprahovej Nocľahárni sv. Vincenta de Paul. Na starosti budeš mať najmä:

- pomocné činnosti pri poskytovaní sociálnych služieb a zabezpečovania chodu prevádzky nocľahárne
- administratívne činnosti spojené s registráciou klienta, vedenie požadovanej evidencie
- pripravovanie hygienických potrieb, pranie uterákov, výdaj čistých plachiet pre klientov, pranie oblečenia
- upratovacie práce priestorov počas dennej služby a príprava služby na nočnú zmenu
- vo výnimočných prípadoch asistencia pri sprevádzaní imobilného klienta v zariadení, pomoc pri presúvaní, atď
- výdaj a/alebo príprava stravy (raňajky), výdaj potravín a ošatenia

Rozvrh pracovného času 

Ide o prácu na nočné (18:45h – 7:45h) a denné zmeny (7:30h – 20:00h) v nepretržitej prevádzke s týždennou pracovnou dobou 37,5h. Mesačný priemer je spravidla 9 nočných služieb a 4 denné služby. Rozvrhnutie zmien môže byť aj individuálne podľa dohody so zamestnancom​

Kto sme? 

Nocľaháreň sv. Vincenta de Paul je najväčšou nízkoprahovou nocľahárňou v strednej Európe. Funguje nepretržite už 20 rokov, bez prestávky každý deň v roku. Denne poskytne nocľah, teplé jedlo, sociálne poradenstvo a ďalšie služby pre 200 ľudí v núdzi. Nocľaháreň je jedným z 10 zariadení a projektov neziskovej organizácie Depaul Slovensko, ktorá poskytuje komplexné služby ľuďom bez domova. Pre činnosť našej organizácie sú najdôležitejší naši zamestnanci – Depaul ľudia – profesionáli s veľkým srdcom, trpezlivosťou a empatiou. Pracujeme v priateľskom kolektíve, podporujme vzdelávanie, supervízie a teambulidingové aktivity.

Láka ťa práca v nocľahárni, ale premýšľaš, či máš dostatok skúseností?

Počas zaúčacieho procesu ťa bude v práci sprevádzať skúsený tím kolegov. Postupne budeš mať príležitosť absolvovať školenia a supervízie, ktoré ti pomôžu pri práci s klientmi. Pozícia je vhodná aj pre študentov sociálnej práce alebo príbuzných humanitárnych odborov, ktorí by radi svoje doterajšie vedomosti preniesli do praxe. Náš tím tvorí viacero pomáhajúcich pracovníkov a počas dňa stretneš aj skvelých sociálnych pracovníkov, koordinátorky dobrovoľníkov a komunitné organizátorky či vedúcu nocľahárne s jej zástupkyňami.

jobs.title: Extra åpner ny butikk i Hammerfest - er du vår nye butikksjef?
jobs.employer: COOP HAMMERFEST SA AVD 026 COOP PRIX HAMMERFEST
jobs.description:
Vil du være med fra starten og sette ditt preg på en helt ny Extra-butikk i Hammerfest?

I mars 2027 åpner vi Hammerfest sin nye dagligvarebutikk. Butikken blir en moderne butikk på 1000 kvm salgsflate med åpninstider fra 7-23. 

Vi ønsker oss en inspirerende og engasjert leder med relevant erfaring fra dagligvare eller varehandel. Vi håper og tror du legger stor vekt på god kundeservice, da gode kundemøter er noe av det vi ser som aller viktigst :-). Som butikksjef har du totalansvar for driften og jobber sammen med de ansatte for å beholde vårt gode arbeidsmiljø. 

Kunne du tenke deg å drive Finnmarks nyeste EXTRA butikk? Da kan dette være perfekt for deg!

Søknadsfrist: 24.10.2026 Oppstart 01.02.27

Hva kan du få hos oss?Vi er opptatt av å utvikle våre ledere og har også et støtteapparat som bistår våre ledere. Derfor kan vi si at vi legger til rette for at du skal trives og få både den støtten og det faglige påfyllet som trengs som butikksjef hos oss. Stillingen har mulighet for bonus, skaper du gode resultater får du igjen for det. I tillegg til lønn etter avtale selvsagt. Vi har telefonordning, ansattrabatter og pensjonsordning. Ikke minst får du en gjeng med utrolig engasjerte og skikkelig gode kollegaer:-). Vi tror det er bra å jobbe hos oss og vi vil ta godt vare på deg.

Hva skal du gjøre?Som butikksjef har du det overordnede ansvaret for drift, resultater og personal, og vil være en synlig og motiverende leder i hverdagen. Resultater skaper du gjennom en positiv væremåte, grundig arbeid og god ledelse både i butikken og i møte med kundene. Oppgaver som rekruttering, opplæring, oppfølging og utvikling følger naturlig med stillingen. Sist men ikke minst, så er det viktig at du skaper et godt miljø og en hyggelig butikk for våre kunder å besøke, gjennom å inspirere og motivere de som jobber sammen med deg.

Hva ønsker vi av deg?

  • Vi ønsker at du har erfaring som assisterende butikksjef eller butikksjef.
  • Det er viktig at du motiverer og skaper engasjement og trivsel med dine medarbeidere.
  • Du er genuint opptatt av kundeservice og bidrar til å skape gode resultater på våre løpende kundemålinger.
  • Det er ønskelig at du har relevant ledererfaring innen varehandel, gjerne dagligvarebransjen.
  • Følger kjedens konsept
  • Det å skape gode økonomiske resultater motiverer deg.

 

Spørsmål til stillingen kan rettes til personalsjef Ida Ostad på telefon: 482 03 701.

 

 

Høres dette ut som noe for deg? Da er du kanskje den nye lederen vi ser etter:-)

Coop Hammerfest SA er et medlemseid samvirkeforetak med drøyt 5700 medeiere. Selskapet har 4 butikker i Hammerfest Kommune. Vi har i dag 3 Extra og 1 Prix Butikk. Vi er ca. 75 ansatte, og forventet omsetning i 2027 er om lag 320 millioner. Vi er ett samvirkerlag i sterk vekst og ønsker deg gjerne med !

jobs.title: Research Engineer, Index Intelligence
jobs.description:
Exa is an applied AI lab building a search engine unlike the world has ever seen. We build massive-scale infra to crawl the entire web, train state-of-the-art embedding models to process it, and design super high performant vector databases to retrieve over it. We now power search for Cursor, Cognition, HubSpot, and over 400,000 developers and have raised $350m from Lightspeed, Benchmark, and a16z.

 

Our ultimate goal is to build perfect search over all the world's information, far beyond Google. If you want to build massive-scale ML systems that will define the way the new AI world consumes information, this is the place for you.

We crawl the web continuously and cannot keep all of it, refresh all of it, or spend a GPU on all of it. Something has to decide which pages are worth indexing, which links are worth following, which pages say the same thing as pages we already have, what has gone stale, and what we should never have picked up. These decisions are worth more than most ranking work. The cheapest way to improve search is to stop indexing pages nobody should ever retrieve, and to start indexing the ones we are missing. Today they run on a mix of learned signals and thresholds someone picked.

We are looking for a research engineer to own the signals behind those decisions, and the decisions themselves.

Desired Experience

  • You are comfortable owning a problem with no ground truth, where the first job is defining what the right answer means

  • Hands-on ML experience with classifiers, rankers and calibration, plus strong data instincts at web scale

  • You think in end-to-end impact. A signal only counts if a decision changes and search gets better

  • You like working across teams. Crawling, indexing and retrieval all consume what you build

  • You care about the problem of finding high quality knowledge and recognize how important this is for the world

Example Projects

  • Make parsing work on the pages where it currently does not, and prove the improvement rather than assert it

  • Teach a model to judge page quality, and get everyone to agree on what quality means well enough to supervise it

  • Work on credibility and misinformation as a modelling problem: what a page claims, whether it is a reliable source of it, and whether it was written for a reader or for a crawler

  • Decide whether two documents are semantically the same or genuinely different, so we can deduplicate the web without collapsing pages that a user would want to see separately

jobs.description:
Exa is an applied AI lab building a search engine unlike the world has ever seen. We build massive-scale infra to crawl the entire web, train state-of-the-art embedding models to process it, and design super high performant vector databases to retrieve over it. We now power search for Cursor, Cognition, HubSpot, and over 400,000 developers and have raised $350m from Lightspeed, Benchmark, and a16z.

 

Our ultimate goal is to build perfect search over all the world's information, far beyond Google. If you want to build massive-scale ML systems that will define the way the new AI world consumes information, this is the place for you.

 

As a backend engineer, you'd play a critical role in our search architecture. We're pretty flexible on what projects people work on based on their skills and interests.

Search quality is bounded by what we understand about a page. Before anything can be retrieved, something has to work out what the page actually says. That means parsing it into the parts that are content and the parts that are furniture, classifying what kind of page it is and what it is about, telling whether the page is usable at all, extracting when it was published, judging how good it is and whether it can be trusted, and working out whether it says anything that a page we already have does not. All of this has to work on every page on the web, in every language, in every shape the web comes in.

Some of this is classic document understanding. Some of it is much more open. Credibility and misinformation, AI-generated and machine-spun content, and pages written to be found rather than read are all unsolved, and search results are only as trustworthy as our answers to them.

We are looking for a research engineer to work on this. There is a lot of room to do it well.

Desired Experience

  • Graduate-level ML experience (Master’s or PhD with at least 2 years of relevant experience), or an exceptionally strong undergrad

  • You can build a transformer from scratch in PyTorch, and you have trained models that then had to be cheap enough to run everywhere

  • You like building large-scale datasets and living in the data. Most of the wins here are in the supervision rather than the architecture

  • You are comfortable with problems where the ground truth does not exist yet and defining it is part of the job

  • You care about the problem of finding high quality knowledge and recognize how important this is for the world

Example Projects

  • Make parsing work on the pages where it currently does not, and prove the improvement rather than assert it

  • Teach a model to judge page quality, and get everyone to agree on what quality means well enough to supervise it

  • Work on credibility and misinformation as a modelling problem: what a page claims, whether it is a reliable source of it, and whether it was written for a reader or for a crawler

  • Build classification and extraction that is accurate at web scale and cheap enough to run on all of it

  • Design the supervision for something nobody has labels for, and find out whether it is learnable at all

  • Trace a bad search result back to the page-level prediction that caused it, and fix it at the source

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Knowledge Engine – Query Engine
jobs.description:
Exa is an applied AI lab building a search engine unlike the world has ever seen. We build massive-scale infra to crawl the entire web, train state-of-the-art embedding models to process it, and design super high performant vector databases to retrieve over it. We now power search for Cursor, Cognition, HubSpot, and over 400,000 developers and have raised $350m from Lightspeed, Benchmark, and a16z.

Our ultimate goal is to build perfect search over all the world's information, far beyond Google. If you want to build massive-scale ML systems that will define the way the new AI world consumes information, this is the place for you.

The Knowledge Platform team builds Exa's knowledge engine. We continuously synthesize information from across the web and beyond into one of the world's largest open-domain knowledge graphs, with hundreds of billions of evidence-backed claims. The work has two halves: construction pipelines that decide what to trust, and retrieval engines that decide how best to search it. Our goal is to give agents answers to any factual question about the world with unprecedented precision and completeness.

In this role, you'll own the query engine that searches hundreds of billions of claims across a variety of retrieval backends, from a distributed graph database to vector, full-text, time-series and geospatial indexes.

This is greenfield work with a massive scope. No off-the-shelf system answers precise questions over hundreds of billions of evidence-backed claims at agent speed, so you'll make foundational decisions, from storage layout and indexing across engines to the query language and the planner that routes work between them, that every query depends on.

What you'll do

  • Own storage and indexing across backends: data layout, partitioning and indexes for graph, vector, full-text, time-series and geospatial retrieval, with bulk snapshot builds and live ingest that never take the system down.

  • Decide how best to search: cost-based planning from cardinality estimates that chooses, for each question, which backends to use, in what order and how to join their results, executed as traversals, retrievals, filters and aggregations in one plan.

  • Make it fast at scale: serve thousands of queries per second, profiling and cutting p50/p99 latency, memory and cost per query under high concurrent load, from on-disk layout to network fan-out.

  • Keep answers consistent while the data converges: the graph is fed by live updates and bulk snapshots at once and is eventually consistent by design, so you'll own what a query may see while it converges: consistent snapshot promotion, ordered application of live updates and stable pagination across versions.

  • Measure precision and completeness: end-to-end checks every deployment must pass, plus evals and metrics that show when a plan returns wrong results or misses ones it should have found.

What we're looking for

  • You've worked deep inside a distributed database, query engine, search engine or storage system.

  • Strong grasp of indexing, query planning and optimization, and storage formats.

  • Solid grasp of distributed systems fundamentals: consensus, replication, sharding and fault tolerance.

  • Strong in a systems language (Go, Rust or C++).

  • You profile before you optimize, and you've shipped measured latency wins in production.

  • You obsess over correctness, reliability and data quality as much as scale.

Bonus

  • Graph databases, or combining vector, full-text, time-series and geospatial retrieval

  • Compilers, query language design or cost-based optimizers

Example projects

  • Build a system that retrieves and reasons over everything known about any company or person in the world, answering any factual question precisely and completely.

  • Answer precise multi-hop questions over hundreds of billions of claims at thousands of QPS with interactive latency.

  • Build a planner that picks the right mix of graph, vector, full-text and geospatial retrieval for any question, and proves it chose well.

  • Make new knowledge queryable seconds after it's synthesized, without ever serving an inconsistent result.

Logistics

  • Location: This is an in-person opportunity in Zurich.

  • Visas: We're happy to sponsor international candidates (e.g., STEM OPT, OPT, H1B, O1, E3). While we cannot guarantee your visa, we have historically been successful in sponsoring candidates from all over the world. If you receive an offer, our team will work hard to get you a visa.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Introducer Tech
jobs.description:
Senior Backend Engineer - Introducer Tech - DE

Hybrid in London / Remote within the UK

We’re looking for a Senior Backend Engineer

You'll own the Lending API in Germany, which banks, fintechs, brokers, and comparison sites build on to offer iwoca's finance to their customers. You'll decide how it evolves and help build the features that make partners choose iwoca.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £5 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

Introducer Tech builds the systems that partners in Germany use to refer businesses to iwoca. The aim is to get new partners integrated quickly and to make applying simple for their customers. The team also looks after how partners earn commission.

Its work covers three main areas:

  • The Lending API. Developing the versioned API and the webhooks that keep partners up to date on their customers.

  • The Introducer Portal. Building the web app that German brokers log in to, to submit applications and upload documents.

  • The sign-up journey. Improving how businesses apply and how well they convert, after a partner referral.

The team is growing to have two product managers, who each focus on either the broker or the partner flow, and three engineers across the backend and frontend, including this hire.

The team currently works in sprints, with three stand-ups a week and planning every two weeks. However, there is room to adapt how it works as it grows.

The role

You'll be the senior engineer behind iwoca's broker and partner channels in Germany, from the tools partners integrate with to the internal systems that broker account managers use.

Ownership and autonomy

  • Own the Lending API in Germany end to end, deciding what to build, when to release a new version, when to retire an old one, and what iwoca can promise partners.

  • Own the developer portal and every tool partners use to integrate, from documentation that their developers and coding agents can build from to self-serve testing that needs no help from iwoca.

Impact

  • Ship the features that make partners choose iwoca, starting with pre-qualification, which shows a customer what they could borrow before they apply.

  • Make integration quick and simple, so a partner can go live with few questions and little hand-holding.

  • Automate parts of the broker funnel and the internal CRM that broker account managers use, cutting friction and the lag between a decision and the action that follows, and building agents wherever they help.

Growth trajectory

  • Set the team's technical direction and shape the product and technical roadmap alongside the product manager.

  • Align designs with the UK engineers who share the API, so German requirements shape the design from the start.

  • As well as being hands on, you’ll develop your mentoring and coaching skills. You’ll help lead the team as the most senior engineer.

You'll work with the commercial colleagues who bring in new partners, and join the team's weekly support rotation.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Backend engineering. You've designed and built production backend systems in Python – ideally with Django, though FastAPI or Flask count too. You've used PostgreSQL or another relational database in production, and kept it fast and maintainable.

  • API design. You've built and evolved APIs that other teams or companies depend on, and made the decisions on structure, versioning, and change.

  • Ownership. You've taken work from a commercial problem through to production – scoping the solution, making the trade-offs, and iterating based on how people use it.

  • Mentoring. You've helped other engineers grow through code reviews and design sessions.

  • AI leverage. You've built agentic workflows, or used AI to scale your engineering output beyond what you could deliver alone. You judge when to use it and when not to.

  • Communication. You write and speak clearly, directly, and concisely. You adapt technical detail to your audience.

Bonus:

  • Partner onboarding. You've helped external developers integrate with an API – through documentation, test environments, or working with them directly.

  • Full-stack. You've contributed to frontend codebases, particularly in React or TypeScript.

  • CI/CD. You've set up or maintained the pipelines that test and release a production service.

  • Measurement. You've used data, metrics, or A/B tests to check whether a change had the effect you intended.

The salary

We expect to pay from £80,000 to £100,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.
