jobs.description:
About Volta

Volta is the category-defining, fully vertically integrated AI infrastructure platform – from capital to clusters to software, under a founder-led enterprise. Our mission is The Utility of Compute™: AI infrastructure as dependable and available as electricity, for every organization that needs it. Launched with a $10B strategic partnership with one of the leading frontier AI labs, a Series A led by Andreessen Horowitz, and a $5B AI Infrastructure Fund, Volta is building the infrastructure layer of the AI era from the ground up. We are 100+ people across London, Palo Alto, and New York, with rapid growth expectations to hundreds.

The Role

We are looking for a Procurement Legal Counsel to join our Procurement team to support the drafting, review and negotiation of procurement contracts across Volta's global portfolio. You will report directly to the VP, Vendor Procurement and work day to day with the Regional Procurement Directors and Category Managers in EMEA and AMER, taking agreements from first draft through to signature, from MNDAs and MSAs to frameworks.

You will work from Volta's approved templates, negotiation playbooks and fallback positions, and escalate non-standard legal risk to the VP Vendor Procurement/Legal team and/or external counsel rather than determining it yourself. It is also a first of fleet role: you will help build the templates, playbooks and contract records.

What You Will Do

  • Prepare, review and negotiate mutual and one way NDAs with prospective suppliers, contractors and consultants, turning them around quickly so sourcing activity is never held up

  • Draft and negotiate Master Services Agreements, supply agreements and their associated order forms, statements of work and purchase order terms, working from Volta's approved templates

  • Support the Regional Procurement Directors in preparing and negotiating regional framework agreements, including (not limited to) call off mechanisms, pricing schedules, service levels and performance terms

  • Support the Delivery Contracts team to prepare and manage construction and project agreements, including standard form contracts such as NEC, JCT, FIDIC and AIA

  • Review supplier and contractor markups against Volta's playbook, prepare issues lists, recommend positions within agreed fallbacks and facilitate and manage negotiation calls

  • Escalate non-standard positions, such as liability caps, indemnities, liquidated damages and IP, to the Legal team or external counsel with a clear summary of the issue

  • Manage contract execution end to end, including approvals in line with the delegation of authority, signature routing and version control

  • Maintain the procurement contract repository, tracking key dates, renewals, expiries, insurance certificates and contractual obligations, and flagging upcoming actions to the relevant Category Manager.

  • Work with Procurement Global operations to agree technology strategy

  • Build and maintain Volta's procurement contract templates, clause library and negotiation playbooks, capturing lessons learned and guiding procurement colleagues on their use

  • Provide contract status and pipeline reporting to the VP, Vendor Procurement

What You Will Bring

  • A paralegal, chartered legal executive or contracts qualification (for example CILEx, a law degree, or SQE or LPC study), or equivalent experience gained in a commercial contractsrole

  • 4 or more years drafting, reviewing and negotiating commercial contracts, ideally in procurement, data centre or large scale infrastructure

  • Hands on experience with NDAs, MSAs, framework agreements and supply contracts, and a working knowledge of standard form construction contracts such as NEC, JCT, FIDIC or AIA

  • A solid understanding of key commercial risk areas, including liability, indemnities, insurance, warranties, payment terms, termination and intellectual property, and the judgement to know when to escalate

  • Experience working under the supervision of in house or external lawyers while managing a high volume of agreements to deadline, ideally using contract lifecycle management and electronic signature tools

  • Precise drafting, exceptional attention to detail and clear communication with commercial, technical and supplier stakeholders

  • Exposure to both UK or European and US contracting would be an advantage

REQ-284

As a global team, we do our best to provide great benefits wherever you're based. While some benefits vary by country due to local regulations, we believe looking after our people is simply the right thing to do.

Role: Staff Engineer (Integrations / Supply, air travel)

Company: Voyagu

Location: Fully remote, Europe preferred. European time zone; about two hours of difference is fine. About eight hours online, and some overlap with US time zones helps because many users are there.

Job Type: Full-time. Contract model is flexible: contractor, payroll provider or direct employment.

About Voyagu

Voyagu builds one platform that runs several travel businesses. Today the focus is air travel. The platform covers client management (CRM), ERP modules for finance and accounting, travel operations, and integrations with travel supply systems.

The model is offline travel: agencies that sell through people. Voyagu does not sell the software and does not plan to, but agencies work with it in different models. It is a bootstrap scaleup, so teams are lean and money is counted.

Development leans heavily on AI. Teams of AI agents run big features under a business operator and a technical operator. Sometimes this turns two half-years of work into two weeks. It does not always work. When code is cheap, product vision and architecture become the bottleneck, and that is where you come in.

This role owns the integrations and supply direction. Air travel alone is deep: every airline has its own distribution channels and APIs. You would lead one of five platform development streams and report to the CTO. There is no product manager in between, and you work directly with the founder and other business stakeholders. The team has no one with your profile today, so you would be the first.

What you are expected to do

Technical ownership

  • Lead the integrations and supply direction as its technical owner.

  • Build integrations with GDS systems. Voyagu works with one today and needs more.

  • Connect airline direct APIs and non-GDS protocols across multiple sources.

  • Handle servicing after sale: changes, cancellations, refunds, and group bookings split into parts.

  • Work with live, real-time availability. Seat availability does not depend on price.

  • Prevent costly errors. One missed booking can mean tens of thousands of dollars. Design for reliability, for example with idempotency, so nothing is paid or bought twice.

  • Keep the solution sized to Voyagu’s scale and avoid over-design. This is not internet-scale work.

  • Keep the system stable. Speed and error rate are the measures.

Vision and delivery

  • Shape the technical vision with stakeholders and defend it. They will challenge it.

  • Expect no ready-made tasks. Business stakeholders give you a direction, not a finished task.

  • Turn the agreed platform capabilities into features and give estimates. Several dozen capabilities are written down, such as search and booking.

  • Success means Voyagu accepts your estimates and you deliver them, or come close. Part of the plan will be agreed together with you.

AI-driven development

  • Build and direct teams of AI coding agents instead of writing code by hand.

What you need to succeed

  • You have worked in the travel domain, especially on integrations with supply systems. About two or more years is likely enough.

  • You understand booking versus ticket, and the statuses and states of each.

  • You have owned a large piece of a product, not a small slice.

  • You work at staff or senior level, as architect and technical lead.

  • You understand what Voyagu does and why, and you talk well with stakeholders.

  • You use AI well beyond the beginner level and have a clear view on how to use it effectively.

  • You believe small teams work. You do not think in big organisations.

  • You work in a European time zone; ideally you are based in Europe.

  • You speak Russian: engineering works mostly in Russian. Business teams speak English, and English B2 is enough.

  • Nice to have: you have seen both corporate and lean startup worlds, or a bootstrap scaleup. You may be an ex-founder or a small-company CTO who stayed hands-on.

  • Nice to have: you have run teams of agents, not only asked an agent to write a feature.

  • Nice to have: vendor-side experience building for end users. Python is the current main stack, but language skill is not important.

  • Not required: high-load experience, writing agent skills, or deep C#/legacy aviation knowledge.

What you get

  • You own a whole direction, with responsibility handed over fully.

Black Forest Labs builds visual intelligence: models that create and understand images and video, and increasingly act in the physical world. For a company whose work is visual, the brand is part of the work. It's often the first thing people see of us, before they've tried a single model. It has to hold the same bar as our models and grow as they do.

We're hiring our first Brand Designer to define that brand and own it wherever people meet BFL. You'll bring the taste that sets the standard for how BFL looks, and build what keeps it consistent across launches, the website, events and everything in between.

This is a hands-on lead role. You'll ship much of the work yourself while setting up the tools and processes that let others ship at your level. Over time, you'll also shape how brand and marketing design grows at BFL, including who we hire next.

What you'll work on

  • Lead how our visual identity grows, including logo, type, color, imagery and motion, and turn it into guidelines and design systems others can work from.

Design at BFL is young, and much of how it works is still open, including how we review work, what we call finished and how design informs decisions across teams. You'll help define these and represent design across the company.

You'll work closely with Devran, who leads design at BFL, and with teams across the company, including marketing, growth, developer relations, research and product design. Among the people you'll work with most are Owais and Aitana in marketing and Jay in growth engineering.

What we're looking for

  • At least six years designing brands, and one or two projects you'd still stand behind today, where you played a key role from concept through rollout and others now build on the work. We're looking for an original idea, clear taste and execution that holds up in every detail.

  • Deep craft in identity and visual design, from typography and color to layout, art direction and motion. You notice the crop, the spacing and the timing of a transition, and you fix them before anyone asks.

  • A quality bar that raises the work around you. You've made a team better before, through the work you shipped and the feedback you gave.

  • You're ready to ship from day one. You've started work no one asked for, seen it through, and sorted out disagreements directly with the people involved.

  • A systems thinker. You've built guidelines, templates or design systems that others used well without you in the room, and you can tell when work should scale and when it should stay one of a kind.

  • You move easily between the big picture and the details. You can make the case for a design decision to a founder, an engineer and a marketer, and you change how you make it for each of them.

  • You're comfortable with ambiguity. One week might take you from a model launch to merch to a new page on bfl.ai. Much here isn't figured out yet, and you see that as an opportunity.

  • Curiosity about new tools, new problems and getting better at your craft. You can point to something you taught yourself recently and how it changed your work.

  • Shipping web pages or prototypes yourself with AI coding tools such as Claude Code.

  • Building your own tools for brand work, such as template generators or small internal apps.

  • Using generative image or video models in your creative process.

  • Motion, 3D or creative coding.

How we work together

We’re a distributed team with real offices that people actually use. You’ll be based in Europe or the US and work from your home location, with one week each month spent with us in Freiburg or San Francisco to stay connected with the team.

Everything we do is grounded in four values:

  • Low Ego. The work speaks. The best idea wins, no matter who said it. Credit is shared. Nobody is above any task.

The PACE is fast. The expectations are high. The contribution matters. Working at TYTAN is more than a job, this is a mission. Our mission and values guide everything we do, and we're looking for people who are driven by ownership, embrace challenges, and are energized by meaningful work. At TYTAN, we aim to set a global standard in autonomous air defense with AI-driven, cost-efficient systems that counter unmanned aerial threats at scale. We protect people. We protect critical infrastructure. We protect European sovereignty.

We are looking for an Senior Export Control Manager whose has understanding of defense product related export control and customs regulation to ensure full compliance with export control, customs, and trade regulations across our operations.

The role works closely with Logistics, Procurement, Production, and Engineering, while owning all export control and customs compliance topics within the Operations team, specifically related to the production and international movement of KWL-controlled goods.

You will act as the subject matter expert for both export control and customs, ensuring compliant classification, licensing, customs processes, and documentation across the entire operational value chain.

Your Roadmap to Make an Impact

Export Control & Trade Compliance

  • Ensure compliance with German, EU, and international export control regulations, including AWG, AWV, EU Dual-Use Regulation, and applicable international regimes.

  • Own export control topics for KWL-controlled goods, including classification, licensing, documentation, and audit readiness.

  • Classify products, components, software, and technology (e.g. KWL, ECCN, HS) in cooperation with Engineering and Product Management.

  • Determine licensing requirements, apply for and manage export licenses, and conduct embargo, sanctions, and restricted party screenings.

Customs & Import / Export Operations

  • Ensure compliance with customs regulations for imports and exports, including tariff classification (HS), customs valuation, origin determination, and preference management.

  • Coordinate customs processes with freight forwarders, customs brokers, and authorities.

  • Review and approve customs documentations and manage customs-related authorizations and procedures (e.g. simplified procedures, AEO where applicable).

Operations & Supply Chain Collaboration

  • Work closely with Logistics, Production Planning and Procurement to ensure compliant material flow.

  • Advise Operations on compliance implications for manufacturing, internal transfers, re-exports, and technology access.

  • Support onboarding of new suppliers and logistics partners and ensure export control and customs requirements are embedded into operational workflows and ERP systems.

  • Support item onboarding to ensure data quality across the product life-cycle.

Process Ownership & Governance

  • Develop, implement, and continuously improve export control and customs processes, SOPs, and work instructions within Operations.

  • Maintain complete and audit-ready documentation, records, and prepare and support internal and external audits, and authority requests.

  • Act as the main point of contact for export control and customs authorities and external advisors.

Leadership & Advisory

  • Act as a lead for export control and customs department. Train and advise employees in Operations, Supply Chain, and Logistics on export control and customs requirements.

  • Monitor regulatory changes and assess their impact on different processes and act as escalation point and decision-maker for complex compliance cases.


  • 6+ years of experience in defense product export control, customs, or trade compliance in the defense area.

  • Strong knowledge of German export control regulations (AWG, AWV, KWL) and customs law; EU Dual-Use Regulation required, understanding of US EAR/ITAR is also important .

  • Understanding of export control and customs rules for defense product is a must have.

  • Experience with KWL-controlled goods and complex international supply chains.

  • Hands-on experience with customs classification, valuation, origin, and broker coordination.

  • High level of ownership, structured working style, and attention to detail.

  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.

  • Fluency in German and English (written and spoken).

Why TYTAN?

  • Build technology with real operational impact: Develop autonomous defense systems designed to protect lives and strengthen Europe’s security

  • Shape scalable defense capabilities: Work on solutions built for mass deployment, cost efficiency, resilience, and reliable production at scale

  • Contribute to networked air defense: Help integrate our systems into multi-layered defense architectures alongside sensors, command systems, and effectors

  • Develop for real-world operations: Build capabilities together with end users and improve them continuously based on direct operational feedback

  • Move fast and take ownership: Work in a focused, high-performance team where decisions are made quickly and individual contributions have immediate impact

  • Define a new generation of defense technology: Join early and help shape the products, engineering standards, culture, and direction of a fast-growing deep-tech company

  • Work with an international mission-driven team: Collaborate with experienced specialists united by the goal of creating sovereign and effective security capabilities for Europe

Our Benefits

  • Monthly allowances: €106/month in flexible benefits including lunch discounts and EGYM Wellpass or shopping credit

  • Regular health care events: Health check-ups, skin screenings, mental health workshops, and an annual vitamin infusion on us

  • Regular team events: On- and off-site activities to connect and celebrate together

  • Corporate discounts: Exclusive employee discounts across a wide range of partner brands

  • Flexibility: Flexible working hours and hybrid work model, plus a modern Munich office built for focus and collaboration

About us

At TYTAN, it is more than just a job; it is about embracing autonomy, personal growth, and purpose. Make a lasting impact in the new era of defense! Join us to create a safer world for all.

jobs.title: Socialsekreterare till mottagningen
jobs.description: Nu har du chansen att bli en av oss!Vi arbetar tillsammans med hjärta och kvalitet för att kunna ge bästa möjliga service till Ronneby kommuns invånare. Ronneby ligger vackert mellan hav och skog i mitten av Blekinge. Dessutom har vi bra kommunikationer med bil, tåg och flyg. Dina 2500 blivande kollegor är duktiga på att möta framtidens utmaningar och våra invånares ökade förväntningar genom digitalisering, samarbete och ett engagerat ledarskap. Tillsammans med dig gör vi Ronneby ännu bättre!Läs om Ronneby kommun via https://ronneby.se/naringsliv--arbete/arbeta-hos-oss.html1 plats(er). ARBETSUPPGIFTERSocialsekreteraren är mottagningens myndighetsutövande funktion i första kontakten med invånare, anhöriga och professionella. Rollen arbetar med en bred målgrupp inom mottagningens uppdrag, bland annat barn och unga, skadligt bruk, våld i nära relation, LSS och ekonomiskt bistånd. Socialsekreteraren ansvarar för att ta emot ansökningar, anmälningar och andra kontakter, göra tidiga och rättssäkra bedömningar samt genomföra enklare utredningar när ärendet kan hanteras inom mottagningens uppdrag. Socialsekreteraren avgör om behovet kan mötas genom information, rådgivning, beslut eller kortare handläggning i mottagningen, eller om ärendet behöver överlämnas till fortsatt handläggning. Rollen ska bidra till att rätt stöd ges på rätt nivå från början, att invånaren inte bollas mellan verksamheter och att mottagningen arbetar utifrån helhet snarare än stuprör.Huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter    • Ta emot och hantera inkommande ansökningar, anmälningar och förfrågningar.    • Genomföra skyddsbedömningar, förhandsbedömningar och initiala behovsbedömningar.    • Arbeta utforskande för att tidigt förstå behov, risker, skyddsfaktorer och möjliga lösningar.    • Ge information, råd och stöd.    • Bedöma om stöd kan ges direkt, om ärendet ska hanteras i mottagningen eller om det ska överlämnas.    • Fatta beslut enligt delegation.    • Genomföra enklare utredningar inom mottagningens uppdrag när det är tillräckligt och ändamålsenligt.    • Bidra till att onödiga utredningar, dubbelarbete och interna överlämningar undviks.    • Samordna tidiga kontakter med andra verksamheter och externa aktörer när det behövs för att skapa en samlad bild av behovet.Koppling till mottagningens uppdrag: Rollen bidrar särskilt till en väg in, tidiga och likvärdiga bedömningar, kortare väg till stöd och minskad rundgång mellan olika verksamheter.    • Arbetar lösningsfokuserat och utforskande.    • Ser möjligheter att ge stöd utan omfattande utredningsprocesser när det är lämpligt.    • Har förmåga att arbeta brett över flera målgrupper.    • Bidrar aktivt till samverkan och utveckling.KVALIFIKATIONERSocionomexamen ett grundläggande krav för uppdraget som innefattar myndighetsutövning. Rollen innefattar myndighetsutövning och kräver därför relevant högskoleutbildning inom socialt arbete.Rollen förutsätter god kunskap om socialtjänstens uppdrag, relevant lagstiftning, dokumentation, bedömning och beslutsfattande.Särskilt viktiga förmågor är att skapa förtroende i korta kontakter, snabbt kunna ringa in behov hos olika målgrupper, prioritera under tidspress, uttrycka sig tydligt i tal och skrift samt fatta välgrundade beslut även i komplexa situationer.Erfarenhet av mottagningsarbete, förhandsbedömningar, skyddsbedömningar, barn och unga, vuxna med skadligt bruk, våld i nära relation, LSS, ekonomiskt bistånd eller annat myndighetsarbete inom socialtjänsten är meriterande.Löneform: Månadslön.Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning.Varaktighet: Tillsvidare.Om du kallas till intervju ska du uppvisa giltig identitetshandling samt styrka ditt medborgarskap eller arbetstillstånd. Vi tillämpar individuell och differentierad lönesättning, och erbjuder ersättningar enligt kollektivavtalens bestämmelser. Vårt lönepolitiska arbete bygger på de centrala kollektivavtalen. jobs.description: Värderar du närhet, att växa och skapa de bästa förutsättningarna för alla som bor och verkar i Huddinge kommun? jobs.title: Trosopplæring - Etnedal og Sør-Aurdal
jobs.description:
Etnedal kyrkjelege fellesråd i samarbeid med Sør- Aurdal kirkelige fellesråd har ledig 40% stilling som trosopplæringsmedarbeider/ menighetspedagog.

Vi ser etter en person som ønsker å formidle kristen tro og praksis, som stortrives sammen med barn og som brenner for å gjøre menighetenes tilbud tilgjengelig, relevant og inkluderende for barn og familiene deres.

Kirkens trosopplæring er i endring og vi ønsker å drive tiltak som er relevante for barn og familier i nærområdet vårt. Det vil derfor være viktig at personen som ansettes, kan tilrettelegge og tilpasse tiltak og aktiviteter til lokale behov. For å gjennomføre tiltak er vi avhengig av godt samarbeid i stab og med frivillige. Vi søker derfor noen med gode samarbeidsevner og som har evne til å bygge relasjoner og nettverk til frivillige. I tillegg vil den ansatte arbeide tett med øvrig stab og sammen med denne drive informasjons- og profileringsarbeid.

Stabene i Etnedal og Sør- Aurdal består av prester, organister, kirkeverger, kirketjenere og sekretærer. Kirkekontoret i Etnedal er lokalisert på Bruflat og i Sør- Aurdal på Tingvoll på Bagn.

Den som tilsettes får Etnedal kyrkjelege fellesråd som arbeidsgiver med kirkevergen som nærmeste overordnede.

Arbeidsoppgaver:

  • Planlegging, gjennomføring og evaluering av trosopplæringstiltak 0-18 år i samarbeid med ansatte, trosopplæringsutvalg og frivillige. Tiltakene kan endres, men innbefatter per nå bl.a. babysang, skattejakt i kirkene, Tårnagentene, Lys Våken m.m

  • Være en ressurs i oppfølging av frivillige medarbeidere, foreldre og hjelpeledere

  • Være med å legge til rette for barne- og ungdomsarbeidet

  • Arbeide med de lokale planene for trosopplæring og rapportering

Personlige egenskaper:

  • Gode samarbeids-, planleggings- og gjennomføringsevner

  • Kontaktskapende og fleksibel

  • Ansvarsbevisst og evne til å arbeide selvstendig

  • God formidlingsevne og relasjonskompetanse

Kvalifikasjoner:

  • Relevant kompetanse er kateket-, teologisk-, pedagogisk- eller lignende utdanning

  • Erfaring fra arbeid med barn og unge, og fra teamarbeid

  • Fordel med erfaring fra sang og musikk, eller annen musikalsk kompetanse/interesse

  • Personlige egnethet vil bli vektlagt

  • Den som tilsettes må være medlem i Den norske kirke

  • Disponere bil

Vi tilbyr:

  • Fast ansettelse

  • Lønn etter gjeldende tariff og pensjonsordning i KLP

  • Hyggelige arbeidsfellesskap

  • Tilbud om både kontor- og hjemmekontor løsning

  • Varierte arbeidsdager og fleksibel arbeidstid

  • Noe kvelds- og helgejobb må påregnes

Kirken er gitt hjemmel til å kreve barneomsorgsattest, slik den er definert i politiregisterloven § 39. Slik attest kreves ved ansettelse.

For ytterligere informasjon: Kontakt kirkeverge i Etnedal, Marie Bjørnødegård, på telefon: 91 83 70 11 eller på e-post: mb836@kyrkja.no.

Søknad og CV sendes: Etnedal kyrkjelege fellesråd, Kyrkjevegen 10, 2890 Etnedal eller m836@kyrkja.no

Søknadsfrist 30. oktober 2026 Ansettelse snarest

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Kirkelig fellesråd er et lovpålagt samarbeidsorgan mellom kommune og soknene.

Vi skal ivareta administrative og økonomiske oppgaver på vegne av soknene, utarbeide planer for kirkelig virksomhet i kommunen, fremme samarbeid mellom menighetsrådene samt ivareta deres interesser i forhold til kommunen. Rådet har blant annet ansvar for bygging, drift og vedlikehold av kirker, anlegg, drift forvaltning og gravplasser, anskaffelse og drift av kirkekontor samt arbeidsgiveransvar for ansatte i kirkelige stillinger som lønnes over fellesrådets budsjett.

I Etnedal er det to kirker og to sokn. I Sør- Aurdal er det fem kirker og fem sokn (samt 3 kapell).

Etnedal og Sør- Aurdal samarbeider om trosopplæring, og Etnedal er den den økonomiske og administrative enheten i samarbeidet. Den ansatte vil dermed bli tilsatt i Etnedal kyrkjelege fellesråd.

jobs.title: Brannforebygger i Sel brann- og redningsvesen og Vågå brannvesen, 100% fast stilling
jobs.description:
Sel kommune med ca. 6000 innbyggere ligger midt i Gudbrandsdalen med kort avstand til landets flotteste og mest besøkte nasjonalparker og elver. Kommune- og regionsenteret Otta er et viktig samferdselsknutepunkt for vei og jernbane. Sel kommune er vertskommune for et omfattende, interkommunalt samarbeid. Vi er en aktiv MOT-kommune og er stolte av ungdommen vår. Vi er også en handels- og industrikommune med viktige arbeidsplasser blant annet innen varehandel, bilbransje, grafisk bransje, treforedling, næringsmiddelindustri, mekanisk industri og steinindustri. Vi har en betydelig reiselivs- og opplevelsesnæring med utgangspunkt i ikke minst Rondane, Heidal og Sjoa elv. Landbruket er fortsatt en viktig næring. Ett topp moderne lokalmedisinsk senter ligger vegg i vegg med Sel rådhus. Sykehuset Innlandet har betydelig virksomhet på Otta.

Vil du bidra til å redusere sannsynligheten for brann og begrense konsekvensene brann kan få for liv, helse, miljø og materielle verdier for våre innbyggere i Sel og Vågå kommuner?

Sel brann- og redningsvesen og Vågå brannvesen har ansvaret for det brannforebyggende arbeidet i Sel og Vågå kommune. Det er fire ansatte ved forebyggende avdeling, en leder og tre brannforebyggere. Vi dekker et stort geografisk område med i underkant av 10 000 innbyggere. Beredskapsavdelingen har 44 mannskaper fordelt på brannstasjoner i Heidal, Vågå og Otta.

Brannforebygger i Sel brann- og redningsvesen og Vågå brannvesen,

100% fast stilling

St.id. 1039

Vi har ledig stilling som brannforebygger i Sel brann- og redningsvesen og Vågå brannvesen og vi søker en engasjert og motivert brannforebygger til vårt team ved forebyggende avdeling. Vi søker etter en ny medarbeider som er utadvendt, trygg i møte med våre innbyggere og har et stort engasjement for brannforebygging.

Arbeidsoppgaver:

  • Planlegge, varsle og gjennomføre tilsyn og feiing med fyringsanlegg i bolig og fritidsbolig.

  • Saksbehandling og oppfølging etter feiing og tilsyn.

  • Veilede om brannvern til innbyggere og hytteeiere.

  • Arbeide med informasjons- og motivasjonstiltak.

  • Andre forebyggende oppgaver ved avdelingen.

  • Ansvar og vedlikehold av verneutstyr, tjenestebil og anna materiell.

  • Delta i utviklingsarbeid, prosjekter og kompetanseheving.

  • Samarbeid med andre aktører internt og eksternt.

  • Bidra til god HMS-kultur og utvikling av rutiner, prosedyrer og internkontroll.

Kvalifikasjonskrav:

  • Svennebrev som brannforebygger.

o Søkere uten svennebrev i brannforebyggerfaget, men med annen relevant erfaring eller relevant fagbrev, kan bli vurdert. Ansettelse uten svennebrev vil gi særskilte krav om et utdanningsløp som praksiskandidat.

  • God skriftlig og muntlig fremstillingsevne.

  • Grunnleggende IT-kunnskaper og erfaring med bruk av digitale verktøy.

  • Førerkort klasse B (manuell).

Vi søker deg som:

  • er selvstendig og strukturert

  • arbeider godt i team, og som deler kunnskap og erfaringer med andre.

  • kommuniserer godt og er trygg i møte med våre innbyggere

  • har godt humør, er positiv og bidrar til et godt arbeidsmiljø

  • håndterer rolige, hektiske og varierte arbeidsdager

  • har god fysisk form

  • er motivert for faglig utvikling

Personlig egnethet vil bli tillagt stor vekt.

Vi tilbyr:

  • en meningsfull og viktig jobb i vårt lokalsamfunn

  • gode og engasjerte medarbeidere i et trivelig og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø

  • konkurransedyktig lønn basert på utdanning og kvalifikasjoner

  • god pensjonsordning i KLP

  • trening i arbeidstiden

  • bedriftshelsetjeneste

  • fleksibel arbeidstid

  • ny tjenestebil

  • lønns- og arbeidsvilkår som er fastsatt i lov og avtaleverk

Tilfredsstillende politiattest må fremlegges før tilsettelse i Sel brann- og redningsvesen, jf. brann- og eksplosjonsvernloven §18.

På sikt kan det også bli aktuelt med en rolle innen beredskapsavdelingen.

Tiltredelse etter avtale.

For nærmere opplysninger eller spørsmål om stillingen som brannforebygger ta kontakt med leder forebyggende avdeling Tor-Even Vågheim på telefon 99 58 96 12, tor-even.vagheim@vaga.kommune.no eller brannsjef Roar Strand, roar.strand@vaga.kommune.no, 90 14 19 75.

Søkere må benytte elektronisk søknadsskjema for ledige stillinger.

Sel kommune er opptatt av mangfold og oppfordrer kvalifiserte kandidater å søke uavhengig av alder, kjønn, funksjonsevne, etnisitet eller nasjonal bakgrunn. Vi er IA-bedrift og vil legge forholdene til rette for søkere med redusert funksjonsevne.

Vi gjør oppmerksom på at opplysninger om søkeren kan bli offentliggjort selv om søkeren ber om å ikke bli oppført på søkerlista, jfr. offentlighetslovens § 25 og at mottatt kopi av attester og vitnemål ikke vil bli returnert.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Sel kommune ligger sentralt i Gudbrandsdalen. Administrasjonssenteret og byen Otta er regionsenter i Nord-Gudbrandsdalen og et knutepunkt i Gudbrandsdalen. Sel er vertskommune for viktige statlige og regionale funksjoner. Kommunen står fremfor eller i gjennomføringsfasen for flere utbyggings- og utviklingsprosjekter knyttet til bl.a. skole, barnehage, videreutvikling av lokalmedisinsk senter, stedsutvikling i regionsenteret, hovedplan for vann og avløp, kommunal boligbygging, teknologiutvikling/digitalisering og effektivisering av arbeidsprosesser. Våre verdier er SEL: S amhandling -- E ntusiasme -- L ikeverd.

jobs.title: Barnehagelærer
jobs.description:

  • Veilede og støtte øvrig personale

  • Delta aktivt i pedagogisk og praktisk arbeid

  • Være en trygg og støttende voksen for barna

  • Bidra til et godt faglig og sosialt arbeidsmiljø

Personlige egenskaper

  • Fleksibel, initiativrik og løsningsorientert

  • Gode samarbeidsevner og kommunikasjonsevner

  • Kreativ og tydelig rollemodell

  • Glad i å være ute og delta i aktiviteter i all slags vær

  • God omsorgsevne

  • Evne til å se og tilrettelegge for alle barns utvikling

  • Gode norskkunnskaper, både muntlig og skriftlig

  • Personlig egnethet vil bli vektlagt

Vi tilbyr

  • Et godt faglig, stabilt og sosialt arbeidsmiljø

  • Varierte og meningsfulle arbeidsoppgaver

  • Plantid som tas ut i hele dager

  • Tariffavtale med gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger gjennom PBL, inkludert AFP. Startbonus ved fast ansettelse, to års binding.

  • God avspaserings ordning og tjenestefri

jobs.title: Eventus Bergen Barneasyl søker fagarbeider/ pedagogisk medarbeider
jobs.description:
Vil du jobbe i byens kuleste barnehage? Da må du lese videre:

Eventus Bergen Barneasyl er Bergens eldste barnehage. I vårt spennende bygg fra 1752, driver vi en barnehage som både er en by- og kulturbarnehage, og en friluftsbarnehage. Vi bruker byens mange kulturtilbud, og farter land og strand rundt med vår flotte minibuss.

Vi søker deg som har et stort varmt hjerte, er løsningsorientert, og som samarbeider godt med kollegaer, foresatte og barn. Du er opptatt av å gi barn gode opplevelser og har som mål å levere arbeid med høy kvalitet.

Hva ser vi etter:

  • Du er en god rollemodell for barna.

  • Du er faglig reflektert og opptatt av å holde deg oppdatert.

  • Du er interessert i friluftsliv for barn.
  • Du er opptatt av å gi barna gode opplevelser.
  • Du holder deg i form til å håndtere en aktiv barnehagehverdag.
  • Du liker å være aktiv sammen med barna inne, ute og på tur.
  • Du liker å være ute i all slags vær.
  • Du er god til å samarbeide med andre mennesker i alle aldre.
  • Du har god kompetanse på digitale verktøy og IKT.

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Støtte pedagogisk leder i planlegging, gjennomføring og evaluering av det pedagogiske arbeidet på avdelingen.
  • Kan/skal selv legge til rette for pedagogisk arbeid som for eksempel samlingsstunder, utflukter, temaarbeid og annet.
  • Bidra aktivt i foreldresamarbeid og oppfølging av enkeltbarns behov for veiledning, omsorg og utvikling.
  • Være en del av barnehagens profesjonsfelleskap, holde seg faglig oppdatert og delta aktivt i kunnskapsutvikling med øvrige ansatte.
  • Få tildelt et ekstra ansvarsområde etter eget ønske. Dette kan være noe du selv brenner for å få til (friluftsliv, grønnsakshage, lekeområder osv.).
  • Samarbeide på tvers av avdelinger og se hele barnehagen som en helhet.

Kvalifikasjoner

  • Gyldig politiattest

  • Fagbrev i barne- og ungdomsarbeiderfaget er ønsket. Ufaglærte kan også bli vurdert.

  • Gode muntlige og skriftlige norskferdigheter.

Personlige egenskaper

Personlig egnethet og erfaring vil bli vektlagt.

I tillegg til det som allerede er nevn over, er egenskaper som positivitet, humor og entusiasme noe vi verdsetter høyt. Du må like å by på deg selv og være kontaktsøkende. Du må også være strukturert og punktlig.

Vi tilbyr

  • Mulighet for å få dekket førerkort på minibuss og båt.
  • Fleksibel hverdag hvor hver avdeling har mye autonomi.
  • Engasjerte medarbeidere som er opptatt av pedagogisk kvalitet.
  • Arbeidsklær.
  • Lønn som følger PBL sin tariff
  • Planleggingsdager med faglig innhold både i barnehagen og felles for alle i Eventus.

  • Mangfoldig arbeidsmiljø med flere mannlige ansatte.

  • Mulighet til å være med å forme og videreutvikle det pedagogiske arbeidet i en barnehage med et historisk sus.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Eventus Barnehager er en non-profitt-organisasjon som består av 13 barnehager på Vestlandet.

Eventus Bergen Barneasyl er byens eldste barnehage, og vi holder til i et ærverdig og spennende bygg med røtter tilbake til 1752. Vi er plassert midt i Bergen sentrum, med umiddelbar nærhet til byliv, kulturelle opplevelser og til Fløyfellet. Vi har også vår helt egen minibuss, som frakter oss dit vi ønsker å dra.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
We are the platform turning browsing into shopping. We connect 200 million shoppers with deals they love while boosting local sales for hundreds of top retailers and brands.

We help consumers save time and money while making smart shopping decisions, and we support retailers and brands in engaging customers from online research to in-store purchases.

In 2024, Shopfully joined forces with the North American company , creating a global leader in the sector. Together, we reach 400 million households and serve over 1,000 top retailers and brands across 27 markets, including Europe, Canada, the USA, Latin America, and Australia.

Ready to spark your growth with us?

WHO WE LOOK FOR 🦄

Flipp + Shopfully’s Product team focuses on driving adoption and revenue of our products by identifying the biggest market opportunities, building the case for investing in them, and shipping solutions with engineering, all while representing the voice of our merchant customers.

About the role

The Senior Product Manager is a senior, commercially minded product leader who already understands digital advertising. This role requires a strong strategic thinker with good business sense and solid hands-on product skills who leads opportunity identification, builds decision-ready business cases, and works with engineering to ship.

You will work closely with Sales, Engineering, Data, and Marketing teams across markets to align on key business objectives. By combining market insight, customer feedback, and industry trends, you will make sure our products resonate with merchants and drive growth. We’re looking for someone who can ramp up quickly and contribute independently.

WHAT YOU WILL DO 🏄

Market Understanding and Opportunity Identification

  • Work with Product Marketing, Sales Engineering and customer-facing teams to understand customer needs and prioritize the opportunities that matter most.
  • Find the highest-leverage areas to invest in, and weigh customer demand against our resources, capabilities and strategic direction.
  • Turn complex questions into clear priorities. For example: how do we create more value for retail partners as their strategies move toward e-commerce? How do we find and build opportunities at scale as products launch in new markets?

Business Cases and Strategy

  • Build business cases that size opportunities, weigh revenue trade-offs, and structure a clear recommendation so leadership can make a decision.
  • Own your recommendations, and be ready to explain them and adapt them as you learn.
  • Lead the strategy for how our products differentiate from competitors in the market.
  • Partner with Sales and Finance on pricing and monetization so our offering stays cohesive.

Product Discovery and Delivery

  • Lead discovery with merchants, advertisers, and internal teams to define problems worth solving.
  • Prioritise ruthlessly, balancing revenue impact, effort, and strategic fit.
  • Work hands-on with engineering to define requirements and ship, from alpha and testing through broad launch.
  • Partner with Sales and Marketing on launch timing and readiness, and run retrospectives on past launches to improve future ones.

Alignment and Stakeholder Management

  • Generate cross-functional alignment (Engineering, Data, Sales, Marketing, Content) with a shared focus on goals and timing.
  • Work across markets and levels of seniority, including senior leadership, with confidence.
  • Track progress and impact of product initiatives and communicate results clearly.
  • Build relationships with industry analysts, partners, and customers, and represent Flipp + Shopfully at conferences and industry events where relevant.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED🪄

Must-haves

  • Digital advertising foundations: supply vs. demand, how exchanges, SSPs, and DSPs work, programmatic bidding, pricing models (CPM, CPC, CPV), and fill rate and yield. Ideally gained in ad tech, a retail media network, a publisher, or a marketplace.
  • Proven experience building business cases: sizing opportunities, weighing revenue trade-offs, and structuring recommendations for decisions.
  • High autonomy: you figure things out, own the outcome and don’t need close management.
  • Genuine excitement about using AI tools and rethinking how work gets done.
  • Hands-on product skills: discovery, prioritisation, and working with engineering to ship, not only strategy.
  • Stakeholder management, with the confidence to work across markets and levels of seniority.
  • A scrappy, curious and confident approach. You’re hungry to make an impact.

👉 At our company, we value diversity and actively encourage it — we believe a variety of perspectives and backgrounds makes us stronger. We focus on potential rather than on having a “perfect” CV. If this role excites you and you believe you could grow into it — even if you don’t tick every single box in the requirements — we’d love to hear from you!

NICE TO HAVE 🎆

  • Retail, CPG, or retail media background
  • Multi-market experience
  • Can speak Italian or German

LOCATION 🌐

While we have offices in Milan, Berlin, Barcelona, you can benefit from our flexible hybrid model (full remote available), empowering you to work where you're most effective.

HOURS ⏰
Your manager and several partner teams are in North America, so you’ll need to be flexible about working some later hours, beyond a standard 9-5 CET.

WHAT YOU WILL FIND AT SHOPFULLY 🤗

🌎 An opportunity to thrive in a rapidly scaling multinational company

🕶️ A vibrant, informal, and inclusive work environment

🧠 We champion autonomy, flexibility, and a hybrid work model, empowering you to own your work

📚 Access to learning opportunities and regular feedback sessions

🍓 Enjoy our central, modern offices featuring fresh snacks, coffee (including vegan options!), and ergonomic setups

🎉 Engage in meaningful team events: offsites, happy hours, company parties and celebrations that unite us beyond daily tasks

💻We provide all the necessary equipment for you to work effectively and set up your workspace, wherever you are

🧰 Benefit from additional country-specific advantages based on local contracts and practices

WHO WE ARE 💜

We’re a team of 450 people (and counting!), from 30 different nationalities. We’re on a mission to innovate, and we believe the key to that is seeing the world through a variety of perspectives. That’s why building a more diverse team, as well as bringing in even more talent, is so important for us.

TO FEEL AT HOME 🛋️ IN SHOPFULLY YOU NEED 🎯

  • Progress Over Perfection: We move forward. Always. In a fast-moving world, speed with purpose beats certainty without action. Momentum matters—not for its own sake, but because it drives results.
  • Clarity Through Transparency: We bring each other along. We work in teams, not silos. Transparency gives context, and context enables action. That means we share decisions early, publish work in progress, and document outcomes so others can learn, move faster, and build better.
  • Learn Loudly: We grow by doing and by daring. Big bets unlock big breakthroughs. But real innovation demands risk, and risk always carries the possibility of failure. That’s not a flaw. It’s the price of ambition.
  • Challenge with Empathy: We speak up, even when it’s hard—because candor shows care, and leads to better outcomes. Listening deeply is how we grow. Disagreeing openly is how we build trust.

Always Build Better: We are builders—of products, systems, and ideas. But more than that, we are builders of better. Better has no finish line. It’s a mindset.

jobs.description: Assistant Professor in Economics for Global-Local Analysis on Sustainable Development(Valid from 22/10/2026 to 08/04/2027) Language: English (UK)Location Esch-sur-AlzetteCountry: Luxembourg Organisation data: Luxembourg Centre for Socio-Environmental SystemsJob Number: UOL08556Contract Type: Professorial - PermanentSchedule Type: Full TimeWork Hours 40.0 Hours per WeekExpected Start Date: 01/05/2027 Job Level: MonolevelJob (internal): Assistant ProfessorExpertise: ProfessorsRole Type: Open PositionFunctions: Associate / Assistant ProfessorAbout usThe University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.The Luxembourg Centre for Socio-Environmental Systems strives to grow into an internationally recognised research hub for a sustainable and equitable world. Our goal is to help societies to transition to environmentally friendly and just conditions. At the core is the recognition that global environmental disruptions such as climate change, biodiversity loss, and resource depletion are closely linked with societal systems. To address these complex issues, we take a systemic approach and study the interconnectedness of human activities and the environment. Our mission is to develop sustainable, socially just, and environmentally friendly solutions by bridging disciplines and fostering collaboration between researchers, policymakers, and society. Your roleThe successful candidate will establish and lead internationally visible research at the interface of economics, sustainability science and global environmental change, developing new quantitative approaches to understand and steer transformations across food, land, water and natural-resource systems. A distinctive ambition of the professorship is to develop a multi-scale global–local–global perspective on sustainability by investigating how local decisions by producers, consumers and other actors are shaped by global markets, trade, technology, climate and policy – and how their aggregate effects feedback to landscapes, ecosystems and societies.Consequently, the candidate's research will combine economic theory, fine-scale spatial data, empirical evidence and computational modelling to explain trade-offs, synergies and spillovers that remain hidden in single-scale analyses. Relevant research may address at least three of the following fields: agricultural production, labor markets, natural-resource scarcity, food security, climate change, technological change, impacts of demographic transition, social cohesion, resilience of supply chains, environmental policy, and the distributional consequences of sustainability transformations.A key ambition is to move beyond diagnosing unsustainable trajectories towards designing effective and equitable transformation pathways, exploring how policy, innovation and global interconnectedness can reconcile environmental sustainability with food security, livelihoods and economic development.For further information about the role, please contact: Prof. Dr. Ralf Seppelt, Director the Luxembourg Centre for Socio-Environmental System (LCSES), Email: ralf.seppelt@uni.lu. Your profileThe successful candidate holds a strong academic background in economics, agricultural or environmental economics, together with an internationally recognized research record. They have demonstrated expertise in economic theory and quantitative modelling, complemented by experience with spatially explicit data, empirical estimation, computational methods or other approaches capable of linking processes across scales.Additionally, they can translate theoretical concepts into transparent, empirically grounded models and integrate economic analysis with insights and data from other disciplines. Experience in interdisciplinary research on food, land, water, climate, natural resources or related sustainability challenges can be proven by documented participation within interdisciplinary networks and projects.The successful candidate is an intellectually independent researcher with the ambition to build and lead a collaborative, interdisciplinary research team, attract competitive research funding, develop innovative methodological approaches and contribute to policy-relevant sustainability science. A commitment to open, reproducible research, excellent communication across disciplinary boundaries, and the ability to engage effectively with policy and practice are essential.The ideal candidate will have:• A PhD in a relevant field and a minimum of 5 years postdoc experience demonstrating ability to independently develop a research agenda• A strong capability to think out of the box and shape their research around the challenges posed by interdisciplinary questions• A strong record of research excellence, evidenced by impactful publications and success in securing external research funding• Experience engaging with policymakers, NGOs, and other stakeholders to translate research into real-world impact• A demonstrated commitment to mentoring and fostering the next generation of researchers• Willingness to contribute to teaching programmes at the undergraduate and graduate levels in areas related to environmental change and socio-environmental systemsLanguage requirements:The University of Luxembourg is set in a multilingual and multicultural context. The person hired on this position must have an excellent command of English. Excellent command of either French or German will be considered as an advantage. The University encourages its staff to learn the other language and provides access to language courses to this end. We offer• A modern, dynamic university with a personal and inclusive atmosphere. Multilingual and international character. Staff coming from more than 90 countries. Member of The Guild of European Research Intensive Universities• An exceptional research environment, supported by skilled staff and high-quality equipment. Strong links to professional sectors and the Luxembourg labour market. A unique urban campus with excellent infrastructure• A partner for society and industry. Cooperation with European institutions, innovative companies, the Financial Centre and a wide range of non-academic partners including ministries, local governments, associations, and NGOs How to applyApplications should contain:• Cover letter, to be addressed to Prof. Ralf Seppelt, Director of the LCSES• CV, including any periods of absence from work such as family-related leave and career breaks• Short description of profile, key achievements and impact, summarizing main publications, projects, teaching expertise and accomplishments in knowledge transfer relevant to this role (1-3 pages)• Statement of planned research, teaching and other activities at the University of Luxembourg (1–3 pages)• Lists of publications, research projects, PhD theses supervised and subjects taught• Names, contact information and current position of 3 referees who can, upon request, provide an assessment of the application. jobs.title: Technicien / Ingénieur Intégration & Validation Cryogénique
jobs.description:
Quandela est un leader mondial de l’informatique quantique, qui conçoit, développe et déploie des solutions quantiques de pointe à destination de la recherche et de l’industrie.

Son offre comprend notamment les ordinateurs quantiques les plus économes en énergie pour les data centers, des solutions complètes de calcul quantique accessibles via le cloud, ainsi que des services d’accès à des algorithmes pour les acteurs académiques et industriels.

Avec une feuille de route pragmatique et progressive, Quandela déploie depuis 2023 des systèmes de niveau industriel, tout en développant les futures générations d’ordinateurs quantiques tolérants aux pannes, capables de passer à l’échelle grâce à l’intégration de milliers de composants photoniques.

Quandela ambitionne de rendre l’informatique quantique accessible au plus grand nombre afin de contribuer à résoudre les défis industriels et sociétaux les plus complexes.

En savoir plus : Quandela | Leading Photonic Quantum Computing Solutions

Rejoignez-nous à la pointe de l’innovation en informatique quantique 🚀

À propos du poste

Dans le cadre du développement de nos activités de production et d'intégration de processeurs quantiques photoniques (QPU), nous recherchons un(e) Technicien(ne) / Ingénieur(e) Intégration & Validation Cryogénique pour rejoindre notre équipe Assemblage & Production, basée à Massy.

Vous interviendrez principalement sur l'intégration et la validation des équipements et sous-ensembles au sein des cryostats utilisés dans nos systèmes. Ces opérations impliquent la manipulation de composants sensibles et délicats, nécessitant une grande précision, de la méticulosité et une attention particulière aux conditions de montage et d'intégration.

Vous réaliserez les opérations de montage, de câblage, de thermalisation, de mise en service et de contrôle, en veillant au respect des contraintes cryogéniques et des protocoles de validation.

Vous participerez également au suivi du fonctionnement et des maintenances des équipements cryogéniques, notamment les cryostats et leurs compresseurs associés. La compréhension et l'utilisation des systèmes de vide et de pompage feront partie de vos activités, en tant qu'éléments nécessaires au bon fonctionnement des installations cryogéniques.

Au-delà de l'application des procédures, vous devrez être capable de comprendre le comportement des systèmes, d'analyser les anomalies et de contribuer à l'identification des actions nécessaires à leur résolution, en collaboration avec les experts techniques concernés.

Selon les besoins, vous pourrez apporter un support technique à distance ou intervenir ponctuellement sur les systèmes installés chez nos clients, en France ou à l'international.

Le poste s'inscrit dans un environnement de production en petite série, avec des équipements complexes et multidisciplinaires. La montée en échelle de la production est déjà engagée, notamment à travers la structuration progressive de nos méthodes et processus d'industrialisation. Une première base documentaire est déjà en place, et vous contribuerez à son amélioration afin de rendre les opérations plus robustes, reproductibles et adaptées à l'augmentation des volumes de production.

Vous bénéficierez d'un accompagnement et de formations internes pour approfondir votre connaissance des équipements cryogéniques spécifiques à Quandela, avec la possibilité de devenir progressivement un interlocuteur technique de référence sur ces systèmes.

Missions principales

Intégration et validation des équipements dans les cryostats

Vous réalisez l'intégration de composants et sous-ensembles, parfois sensibles et délicats, au sein des cryostats. Ces opérations nécessitent une grande précision et le respect des exigences de propreté, de manipulation et d'assemblage.

À ce titre, vous :

  • Préparez les cryostats, les composants et les équipements nécessaires aux opérations d'intégration.
  • Manipulez et assemblez avec précision des composants sensibles, en appliquant les précautions et méthodes adaptées à leur fragilité et à leurs contraintes d'intégration.
  • Réalisez le montage et l'intégration des composants et sous-ensembles dans les chambres de cryostats.
  • Assurez le passage, le cheminement et la fixation des câbles et connexions à l'intérieur des enceintes cryogéniques, en veillant à préserver l'intégrité des composants et des connexions.
  • Réalisez les opérations de thermalisation des câbles et composants, en tenant compte des contraintes thermiques et mécaniques.
  • Veillez au respect des contraintes d'intégration : encombrement, interfaces mécaniques, compatibilité des matériaux, propreté et contraintes thermiques.
  • Appliquez les bonnes pratiques de manipulation, de protection et de contrôle des composants tout au long des opérations d'intégration.
  • Réalisez les opérations de contrôle et de validation de l'intégration selon les protocoles définis.
  • Analysez les résultats des contrôles, identifiez les éventuelles non-conformités et participez à leur résolution.
  • Rédigez les rapports de validation associés et assurez la traçabilité des opérations réalisées.
  • Identifiez les difficultés d'intégration et proposez des améliorations adaptées.

Requirements

Compétences techniques – Indispensables

  • Bonnes connaissances pratiques en cryogénie et compréhension des contraintes associées aux basses températures.
  • Connaissance des principes de transfert thermique, de thermalisation et des contraintes mécaniques liées aux environnements cryogéniques.
  • Capacité à réaliser des opérations de montage et d'intégration de composants dans des systèmes cryogéniques.
  • Expérience dans la manipulation et l'assemblage de composants sensibles ou délicats, nécessitant précision et précautions particulières.
  • Maîtrise des bonnes pratiques de manipulation, de propreté et de protection des composants lors des opérations d'intégration.
  • Compréhension du fonctionnement général des cryostats et de leurs équipements associés.
  • Connaissance des principes de mise sous vide et du fonctionnement des équipements de pompage nécessaires aux applications cryogéniques.
  • Capacité à réaliser des opérations de mise en service, de refroidissement et de validation selon des procédures établies.
  • Capacité à réaliser et valider des opérations d'intégration selon des protocoles définis, à analyser les résultats et à rédiger les rapports associés.
  • Capacité à interpréter des mesures de température et de pression pour analyser le fonctionnement d'un système.
  • Capacité à réaliser les premières investigations techniques, à analyser les symptômes observés et à contribuer à l'identification des causes d'un dysfonctionnement, en collaboration avec les experts lorsque nécessaire.
  • Capacité à suivre des procédures tout en sachant identifier les situations nécessitant une analyse complémentaire ou l'intervention d'un expert.
  • Capacité à assurer le suivi des échéances de maintenance et des interventions réalisées.
  • Capacité à lire, appliquer et rédiger des procédures techniques et des rapports d'essais.
  • Sensibilisation aux risques associés aux systèmes cryogéniques et aux équipements sous vide.

Qualités recherchées

  • Méticulosité et précision : capacité à réaliser des opérations d'assemblage délicates avec soin, patience et une attention constante aux détails.
  • Rigueur et respect des procédures : attention portée à la qualité des montages, à la propreté des équipements et à la protection des composants sensibles.
  • Autonomie et esprit d'initiative : capacité à prendre en charge les activités confiées, à identifier les difficultés et à solliciter les bons interlocuteurs lorsque nécessaire.
  • Esprit d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes : capacité à comprendre le comportement des systèmes, à analyser les anomalies et à mener des investigations méthodiques.
  • Pragmatisme et sens pratique : goût pour les manipulations techniques, l'intégration et la résolution concrète de problèmes.
  • Organisation et traçabilité : capacité à documenter les opérations, suivre les essais et maintenir des historiques techniques fiables.
  • Curiosité technique et volonté d'apprendre : intérêt pour le fonctionnement des équipements et l'acquisition progressive d'une expertise approfondie.
  • Esprit d'amélioration continue : capacité à contribuer à la structuration des processus et à l'amélioration des méthodes de travail.
  • Capacité à travailler en équipe avec des profils techniques variés et à solliciter les experts appropriés.
  • Pédagogie et communication : capacité à transmettre des connaissances et à accompagner d'autres intervenants.
  • Respect des règles de sécurité et conscience des risques associés aux systèmes cryogéniques et aux équipements de vide.

Benefits

Ce que nous offrons :

      • Un rôle à fort impact, avec de réelles responsabilités dès votre arrivée
      • Une équipe qui a envie de collaborer, de partager et de grandir avec vous
      • Un modèle de travail hybride : 3 jours par semaine sur site à Massy, 1 jour à Paris et 1 à 2 jours en télétravail
      • Une exposition quotidienne à l’ensemble de la stack quantique : des API haut niveau jusqu’au firmware bas niveau, et tout ce qui se trouve entre les deux

Processus de recrutement :

      • Entretien avec l’équipe Talent Acquisition (30 à 45 min)
      • Entretien avec le Hiring Manager (45 min)
      • Étude de cas : en direct ou à préparer chez vous puis à présenter
      • Rencontre avec les équipes
      • 2 prises de références
      • Offre

Ce processus est donné à titre indicatif et peut évoluer en fonction du poste.

Chez Quandela, nous sommes convaincus que la richesse de notre équipe repose sur la diversité des expériences, des perspectives et des parcours. Nous nous engageons à construire un environnement de travail respectueux, inclusif et accueillant. Toutes les candidatures sont les bienvenues.

jobs.title: Refa für kleine Kanzlei im Migrationsrecht (Rechtsanwaltsfachangestellte/r)
jobs.description: Wir suchen eine*n Rechtsanwaltsfachangestellte*n.Unsere Anwält*innenkanzlei mit 6 Rechtsanwält*innen besteht seit November 2018 und befindet sich in Berlin-Kreuzberg 61. Wir sind ausschließlich im Bereich Migrationsrecht tätig und arbeiten bundesweit in allen Teilbereichen des Aufenthaltsrechts, des Asylrechts sowie des Staatsangehörigkeitsrechts. Darüber hinaus sind wir auf dem Gebiet des Sozial- und Strafrechts für unsere aufenthalts- und asylrechtlichen Mandant*innen tätig.Bei uns sind derzeit 5 Bürokräfte sowie eine ausgebildete Rechtsanwaltsfachangestellte (in unterschiedlichem Stundenumfang) und eine Auszubildende angestellt. Dazu kommen noch zwei wissenschaftliche Hilfskräfte.Neben der Posteingangs- und Fristenkontrolle, stehen vor allem organisatorische Aufgaben im Mittelpunkt.Ihre Aufgaben:Als Rechtsanwaltsfachangestellte*r übernehmen Sie eine zentrale Rolle in unserer Kanzlei. Zu Ihren Aufgaben gehören:- Eigenverantwortliche Erledigung von administrativen Aufgaben im Kanzleisekretariat; perspektivisch die Leitung des gesamten Bürosekretariats- Abwicklung des Publikumsverkehrs und Sicherstellung der telefonischen Erreichbarkeit- Koordination des Termin-Kalenders und Scannen sowie Zuordnen der Eingangs- und Ausgangspost- Eigenständige Führung des Fristen-Kalenders- Korrespondenz mit Mandantinnen, Behörden und Gerichten in Absprache mit den Anwältinnen- Abrechnung der Mandate sowie vorbereitende Buchführung- Umgang mit digitalen Akten (keine Papierakten) – sicherer Umgang mit Computer und gängigen ProgrammenWas wir erwarten:- Abgeschlossene Ausbildung zur/zum Rechtsanwaltsfachangestellten- Gute EDV-Kenntnisse, insbesondere im Umgang mit Textverarbeitungs- und E-Mail-Programmen- Erfahrungen im Kanzleibetrieb und idealerweise in den Bereichen Migrationsrecht, Sozialrecht oder Strafrecht- Freude an eigenständigem Arbeiten (wobei wir für Rückfragen immer ansprechbar sind)- Fremdsprachenkenntnisse (mind. Englisch)Was wir bieten:- Flexibilität: Sie können Ihre Arbeitszeiten im Rahmen der arbeitsrechtlichen Vorgaben flexibel einteilen – Wir legen insbesondere Wert auf Familienfreundlichkeit- Kollegialität und persönlichen Umgang: flache Hierarchien, regelmäßige gemeinsame Mittagessen, Team-Treffen und Kanzleiausflüge- Attraktive Konditionen: - Einstieg mit marktüblichem Gehalt, das sich an Ihrem Erfahrungshorizont orientiert- Übernahme der Kosten für ein Deutschland-Ticket (Job-Ticket)- Arbeiten in einem repräsentativen Altbau im Herzen Berlins- Abwechslung: Tätigkeit mit direktem Mandantenkontakt, die Möglichkeit, Arbeitsprozesse aktiv mitzugestalten und sich bei Interesse weiterzubildenDie Position umfasst **mindestens 20 Stunden pro Woche (**bis zu 40 Stunden sind möglich).Wenn Sie Interesse haben, freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbung per E-Mail an Julius Engel unter engel@blkr-berlin.de

jobs.title: Sekretariatsleitung in Anwaltskanzlei (Bürovorsteher/in (Rechtsanwaltskanzlei/Notariat))
jobs.description: Wir suchen eine Büroleitung bzw. -vorstand für unser Sekretariats-Team zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt.Unsere Anwält*innenkanzlei mit 6 Rechtsanwält*innen besteht seit November 2018 und befindet sich in Berlin-Kreuzberg 61. Wir sind ausschließlich im Bereich Migrationsrecht tätig und arbeiten bundesweit in allen Teilbereichen des Aufenthaltsrechts, des Asylrechts sowie des Staatsangehörigkeitsrechts. Darüber hinaus sind wir auf dem Gebiet des Sozial- und Strafrechts für unsere aufenthalts- und asylrechtlichen Mandant*innen tätig.Bei uns sind derzeit 5 Bürokräfte sowie eine ausgebildete Rechtsanwaltsfachangestellte (in unterschiedlichem Stundenumfang) und eine Auszubildende angestellt.Für unser Team suchen wir noch weitere Hilfe.Zu Ihren Aufgaben gehört die selbständige Abwicklung aller im Sekretariat anfallenden Tätigkeiten, vor allem aber auch deren Organisation und Gewährleistung eines reibungslosen Ablaufes. Zu den Aufgaben des Sekretariates gehören insbesondere die Abwicklung des Publikumsverkehrs, das Führen von Telefonaten, die Übersicht über den Termin-Kalender, das Scannen und Zuordnen der Eingangs- und die Bearbeitung der Ausgangspost, Aktenanlagen oder die Abwicklung einfacher Korrespondenz mit Mandant*innen, Behörden und Gerichten, Buchhaltung, Rechnungslegung und -prüfung.Als Büroleitung behalten Sie die Übersicht und stellen sicher, dass die verschiedenen anfallenden Aufgaben ausgeführt werden.Wir arbeiten größten Teils ohne Papier-Akten, weshalb Computer-Kenntnisse (vor allem im Umgang mit Text- und E-Mail-Programmen) unabdingbar sind. Als migrationsrechtlich tätige Kanzlei vertreten wir Mandant*innen aus vielen unterschiedlichen Ländern. Wir erwarten daher zumindest Englischkenntnisse.Wir bieten einen möglichst persönlichen Umgang (gemeinsame Mittagessen, Team-Treffen, Kanzleiausflug), Flexibilität bei der Einteilung der Arbeitszeiten (im Rahmen arbeitsrechtlicher Vorgaben) aus Verständnis für familiäre Verpflichtungen und eine abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit mit viel Mandant*innen-Kontakt. Die Tätigkeit sollte mindestens 20 h/ Woche umfassen. Wir übernehmen die Kosten für Deutschland-Ticket im Rahmen eines Job-Ticket Abos.Bei Interesse bewerben Sie sich gern mit Gehaltsvorstellungen per E-Mail bei Julius Engel (engel@blkr-berlin.de). jobs.title: Erfahrener Verkäufer / Einrichtungsberater (m/w/d) bei skurios – Vollzeit oder Teilzeit (Verkäufer/in)
jobs.description: Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:Möbelverkäufer/in; Einrichtungsberater/in; Verkaufsberatung Möbel und Interior; Verkäufer/in EinzelhandelStellenbeschreibung:Gute Beratung braucht Erfahrung. Und einen Arbeitgeber, der sie zu schätzen weiß.skurios ist die Lifestyle-Marke von Möbel Kerkfeld, einem Familienunternehmen aus Borken, das seit 1934 in Familienhand ist und heute knapp 50 Mitarbeiter beschäftigt. Bei skurios gibt es Möbel, Leuchten und Deko, die man nicht in jedem Möbelhaus findet, für Kunden, die etwas mit Charakter suchen und dafür eine gute Beratung erwarten. Und wir wachsen: Gerade bauen wir um, bauen an und vergrößern unsere Ausstellung. Für das Team um Christina, die skurios leitet, suchen wir ab sofort einen erfahrenen Verkäufer, der Kunden sicher und ehrlich zum Abschluss führt. Ob du aus dem Möbelhandel kommst oder aus einer anderen Branche, in der gute Beratung zählt: Entscheidend ist, dass du verkaufen kannst.„Bei uns zählt nicht, wie viele Kunden du am Tag durchschleust, sondern dass jeder mit einer Einrichtung nach Hause geht, die wirklich zu ihm passt. Dafür brauche ich jemanden, der Erfahrung mitbringt, Kunden ernst nimmt und gern in einem kleinen Team mit kurzen Wegen arbeitet. Wo diese Erfahrung herkommt, ist mir dabei weniger wichtig.“Christina Tenbeck , Geschäftsleitung skurios„skurios ist schon heute das Einrichtungshaus , in dem man Dinge findet, die es sonst nirgends gibt. Als dritte Generation im Familienunternehmen möchte ich, dass wir genau darauf aufbauen und weiter wachsen. Dafür suchen wir Profis, die wissen, wie guter Verkauf funktioniert, und ihre Erfahrung bei uns einbringen wollen.“Thilo Tenbeck, dritte Generation bei Möbel KerkfeldDas spricht für skurios:- Sicherheit eines Familienunternehmens. Seit über 90 Jahren in Familienhand, inhabergeführt und regional verwurzelt. Hier entscheidet kein Konzern über deinen Arbeitsplatz- Wechsel ohne Risiko. In den ersten 6 Monaten garantieren wir dir dein Gehalt, egal wie der Umsatz läuft. So kannst du dich in Ruhe einarbeiten und deinen Kundenstamm aufbauen- Deine Verkaufserfahrung zählt, das Möbelwissen bringen wir dir bei. Ob Autohaus, Küchenstudio, Mode, Juwelier oder hochwertiger Fachhandel: Wer Kunden gut beraten kann, kann das auch bei uns. Produkte, Materialien und Stoffe lernst du in Herstellerschulungen und im Alltag mit dem Team- Beratung statt Rabattschlacht. Keine Prozentaktionen im Wochentakt, kein Abfertigen von Laufkundschaft. Du berätst Menschen, die etwas Besonderes suchen, und hast Zeit für gute Beratung- Planbare Arbeitszeiten. Für Arzttermine, Behördengänge oder einfach Freizeit, wenn alle anderen arbeiten- Deine Ideen zählen. Du bringst dich bei Sortiment und Einkauf ein und fährst auf Wunsch mit auf Messen. Bei uns entscheidet keine Zentrale, sondern das TeamWas du bei uns machst- Du berätst unsere Kunden eigenständig im Möbelhaus , vom ersten Gespräch bis zum Auftrag- Du planst mit ihnen ganze Wohnbereiche: Schlafzimmer, Wohnzimmer, Jugendzimmer oder einzelne Möbel wie z. B. Sofa, Tisch, Leuchte und Deko, abgestimmt auf Raum, Stil und Budget- Du berätst zu Stoffen, Farben, Materialien und Funktionen- Du erstellst Angebote und schließt Aufträge ab- Du baust dir einen eigenen Stammkundenkreis auf und pflegst ihn- Du gestaltest gemeinsam mit Christina Sortiment und Ausstellung mitWas du mitbringst- Mehrjährige Erfahrung im beratungsintensiven Verkauf, z. B. im Möbel-, Küchen- oder Einrichtungshandel, im Autohaus, in der Mode oder im hochwertigen Fachhandel- Eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung oder eine Weiterbildung im Verkauf ist ein Plus- Abschlussstärke und den Anspruch, Kunden wirklich gut zu beraten- Gespür für Design und Einrichtung- Sicherheit im Umgang mit Angebots- und Warenwirtschaftssystemen oder die Bereitschaft, dich schnell einzuarbeiten- Eine offene, freundliche Art- Fachwissen zu Möbeln, Materialien und Stoffen ist ein Plus, aber keine VoraussetzungWas du von uns bekommst- Gehalt: Ein Verkäufer auf Vollzeitbasis verdient bei uns zwischen 43.000 € bis 60.000 € im Jahr. In den ersten 6 Monaten gilt unsere Einstiegsgarantie- Arbeitszeiten: skurios hat 6 Tage die Woche geöffnet, Mo–Fr 10–19 Uhr und Sa 10–18 Uhr. Du arbeitest davon an 5 Tagen und hast einen festen freien Tag unter der Woche. Teilzeit ist ab 16 Stunden pro Woche möglich- Einarbeitung: strukturierter Start in Sortiment, Materialkunde, Lieferanten und Abläufe, mit Christina als fester Ansprechperson. Branchenwechsler bekommen die Zeit, die sie brauchen.- Kurze Wege: direkter Draht zu Christina und zur Geschäftsführung. Entscheidungen fallen schnell.- Urlaub: 30 Tage (6-Tage-Woche)- Altersvorsorge: betriebliche Altersvorsorge mit Arbeitgeberzuschuss- Perspektive: z. B. Stellvertretung oder Verantwortung für einen Sortimentsbereich, falls Interesse- Mitarbeiterrabatt: großzügige % auf Möbel und Küchen von skurios und Möbel Kerkfeld, auch für deine Familie- Job-Rad: Fahrrad-Leasing- Weiterbildung: Schulungen bei Herstellern und gezielte Förderung deiner Weiterentwicklung- Moderne Hilfsmittel: Mit unserer eigenen KI-Visualisierung zeigst du Kunden ihre Wunschkombination fotorealistisch, bevor sie kaufen. Das ersetzt keine Erfahrung, es macht deine Beratung noch überzeugender.- Wenn du Lust hast: Du kannst Schaufenster gestalten, bei Events wie unserem Showcooking dabei sein oder auf Instagram zu sehen seinEinen Eindruck vom skurios bekommst du hier: Instagram @skuriosmoebelInteresse?Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und ein paar Sätze zu deiner Erfahrung. Ein Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht. Versprochen: Du hörst innerhalb von 48 Stunden von uns. Du bist aktuell noch in ungekündigter Stellung? Dann behandeln wir deine Bewerbung selbstverständlich vertraulich.Lieber erst mal persönlich sprechen? Dann ruf Christina einfach an. Sie erzählt dir gern, wie der Alltag bei skurios aussieht.Deine AnsprechpartnerChristina Tenbeck (Geschäftsleitung skurios)Christina.Wehlings@moebel-kerkfeld.de (https://mailto:Christina.Wehlings@moebel-kerkfeld.de)02861 703 88-20Ralf Tenbeck (Geschäftsführung)Ralf.Tenbeck@moebel-kerkfeld.de (https://mailto:Ralf.Tenbeck@moebel-kerkfeld.de)02861 703 88-20

jobs.title: Workday Product Owner (f/m/d) (Betriebswirt/in (Hochschule) - Personalmanagement)
jobs.description: BERNER pushing the limits – for those who dare moreMaking a choice about your career and your employer is a choice about your future - a future where you will invest your passion and a large portion of your time, energy, and capacity.  Are you a visionary Workday Product Owner ready to drive innovation and lead our company to new heights? We are looking for a dynamic and experienced professional to join our team and make a significant impact. Join our team and contribute to our success!Shape the future of HR technology at BERNERThe BERNER Group has successfully implemented Workday across 21 countries and continues to expand the platform to support its global HR and digital transformation journey. Current modules include Core HCM, Basic and Advanced Compensation, Talent, Recruiting, Absence, Reporting and Prism with a long-term vision to establish Workday as the single global HR platform covering additional HR domains (eg. Time Tracking, Workforce Planning).As Workday Product Owner, you will be responsible for the overall strategy, governance, stability and continuous improvement of the global Workday platform especially in relation to existing and future HR processes and operating model. You will act as the bridge between HR, business stakeholders, IT and external partners, ensuring that Workday delivers business value while remaining scalable, compliant and user-friendly. This role owns the Workday roadmap, backlog, budget and service performance across the organization.YOUR TASKS- Own the global Workday strategy, roadmap, standardization and governance.- Manage and prioritize the Workday backlog and demand pipeline. Coordinate testing, functional validation and release readiness, ensuring relevant owners approve business outcomes before deployment.- Actively manage relationships with country HR operations and stabilize adoption, HR process efficiency and digitization. Jointly drive communication, user enablement and adoption, working with HR Business Partnering to incorporate local needs and user feedback.- Actively manage relationships with key business stakeholders and counterparts, aligning priorities, managing expectations and driving decisions on the Workday roadmap.- Ensure stable system operations, service quality and compliance. Translate functional requirements into scalable Workday solutions.- Lead vendor relationships, licensing and external partners.- Define priorities and investment decisions together with stakeholders.- Drive adoption of new Workday functionality and releases.- Monitor KPIs, risks, budget and overall platform performance.- Coordinate cross-functional teams including Functional Analysts, Technical Analysts and Process Owners.- Manage the team supporting Workday operation and configuration.YOUR PROFILE- Strong combination of professional HR background with deep Workday expertise, or alternatively, SAP SuccessFactors/ Oracle HCM Cloud expertise.- 5+ years of experience with Workday, or alternatively, SAP SuccessFactors/ Oracle HCM Cloud in a global environment with practical exposure to HR processes.- Deep understanding of end-to-end HR processes and international process standardization.- Experience in product ownership, governance, service management or HRIS leadership.- Ability to manage stakeholders across multiple countries and functions.- Strategic mindset combined with hands-on execution skills.- Analytical thinking combined with a pragmatic, business-oriented mindset.- Experience working with external vendors and implementation partners.- Fluent German and English language skills, both written and spoken.WHY BERNER?- Job bike leasing (JobRad)  - Commuting allowance  - Wellpass membership & corporate benefits  - Company pension scheme  - Opportunities for further training  - Technically modern equipped workplace  - Company restaurant in Künzelsau or meal vouchers in Cologne  - Attractive conditions for our products in the BERNER online shop Apply Now – We’re Excited to Meet You! Please submit your application via our online form, including your availability and salary expectations. The BERNER Group is a European trading company serving professionals in the mobility, construction, and industrial sectors. We are the leading B2B specialist and an innovative manufacturer of chemical products. Our purpose is: “We are pushing the limits of the possible for the shapers of a better tomorrow.” With our strong brands - BERNER, BTI by BERNER, and CCS - we empower our customers to keep their businesses running successfully. Join our team and shape the future with us! The BERNER Group as employer, dare to differentiate ourselves and provide every employee the opportunity to and enable them to dare to be more.  Together, we push our own limits and contribute to shape a better tomorrow.Homeoffice:Umfang: Nach Vereinbarung

jobs.title: Senior CRM Manager (m/w/d) (CRM-Manager/in)
jobs.description: HAGEL ist einer der führenden Anbieter für professionelle Haarpflege, Beauty-Produkte und Friseurbedarf in Deutschland.
