jobs.title: Senior Transportledare
jobs.description: Måltidsfabriken erbjuder transporttjänster till offentlig sektor och privata aktörer i 18 orter runt om i Sverige. Vi är inne i en stark expansionsfas med fokus på kvalitet, pålitlighet och samhällsnytta. Vårt största uppdrag är måltidstransporter för kommuner – ett arbete som kräver ansvarstagande och självständighet i en miljö präglad av tillit och struktur.BeskrivningVi söker nu en transportledare som vill ta ansvar för att leda och optimera vår dagliga transportverksamhet. I den här rollen är du navet i vårt logistikflöde – du planerar rutter, stöttar våra chaufförer och säkerställer att våra leveranser sker smidigt, punktligt och enligt våra kunders krav. Erfarenhet av transporter & logistik är meriterande, men inte ett krav – det viktigaste är att du har ett strukturerat arbetssätt, är lösningsorienterad och trivs med att ha många kontaktytor.Huvudsakliga ansvarsområden:Som transportledare får du en central roll i vår dagliga verksamhet. Du ansvarar för att planera, leda och optimera våra transporter så att de sker effektivt, tryggt och i enlighet med kundens krav. Du är spindeln i nätet mellan chaufförer, kund och driftledning — med stort utrymme att påverka och förbättra arbetssätt.Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter inkluderar:    Planering och schemaläggning: Skapa effektiva körscheman för att säkerställa punktliga leveranser.    Koordinering: Leda, koordinera, Instruera, stötta och följa upp chaufförers arbetsdag.    Övervakning och uppföljning: Kontinuerligt övervaka transportverksamheten för att identifiera och lösa eventuella problem som kan påverka leveranskvaliteten eller effektiviteten. Följa upp och rapportera transportresultat och KPI    Kundkontakt: Vara kontaktpunkt för kunder angående transportrelaterade frågor. Säkerställa att kundernas specifika krav och önskemål uppfylls på ett professionellt sätt.    Kvalitet och säkerhet: Säkerställa att alla transportaktiviteter genomförs enligt företagets kvalitets- och säkerhetsstandarder. Genomföra regelbundna kontroller av fordon och utrustning för att upprätthålla hög säkerhetsnivå.    Rapportering: Upprätta och underhålla rapporteringssystem för att dokumentera transportverksamheten, inklusive avvikelser och förbättringsområden. Rapportera till överordnade chefer om status och problem.    Utveckling av personal: Ansvara för rekrytering, utbildning och utveckling av transportpersonal. Genomföra medarbetarsamtal och prestationsbedömningar för att stödja personalens utveckling och motivation.    Processförbättring: Identifiera och implementera förbättringar i transportprocesser och rutiner för att optimera effektivitet och kostnadskontroll. Delta i utveckling och uppdatering av transportpolicyer och procedurer.Kvalifikationer och krav:    Färdigheter: Goda ledaregenskaper och förmåga att motivera och leda ett team. Stark organisatorisk och analytisk förmåga.    Kommunikationsförmåga: Utmärkta kommunikations- och förhandlingsegenskaper, både på svenska och engelska.    Problemlösning: Förmåga att identifiera och lösa problem effektivt och snabbt.Personliga egenskaper:    Ansvarstagande och självgående    Hög stresstålighet och förmåga att hantera flera uppgifter samtidigt    Noggrann och detaljorienterad    Engagerad i att förbättra och effektivisera processer    Serviceorienterad med ett kundfokuserat arbetssättFöretaget erbjuder:    En dynamisk och utvecklande arbetsmiljö    Konkurrenskraftig lön och förmåner    Möjlighet till professionell utveckling och karriärvägar    En stödjande och samarbetsinriktad arbetskulturAnsökanLåter detta som en roll för dig? Skicka din ansökan senast 2025-07-30. Urval och intervjuer sker löpande, så vänta inte – vi ser fram emot att höra från dig! Vid frågor är du varmt välkommen att kontakta oss på hr@maltidsfabriken.se

jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

The first-day setup that goes smoothly. The benefits question answered with care. The employee change that reaches Payroll right on time. These moments shape how it feels to work at Notion, and People Operations helps make them happen.

As a People Operations Generalist, you’ll provide thoughtful operational support across People programs and processes, owning the critical touchpoints that make our team members feel supported throughout their journey. From the moment someone accepts their offer through their growth and transitions at Notion, you'll ensure every process runs smoothly. You may contribute to employee lifecycle, benefits, global mobility, HR systems, and other areas. You’ll manage work from intake through completion, keep records and handoffs accurate, and help employees and partners navigate processes with clear updates and follow-through.

This is a hands-on role for someone who can independently manage routine workflows, recognize when a case needs specialist or approval support, and adapt as responsibilities shift. The mix of work may evolve over time, creating opportunities to support different teams and build breadth across People Operations.

 

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 

 


WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Make the everyday feel effortless. Process assigned HRIS and employee-lifecycle transactions; maintain clean People data in our HRIS through audits, validation checks, and partner handoffs that prevent downstream reporting issues

 - Be a helpful first stop. Act as the Tier 1 Support for employees. Triage and resolve questions or requests submitted to our ticketing system

 - Keep benefits running smoothly. Coordinate routine benefits transactions and employee update; support compliance workflows, respond to employee questions and requests; partner with benefits providers, HRIS, and Payroll to resolve eligibility or data discrepancies

 - Help people navigate global moves. Initiate and track immigration and relocation cases, milestones, and provide stakeholder follow-ups. Partner with employees, candidates, People Partners, Recruiting, hiring managers, and immigration counsel to keep cases moving.

 - Bring care and judgment to each case. Resolve routine cases using documented guidance and route exceptions, policy decisions, or sensitive matters to the appropriate specialist or approver.

 - Keep teams connected and work moving. Be a reliable partner to cross-functional teams, including Global Mobility, Recruiting, Legal, Finance, People Partners, and IT on all things People Operations

 - Build trust through accuracy. Manage compliance - SOC2, maintain employee files, support regular audits, etc.

 - Leave processes better than you found them. Support ad-hoc projects that improve our processes and operations. Support an employee experience that is thoughtful and consistent

 


SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 2+ years in People Operations, benefits administration, global mobility coordination, or a related service-operations role.

 - Workday proficiency required, with hands-on experience managing employee data, processing employee lifecycle changes, and generating reports to support team

 - Experience managing and resolving employee inquiries through a case-tracking system or ticketing queue using platforms such as Zendesk, ServiceNow, or other systems

 - Experience creating or improving SOPs through documentation and operational reports

 - Confidence managing repeatable workflows independently, prioritizing competing requests, following through on details, and learning new workstreams as priorities change.

 - Strong service orientation and clear, empathetic written communication, with strong triage and prioritization skills

 - Comfort working with data: maintaining data accuracy, building simple metrics, and communicating findings clearly

 - Excellent attention to detail and ability to handle sensitive employee data with discretion

 - Ability to coordinate across employees, vendors, counsel, and internal partners

 - A process-improvement mindset: you notice patterns and look for ways to make support more accurate and easier to navigate




Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $53.36 - $59.61 hourly, annualized to a base salary range of $111,000 - $124,000 per year.

A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

jobs.title: Senior Customer Success Manager, Life Sciences
jobs.description:
This position is remote within the EMEA region, with the flexibility to work from our Munich or Budapest office.

Tulip brings modern technology and AI into manufacturing. Manufacturing accounts for almost 20% of the global economy and one in every seven workers on Earth, yet remains among the least digitized. More than a decade ago, we created the category to close that gap: AI-native software that puts cutting-edge tools directly in the hands of the people on the manufacturing front lines. Because we are human-centered and tech-obsessed, we are building a future of work where human ingenuity is amplified with the latest technology.

In January 2026 we became one of Boston's few new AI unicorns, reaching a $1.3B valuation. We're growing double digits in revenue year over year. The world's best manufacturers run on Tulip - turning inventory 10x faster, releasing gene therapies in hours instead of weeks, and training master craftspeople to forge engagement rings 5x more rapidly. Headquartered in Somerville, MA with offices in Germany, Hungary, Singapore, Japan, and Israel, we've been consistently named a World Economic Forum Global Innovator, a Gartner leader, and one of Built In Boston's "Best Places to Work."

We run the way we build: AI-forward, humanistic, and high ownership. We're looking for builders who are energized by complex problems, rapid cycles, and the unique opportunity to see their impact on a global scale.

About You:

  • You are customer focussed and and excited to partner with customers to identify and deliver measurable impact
  • You communicate clearly and effectively across levels, with people from the shop floor to engineering managers to c-level executives
  • You like to solve problems, working closely with colleagues from other departments
  • You have worked for or supported a Life Sciences company and understand their regulatory requirements
  • You have experience in life science development, operations and/or manufacturing environments
  • You Google your way out of most problems, and understand that every customer sees the world a bit differently

What skills do I need?

  • BA/BS (MBA/Masters preferred)
  • 5+ years of experience in Account Management, Customer Success, Product Management, Management Consulting or other client-facing roles in the Life Sciences industry 
  • Experience with change management in a GxP manufacturing and operations
  • Experience creating and leading stakeholder & executive presentations, working with enterprise corporations and multicultural business environments
  • Experience coordinating and leading actions among cross-functional teams (e.g. Sales, Product, Engineering, Marketing, Professional Services)

jobs.title: Director B2B2C Growth Partnerships
jobs.description:
Meet Urban Sports Club

We are among the leading platforms for sports and wellness in Europe, dedicated to inspiring people to live active, healthy lives. With just one membership we offer access to thousands of fitness and wellness experiences across the continent.

But what truly sets us apart? We believe our people are at the heart of everything we do. If you're curious about how we work, what we value and how you might grow with us, explore our Culture Hub & Career Opportunities.

*Big news: Wellhub and Urban Sports Club unite!*
Urban Sports Club is now a proud part of Wellhub, creating a global wellbeing ecosystem. Together, we connect 39,000 corporate clients and 97,000 wellness partners across 18 countries, offering millions of people even more ways to stay active and take care of their health.

 

The opportunity 

 

Urban Sports Club is looking for an experienced and commercially driven Director, B2B2C Growth Partnerships to establish and scale one of our most strategic growth channels across Europe.

In this role, you will define the commercial strategy and operating model for our B2B2C business, enabling Urban Sports Club's membership offering to be seamlessly integrated into partner ecosystems including banks, insurers, retailers, telcos, travel companies, loyalty programmes, marketplaces, and digital platforms.

You will own the end-to-end commercial lifecycle from identifying market opportunities and designing scalable partnership models to sourcing, negotiating, launching, and growing high-impact partnerships that generate sustainable revenue, expand our member base, and strengthen our market presence.

As the leader of this function, you will build and lead a high-performing team while working cross-functionally with Product, Growth, CRM, Brand, Finance, Legal, and Operations to launch and scale strategic partnerships. Together, you will create seamless partner experiences and establish this channel as a core driver of Urban Sports Club's long-term growth.

 

What you will do

 

  • You will define and execute the long-term European B2B2C strategy and commercial roadmap to drive sustainable business growth
  • You will build and scale strategic partnerships with leading European brands across sectors like banking, insurance, retail, travel, telecom, and digital platforms
  • You will own overall commercial performance, partnership revenue, profitability, and contributions to New Paying Members (NPM)
  • You will lead complex commercial negotiations, design scalable business models, and foster long-term executive-level partner relationships
  • You will drive the complete partner lifecycle, overseeing onboarding, activation, retention, renewals, and account expansion
  • You will partner cross-functionally with Product, Growth, CRM, Brand, Finance, Legal, and Operations to deliver seamless, scalable partner experiences
  • You will recruit, coach, and develop a high-performing partnerships team, cultivating a culture of ownership, innovation, and commercial excellence

 

What you will need to succeed

  • You bring 7+ years of leadership experience in strategic partnerships, enterprise sales, commercial strategy, or business development
  • You have a proven track record of sourcing, negotiating, and closing complex, high-value deals with C-level executives and senior decision-makers
  • You possess strong commercial acumen and experience owning revenue targets, deal structuring, pricing strategy, and partnership economics
  • You have successfully scaled partnership businesses, digital ecosystems, marketplaces, or embedded distribution channels
  • You are a strategic, data-driven thinker with a hands-on mindset who can convert analytical insights into new growth opportunities
  • You demonstrate exceptional cross-functional leadership and stakeholder management, with a history of building and coaching high-performing teams
  • You are fluent in English and possess native or near-native German language skills

 

What's in it for you 

  • Free Urban Sports Club L Pro Membership + Friends and Family Discount: Stay active with free membership, plus discounts for friends and family.
  • Flexible Work Model: Enjoy a hybrid work setup, balancing on-site and remote work options to fit your lifestyle.
  • Extended Remote Work Options: Work up to 120 days remotely within the EU, the UK, and Switzerland, including 30 days outside the EU. You'll also have the option to desk-swap at our other European offices.
  • WorkOUT Life Balance: Take advantage of 30 days of paid vacation annually, plus two additional days for volunteering, flexible working hours, and complimentary access to our mental health provider Open Up.
  • Personal Development: Receive an annual budget of €1,000 for professional growth, with regular internal training sessions and weekly German and English language classes.
  • Engaging Team Culture: Participate in regular team and company events along with wellness initiatives that help you stay productive, healthy, and engaged in a hybrid work environment.

Urban Sports Club is committed to providing a friendly, safe, and welcoming environment for everyone who applies for a position or already works with us, regardless of their sports preferences, gender, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, disability, physical appearance, body size, race, age, or religion (or lack thereof).

Everfield acquiert, développe et accompagne la croissance d’éditeurs européens de logiciels métiers et spécialisés, en leur donnant les clés pour franchir un cap. Notre mission : nourrir l’ambition, alimenter la croissance et révéler le potentiel de l’écosystème logiciel européen.

Les entreprises du groupe suivent un modèle décentralisé. Elles conservent leur équipe, leur marque et leurs bureaux, et se concentrent sur ce qu’elles font de mieux : développer leurs produits et accompagner leurs clients. Everfield les épaule sur le recrutement et les RH. Le groupe leur donne aussi accès à une équipe d’experts qui les conseille sur les enjeux financiers et opérationnels de la croissance d’un éditeur B2B SaaS européen. Depuis sa création en 2022, plus de 40 éditeurs SaaS dans 10 pays ont rejoint Everfield, qui poursuit son développement en Europe.

À propos de Synergee

Synergee est la plateforme SaaS de performance et de conformité des réseaux : franchises, coopératives et réseaux intégrés. Avec 13 modules regroupés en 2 packs, elle centralise le pilotage opérationnel, financier et réglementaire des organisations multi-points de vente. Parmi nos clients de référence : Würth, Galeries Lafayette, Krys, Kiloutou, Randstad, Geodis, Europcar, Casino, Franprix et Yves Rocher.

Pour accélérer notre croissance, nous construisons une équipe commerciale new business, opérationnelle dès 2027. Vous aurez un impact direct sur notre développement et vous participerez à l'évolution de nos méthodes de vente.

Votre mission

Vous transformez les opportunités qualifiées par nos SDR/BDR en nouveaux clients. Chaque deal vous appartient, du discovery call à la signature :

  • Mener la découverte et les démos, puis qualifier chaque opportunité avec MEDDIC

  • Échanger avec des dirigeants de réseaux et des directions qualité, opérations et franchise

  • Construire des propositions fondées sur la valeur business (ROI) et défendre votre prix

  • Négocier et piloter le closing avec les équipes juridiques et achats côté client

  • Coordonner Professional Services, Product et CSM sur les cycles complexes, puis passer le relais au CSM après la signature

  • Tenir un pipeline HubSpot fiable et un forecast honnête

  • Partager vos retours terrain pour faire évoluer notre playbook commercial

Votre profil

  • 3 à 6 ans de vente B2B SaaS, avec un historique prouvé d’atteinte de quota en new business mid-market

  • Expérience des cycles de vente longs à plusieurs décideurs (direction générale, qualité, opérations, achats)

  • Pratique concrète de MEDDIC (ou MEDDPICC) et de SPIN, pas seulement théorique

  • Capacité à vendre à la valeur : vous construisez un ROI et vous négociez sans brader

  • Rigueur CRM au quotidien (HubSpot idéalement)

  • Français courant et anglais professionnel

  • Un plus : connaissance des réseaux multi-sites, de la franchise, des coopératives, du retail ou des enjeux de conformité

Vous êtes pertinent face à des dirigeants, vous écoutez avant de pitcher et vous conjuguez autonomie en télétravail et sens du collectif. Vous annoncez tôt un deal perdu et vous faites de la fiabilité du forecast une priorité.

Ce que nous offrons

  • Un CDI cadre en full remote, parce que le talent compte plus que la localisation

  • Une rémunération fixe + variable trimestriel sur le new ARR signé, avec accélérateurs au-delà de 100 % du quota

  • Un rôle clé dans une équipe commerciale en construction, avec un vrai impact sur la croissance

  • Un process structuré (SDR/BDR en amont, CSM en aval, playbooks HubSpot) qui vous permet de vous concentrer sur la vente

  • La solidité du groupe Everfield et des perspectives d’évolution dans tout son écosystème international

jobs.description:
About Alta Ares


Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them.

Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

Founded in 2024, we have grown to 90 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development.

Role & Mission

  • Perform thermo-mechanical simulations: static, dynamic, vibration, shock, fatigue, etc.

  • Model and simulate pyrotechnic phenomena: explosions, pressure, fragmentation, and fluid–structure interaction, as required.

  • Define assumptions, models, boundary conditions, and acceptance criteria.

  • Analyze and interpret simulation results.

  • Provide recommendations for design and product improvements.

  • Correlate numerical results with experimental test data.

  • Support the planning and preparation of test campaigns.

  • Prepare calculation notes, simulation reports, and related technical documentation.

  • Contribute to the development and improvement of simulation methods and tools.

  • Ensure the traceability and quality of models and results.

Key Interfaces

  • Mechanical Design Engineering

  • Systems Engineering

  • Testing and Validation Teams

  • Manufacturing Engineering / Production

  • Quality and Configuration Management

 
 

Candidate Profile

Experience

  • Strong knowledge of structural mechanics and dynamics.

  • Knowledge of finite element analysis methods.

  • Experience with explicit simulation and rapid transient phenomena.

  • Knowledge of pyrotechnic and/or ballistic phenomena.

  • Proficiency in one or more simulation tools: LS-DYNA, Abaqus, ANSYS, or equivalent.

  • Ability to analyze complex results and translate them into technical recommendations.

  • Knowledge of mechanical testing and simulation-to-test correlation.

Skills & Qualities

  • Hands-on engineer comfortable working with hardware and testing activities

  • Able to independently drive integration and qualification campaigns

  • Rigorous approach to safety, documentation, and regulatory compliance

  • Strong cross-functional communication and coordination skills

  • Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to operate autonomously in a fast-growing company

  • High integrity and professionalism in handling sensitive defense technologies

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. We are looking for an Enterprise Account Executive to build Camunda’s Dutch Government market. This is a territory-building role for a disciplined, consultative seller who can create demand, shape strategic opportunities, and guide complex buying groups through to executive-level decisions. You will own the full sales cycle across a focused set of government accounts, from account strategy and first conversation through business case, procurement, negotiation, close, and expansion.

You will combine commercial ownership with public-sector credibility. The successful candidate will be comfortable engaging senior civil servants, CIO and transformation leaders, procurement, security, architecture, and business stakeholders. You will translate government priorities into a compelling value case for process orchestration, automation, and agentic workflows, while navigating formal procurement processes and the governance expectations of public-sector customers.

What you will own

  • Own the Dutch Government territory and create a clear account and coverage strategy across priority national and public-sector organizations.

  • Build and maintain a healthy, self-generated pipeline, targeting at least 2.5x pipeline coverage through focused outbound activity, executive engagement, partner collaboration, and market development.

  • Develop relationships across complex buying groups, including CIOs, CTOs, transformation leaders, enterprise architects, process owners, procurement, security, legal, and executive sponsors.

  • Lead the full enterprise sales cycle: discovery, qualification, value engineering, technical evaluation, business case, procurement, commercial negotiation, and close.

  • Apply MEDDICC consistently to create deal clarity, strengthen qualification, identify gaps early, and improve forecast reliability.

  • Build business cases connected to public-sector outcomes such as service quality, operational efficiency, transparency, resilience, compliance, and cost control.

  • Coordinate account teams across Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Professional Services, Marketing, Product, Legal, Finance, and leadership.

  • Expand successful customer relationships by identifying adjacent processes, departments, agencies, and use cases after the initial land.

  • Maintain accurate account, contact, opportunity, and forecast data in Salesforce as the single source of truth.

  • Share market intelligence on government priorities, procurement dynamics, competitors, partners, and customer needs to improve Camunda’s Dutch public-sector go-to-market strategy.

What success looks like

First 30 days

  • Build a working understanding of Camunda’s platform, value proposition, sales methodology, customer evidence, pricing approach, and public-sector references.

  • Align with internal stakeholders on territory priorities, account ownership, partner coverage, and available sales resources.

  • Produce an initial account segmentation and stakeholder-mapping plan for the Dutch Government territory.

  • Establish a repeatable operating cadence for pipeline creation, deal inspection, forecasting, and cross-functional account-team collaboration.

First 90 days

  • Complete strategic account plans for the highest-priority government accounts, including business priorities, buying groups, whitespace, partners, competition, and next actions.

  • Create qualified pipeline through a balanced mix of net-new opportunities, partner-sourced activity, executive introductions, and expansion plays.

  • Develop a strong network of relevant government and ecosystem stakeholders, with clear relationship and meeting objectives.

  • Demonstrate consistent MEDDICC qualification and accurate Salesforce hygiene across active opportunities.

  • Identify the most relevant public-sector use cases and value narratives for Camunda’s Dutch market development.

First 180 days and beyond

  • Establish a credible, repeatable pipeline engine for the Dutch Government market.

  • Progress strategic opportunities through well-defined qualification, value validation, technical evaluation, procurement, and commercial stages.

  • Win new government logos and create expansion paths into additional departments, agencies, or processes.

  • Build trusted relationships with executive sponsors and public-sector ecosystem partners.

  • Contribute actionable market insight that improves Camunda’s positioning, messaging, partner strategy, and investment decisions in the Netherlands.

  • Deliver against quota while protecting long-term customer value, adoption, and expansion potential.

What you will bring

Must-haves

  • 5+ years of success in a quota-carrying enterprise software or SaaS Account Executive role, owning complex deals end to end.

  • Demonstrated experience selling into the Dutch Government or another highly regulated public-sector environment, with a clear understanding of formal procurement, security, legal, and governance requirements.

  • A track record of creating pipeline through proactive outbound activity and converting multi-stakeholder opportunities into material, preferably multi-year, contracts.

  • Strong command of MEDDICC or a comparable enterprise sales methodology, with the discipline to qualify rigorously, manage mutual action plans, and forecast accurately.

  • Executive presence and communication skills in Dutch and English, with the ability to connect operational problems to strategic, financial, and citizen-impact outcomes.

  • A collaborative, customer-focused, and resilient approach aligned with Camunda’s FAITH values and global-first way of working.

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience selling process automation, workflow, orchestration, integration, business transformation, or adjacent enterprise technology.

  • Existing relationships across Dutch ministries, executive agencies, municipalities, provinces, public-service organizations, or government-focused partners.

  • Experience working with global system integrators, regional implementation partners, or public-sector framework agreements.

  • Familiarity with Camunda, BPMN, DMN, process orchestration, cloud platforms, or agentic automation.

  • Experience creating quantified value cases for service modernization, compliance, operational resilience, or cost reduction.

Why this role matters now

Dutch public-sector organizations are under pressure to modernize services, improve efficiency, operate securely, and coordinate increasingly complex technology and regulatory environments. Process orchestration gives them a way to make that complexity visible and manageable while connecting people, systems, and automation.

This role is an opportunity to shape a market rather than inherit a mature patch. You will have the ownership and visibility to define where Camunda can create the greatest public value, build the ecosystem around those opportunities, and establish a durable foundation for growth in the Netherlands.

You will join a global, distributed team that values initiative, transparency, customer impact, and practical collaboration. The role offers the chance to work at the intersection of public-sector transformation, enterprise technology, process orchestration, and the next generation of agentic automation.

  • Tu domā tehniski, bet proti arī organizēt: saplānot, vienoties, salikt uzdevumu citam cilvēkam tā, lai viņš to izpilda pareizi.

Ko piedāvājam

jobs.title: Senior FP&A Expert - Financial Task Design and Evaluation
jobs.description:
Lightly AG is a Zurich-based AI company and ETH/HSG spin-off, backed by Y Combinator and top-tier investors. Our machine learning and computer vision technology is trusted by global leaders in autonomous driving, medical imaging, and visual inspection.

We’re looking for experienced Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) professionals with strong financial modeling and analytical backgrounds to support an advanced AI evaluation project. You'll design realistic financial planning and business decision-making tasks, develop reference solutions, and evaluate AI-generated financial outputs for accuracy, completeness, and practical business relevance.

This is a remote, project-based contractor opportunity with flexible working hours.

Compensation: $400 USD per accepted task. Each task is estimated to take approximately 5–6 hours to complete, equivalent to an indicative hourly rate of $67–$80/hour. Actual earnings per hour will vary depending on the time spent completing each task. Compensation is based on successfully completed and accepted tasks, not on hours worked.

Tasks

What you'll be doing

  • Design realistic FP&A tasks and business scenarios that reflect complex, real-world financial planning, forecasting, and decision-making workflows

  • Develop financial models and reference solutions using Excel, including traceable formulas, documented assumptions, scenario analysis, and consistency checks

  • Create tasks involving core FP&A processes, such as annual budgeting, rolling forecasts, variance analysis, headcount planning, and investment decisions

  • Build and evaluate integrated financial analyses, incorporating income statements, balance sheets, cash flow forecasts, working capital, and liquidity considerations

  • Develop scenarios involving multiple sources of financial and business information, including spreadsheets, contracts, emails, and management presentations

  • Evaluate AI-generated financial models, analyses, and recommendations for technical accuracy, financial consistency, completeness, and sound business judgment

  • Identify material errors, unsupported assumptions, inconsistencies, and weaknesses in financial models or conclusions

  • Define clear evaluation criteria and acceptable outcomes, accounting for valid alternative financial approaches and reasonable assumptions

  • Write precise task instructions, reference answers, and concise executive-level explanations that accurately reflect the underlying financial analysis

  • Apply structured evaluation guidelines consistently, providing clear, evidence-based rationales for your assessments

The project focuses on developing and evaluating realistic financial tasks to assess how effectively advanced AI systems can perform complex FP&A workflows. Your role is to bring practical financial expertise to the design of challenging business scenarios and the evaluation of AI-generated outputs against professional standards.

Requirements

You're a strong candidate if you:

  • Have 5+ years of relevant professional experience in Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A), corporate finance, finance business partnering, or a closely related field, or equivalent demonstrated expertise

  • Have advanced Excel and financial modeling skills, including building, reviewing, and auditing complex financial models with transparent formulas and well-documented assumptions

  • Have hands-on experience owning or supporting financial planning processes, including operating budgets, rolling forecasts, variance analysis, headcount planning, and investment evaluations

  • Have a strong understanding of financial statements and accounting principles, including the income statement, balance sheet, cash flow, working capital, liquidity, and debt covenants

  • Are comfortable building scenario-based financial models, evaluating different business assumptions, and assessing their impact on financial performance

  • Can independently reconcile complex or conflicting financial information across spreadsheets, contracts, business documents, and management reports

  • Have strong analytical judgment and can identify material financial errors, flawed assumptions, inconsistencies, and unsupported conclusions

  • Can assess the quality and correctness of financial analyses, including recognizing valid alternative methodologies and defining clear acceptance criteria

  • Have excellent written English communication skills and can produce precise instructions, structured financial explanations, and concise executive memos

  • Have strong attention to detail and can consistently apply detailed evaluation guidelines while exercising independent professional judgment

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience in software, technology, or SaaS businesses, including ARR, retention, gross margin analysis, and subscription-based financial planning

  • Experience with financial model auditing, quality assurance, or reviewing financial deliverables prepared by others

  • Previous exposure to AI evaluation, benchmark development, or designing structured analytical assessments

  • Experience presenting financial analyses and recommendations to senior management or executive stakeholders

Benefits and Compensation

  • $400 USD per accepted task, with an estimated completion time of 5–6 hours

  • Fully remote and flexible — work from anywhere

  • Part-time contractor role with flexible hours

  • Work on the evaluation of cutting-edge AI systems tackling complex financial and business decision-making tasks

Send us your CV along with a brief note about your FP&A background, financial modeling experience, and areas of expertise. Please highlight your experience with budgeting, forecasting, financial analysis, and any relevant software or SaaS industry exposure.

If applicable, we'd also love to know about your experience building complex financial models, reviewing financial deliverables, or designing financial assessments and business cases.

We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.title: Specialpedagog till Högalidskolan åk 4-6
jobs.description: En sak är säker. Med oss gör du skillnad. Vi är läraren som får lillebror att läsa sina första ord och fritidspersonalen som skapar skratt efter skoldagens slut. Vi är barnskötare som får någon att växa varje dag och bibliotekarien som för litteraturen nära. Arbetet innebär att tillsammans med rektor utveckla och utforma det pedagogiska arbetet på såväl grupp- och individnivå som på organisationsnivå utifrån främjande, förebyggande och åtgärdande perspektiv. Du ska vara ett stöd till pedagogerna hur de kan lägga upp sin undervisning så att utbildningen blir tillgänglig, inkluderande och skapar delaktighet för alla barn.Du verkar för och är ett stöd i arbetslagens arbete, vid behov av pedagogiska kartläggningar/handlingsplaner.KVALIFIKATIONERVi söker dig som har specialpedagogexamen eller annan utbildning som av arbetsgivaren bedöms likvärdig. Som person ska du ha lätt för att kommunicera, vara relationsskapande och se utvecklingsmöjligheter hos både barn och vuxna. Du ska ha en förmåga att kunna analysera möjligheter på organisations-, grupp- och individnivå. Vi ser att du har erfarenhet av och förmåga att kunna samverka med andra och att du flexibelt kan möta olika behov i verksamheten. Du bör vara kreativ och vilja hitta lösningar där barnens bästa är i fokus. Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet.Vi vill att du bifogar examensbevis till din ansökan, samt annan information du anser vara viktig.Belastningsregister: Innan en eventuell anställning ska du visa upp ett utdrag ur belastningsregistret (där misstankeregistret ingår) i ett oöppnat kuvert. Utdraget beställs via Polisens webbplats. https://polisen.se/belastningsregistret?mtm_campaign=utdrag&mtm_kwd=post0623 Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning.Varaktighet: Tillsvidare, tillträde: Tillträde enligt överenskommelse.  Tillsvidaretjänst 100% (semestertjänst).För att arbeta hos oss ska du dela Kiruna kommuns gemensamma värdegrund där respekt, ansvar och samverkan är ledorden. Kiruna kommun ser heltid som en rättighet deltid som en möjlighet. Det är meriterande om du har kunskaper i finska, samiska och/eller meänkieli då Kiruna kommun är förvaltningsområde för dessa språk.Kiruna kommun tillämpar individuella och differentierade löner. Om du går vidare i rekryteringsprocessen kommer du att få ett för dig aktuellt lönespann presenterat vid intervjutillfället. Vi vill gärna att du läser information om våra kollektivavtal, lokala avtal och vad vi som arbetsgivare har ett erbjuda innan vi träffar dig en för eventuell intervju, de hittar du här: https://kiruna.se/naringsliv--arbete/arbeta-hos-oss/kommunen-som-arbetsgivare.htmlKiruna kommun har gjort medieval för denna rekrytering och undanber oss därför kontakt med annonssäljare eller andra säljare av rekryteringstjänster.

jobs.title: Softwarearchitekt – HMI / Automatisierungstechnik (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
Du willst nicht einfach irgendeine Code‑Rolle übernehmen. Du willst die technische Gesamtarchitektur von industriellen Bedienoberflächen bestimmen.

Hier geht es nicht um reine UI‑Entwicklung. Hier geht es um Security‑by‑Design nach IEC 62443, Skalierbarkeit und die Integration in komplexe Anlagen.

5 Jahre HMI‑Erfahrung, 2 Jahre in einer architekturverantwortlichen Position und gelegentliche Kundenreisen sind für dich Normalität.

Unser Kunde

Der Kunde ist ein mittelständisches Unternehmen im Bereich Automatisierungstechnik und Maschinenbau, das weltweit industrielle Anlagen und Steuerungssysteme liefert. Mit mehreren Standorten in der Schweiz und Europa entwickelt das Unternehmen integrierte Softwarelösungen, darunter eine einheitliche HMI‑Plattform für seine Produkte. Es positioniert sich als Innovationsführer im Bereich industrieller Bedienoberflächen.

Warum diese Rolle spannend ist

  • Technische Führungsrolle mit direktem Einfluss auf die Produktarchitektur
  • Arbeit mit Qt, QML, WinCC Unified und Web‑HMI‑Technologien
  • Verantwortung für Security nach IEC 62443 (Benutzerverwaltung, Verschlüsselung)
  • Vielfältige Industrieprojekte von Maschinen‑ bis Anlagenbau
  • Gelegentliche Kundenreisen zur Inbetriebnahme und Feldunterstützung
  • Gestaltung einer einheitlichen, wiederverwendbaren HMI‑Plattform

Deine Aufgaben

  • Entwurf, Dokumentation und Weiterentwicklung der HMI‑Softwarearchitektur (Schichten, Module, Schnittstellen)
  • Auswahl und Bewertung von HMI‑Frameworks und Tools (Qt/QML, WinCC Unified, TIA Portal, Web‑HMI)
  • Definition von Architekturprinzipien, Design‑Patterns (z. B. MVVM) und Coding‑Guidelines
  • Aufbau wiederverwendbarer Komponentenbibliotheken und Bedienbausteine
  • Konzeption der Anbindung an Steuerungen über OPC UA, Profinet, Modbus oder MQTT
  • Umsetzung von Security‑by‑Design, Rollen‑ und Rechtekonzepten nach IEC 62443
  • Fachliche Anleitung und Coaching des HMI‑Entwicklungsteams
  • Mitgestaltung von CI/CD‑Pipelines, Versionsverwaltung und Release‑Prozessen

Dein Profil

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der HMI‑ oder Embedded‑Softwareentwicklung
  • Davon mindestens 2 Jahre in einer architekturverantwortlichen oder leitenden technischen Rolle
  • Praktische Erfahrung mit C++ (modern), Qt, QML, WinCC Unified und TypeScript/JavaScript
  • Sicherer Umgang mit OPC UA, MQTT, Profinet und feldbasierten Kommunikationsprotokollen
  • Kenntnisse in Security‑Standards IEC 62443 und Erfahrung in deren Umsetzung
  • Verhandlungssichere Deutsch‑ und Englischkenntnisse (C2)

Was hier nicht funktioniert

  • Job‑Hopper – häufige Wechsel sind ein Dealbreaker
  • Nur Front‑End‑Entwickler ohne Embedded‑Erfahrung – fehlt das Systemverständnis
  • Kein Interesse an Security – du vernachlässigst IEC 62443‑Anforderungen
  • Unflexibel – keine Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Kundenreisen
  • Mangelnde Kommunikationsfähigkeit – du kannst technische Konzepte nicht verständlich vermitteln

Deine Benefits

Was diese Rolle besonders macht

  • Du bestimmst die technische Zukunft der HMI‑Plattform eines Innovationsführers
  • Du kombinierst tiefes Fachwissen mit strategischer Gestaltungskraft
  • Du arbeitest in einem internationalen Umfeld mit Projekten von Bern bis in die ganze Schweiz

Viel Verantwortung, viel Gestaltung, wenig Ausreden. Für manche ein Albtraum. Für die Richtigen: genau das, was sie suchen.

Bereit?

Dann bewirb dich jetzt als Softwarearchitekt – HMI / Automatisierungstechnik (w/m/d).

Egal ob dein Titel Lead HMI Engineer, HMI Architect, Embedded UI Architect, Senior HMI Developer heißt: Entscheidend ist nicht der Titel. Entscheidend ist, ob du mindestens fünf Jahre HMI‑Erfahrung mitbringst und Sicherheit nach IEC 62443 in der Praxis umsetzen kannst.

jobs.description:

We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new. We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new.

Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have.

Are you ready to join us?

Hi there! Thanks for stopping by 👋

Are you actively looking for a new opportunity? Or just checking the market? Well… you might just be in the right place!

We’re looking for a Sales Coordinator to join our Hospitality Sales team based in Paris. In this role, you will be responsible for reviewing and approving all new sales opportunities, along with processing software returns, and adjustments, all the while supporting the local Paris sales teams with administrative tasks post sales. You’ll need to thrive on complex problems and be a quick learner and team player to help keep this machine running.

  • Provide insight and support to members of the Sales teams for opportunity processing.

  • Review, consolidate and reconcile orders, contracts and payments. 

  • Process hardware shipments.

  • Work with customers to resolve billing and subscription inquiries.

  • Review reports to monitor and boost team efficiency and streamline daily operations. 

And a little bit of.... 

  • Ensure that sales meet financial and legal requirements.

  • Contribute to wider company initiatives, and projects outside of daily tasks.

  • Handle other duties and responsibilities as defined by management.

What you need to bring:

  • Experience in an administrative function

  • Experience in a SaaS and/or technology-related field

  • Knowledge of Mac OS X, iOS, G Suite, Salesforce, Zendesk, Slack

  • Remarkable communication skills

  • Perfect written and spoken French and English

  • Team player who works collaboratively to achieve common goals

We know that people are more than what’s on their CV. If you’re unsure that you have the right profile for the role... hit the ‘Apply’ button and give it a try!

What’s in it for you?

Come live the Lightspeed experience...

  • Ability to do your job in a truly flexible environment;

  • Genuine career opportunities in a company that’s creating new jobs everyday;

  • Work in a team big enough for growth but lean enough to make a real impact.

… and enjoy a range of benefits that’ll keep you happy, healthy and (not) hungry:

  • Lightspeed share scheme (we are all owners)

  • Pension fund

  • Axa Health insurance 

  • Health and wellness benefit of 400 EUR/year

  • Mental health online platform and counselling & coaching services

  • 25 vacation days per year

  • Paid leave and assistance for new parents

  • Volunteer day

  • Public transport benefit

To all recruitment agencies: Lightspeed does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. If we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy, Lightspeed will not be responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Lightspeed is a proud equal opportunity employer and we are committed to creating an inclusive and barrier-free workplace. Lightspeed welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

Where to from here?

Obviously, this has to be mutually beneficial: we want you to step into a role you love, and we want to offer you a place you’re proud to come to every day. For a glimpse into our world check out our career page here.

Lightspeed is building communities through commerce, and we need people from all backgrounds and lived experiences to do that. We were founded in 2005, in Montreal’s gay village and our original members were all part of the LGBTQ+ community. The ethos of our business has been about inclusion from the very beginning, and we strive to provide a workplace where everyone belongs.

Who we are:

Powering the businesses that are the backbone of the global economy, Lightspeed's one-stop commerce platform helps merchants innovate to simplify, scale, and provide exceptional customer experiences. Our cloud commerce solution transforms and unifies online and physical operations, multichannel sales, expansion to new locations, global payments, financial solutions, and connection to supplier networks.

Founded in Montréal, Canada in 2005, Lightspeed is dual-listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: LSPD) and Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: LSPD). With teams across North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific, the company serves retail, hospitality, and golf businesses in over 100 countries.

Heras is een vooraanstaand Europese totaalleverancier van permanente perimeter protection oplossingen. Wij opereren vanuit meer dan 24 landen en hebben meer dan 1100 hoogopgeleide experts in dienst. jobs.title: Senior AWS Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
At Luscii, we are creating space for care by building digital health applications that help people manage their health. Applications such as the Luscii Thuismeten app and OMRON Connect. Together with healthcare professionals around the world, we build technology that helps users receive the right care in the right place. Millions of people rely on our products every month, and behind every reliable healthcare experience is a cloud platform that simply works. As engineer working on our apps, you will play a vital role in modernising the cloud platform that powers the platform, creating a more reliable, scalable and future-proof foundation for millions of users worldwide.

OMRON Connect is one of the largest digital health platforms in our ecosystem, connecting millions of users with their healthcare data through OMRON devices. Much of the platform has grown over many years and was partly built by external partners. Today, we're investing heavily in bringing that knowledge, ownership and technical excellence in-house. This is not about replacing everything overnight. It is about making thoughtful engineering decisions, modernising step by step, and building a cloud platform that gives our engineering teams the foundations, tooling and confidence they need to deliver safely and independently.

Your work will have a direct impact on the reliability, scalability and cost-efficiency of a platform serving several million monthly active users across the world. You will help shape our cloud and engineering standards, introduce modern practices where they genuinely add value, and make Infrastructure as Code, observability and safe continuous delivery the default rather than the exception. By creating reusable infrastructure, improving developer experience and removing unnecessary complexity, you will help teams move faster without compromising reliability or security. Along the way, you will collaborate with engineers, influence technical direction and leave the platform in a significantly better state than you found it.

Your role

You will become one of the technical driving forces behind the cloud platforms that power our digital health applications. Working closely with fellow engineers, product teams and colleagues across countries, you will help shape and improve our cloud infrastructure, strengthen the developer experience and ensure reliability, security and scalability are built into the foundations of our technology. Your exact focus will evolve with the needs of our teams and the opportunities you identify to make a lasting impact.

This is a role for someone who enjoys solving difficult engineering problems without chasing complexity for complexity's sake. You will help us balance innovation with pragmatism, modernising a live healthcare platform while maintaining the stability that patients and healthcare professionals depend on every day.

What you will be doing, among others:

  • Design, build and evolve our AWS platform using Terraform as the single source of truth, while driving the gradual modernisation of our cloud landscape;

  • Build reusable infrastructure, deployment pipelines and platform tooling that enable engineering teams to ship independently and safely;

  • Introduce pragmatic cloud-native and event-driven solutions where they genuinely improve scalability, reliability and maintainability;

  • Make observability a default through standardised monitoring, logging, dashboards and alerting across the platform;

  • Improve deployment practices with automated CI/CD, progressive delivery and reliable rollback strategies;

  • Embed security, compliance and cost optimisation into the platform through automated guardrails and best practices;

  • Coach fellow engineers, review infrastructure and application code, and raise the overall cloud engineering bar through collaboration and example.

The responsibilities outlined above reflect how we currently envision this role. As we continue to grow and evolve, the scope and focus of the position may naturally change, influenced by your own ideas and insights. The way we work is built around the belief that everyone's input matters. If you see opportunities to improve the way we do things, or believe a process could be designed differently to achieve a better outcome, we encourage you to bring those ideas forward. Discuss them with your teammates, challenge the status quo, and help shape how we move forward together.

Why Luscii?

Read more about working at Luscii / OMRON and how we work as a team. Together, we are working on a mission to create space for care. Freedom, autonomy and ownership are of great importance in this. You are responsible for your own results and work according to the principles of Holacracy. Luscii is part of OMRON DH; together we built for the long term. To work on making healthcare better.

Most important benefits

  • Salary: Naturally, this depends on your background, experience, and relevant expertise. You may think of a maximum salary of approximately €86.000,- to €94.000,- per year for this position.

  • Remote-first: Work from anywhere in The Netherlands. We stay connected through monthly in-person team days called Assemblii.

  • Flexible setup: Create your own ideal workspace. Whatever works best for you - we’ve got you covered here.

The ideal candidate…

… probably doesn't exist, but if you can tick most of the checkboxes below, please apply! We are looking for someone who enjoys taking ownership of complex technical challenges, makes pragmatic engineering decisions, and is excited about helping others succeed along the way.

You know when to step up, when to involve colleagues and when to move forward decisively. Working independently does not mean working in isolation for you. You feel at ease being both a self-starter and a committed team player, contributing to shared goals while taking responsibility for your own domain. You value open communication, transparency, and mutual trust.

  • You have at least 6 years of experience building and operating large-scale cloud platforms, with deep hands-on AWS expertise and including the same amount of experience in senior-level ownership of modern cloud architectures;

  • You have extensive experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) and treat infrastructure with the same rigour as application code;

  • You have a strong understanding of cloud-native, serverless and event-driven architectures, and the judgement to apply them pragmatically;

  • You know how to build reliable production systems with observability, automated deployments and safe release practices built in;

  • You enjoy modernising legacy platforms through incremental improvements rather than big-bang rewrites, while bringing others along in the process;

  • You have strong backend engineering experience, preferably with Node.js and TypeScript;

  • You are open to working in a Holacratic organization and curious about our way of organizing work, roles, and responsibilities;

  • English is our primary language for all internal communication at Luscii, so you're fluent in that language.

Interested? Apply now!

Would you like more information? Feel free to contact our recruiter Björn Bogerd via

What does the recruitment process look like?

We organise three interviews for each vacancy. It is an extensive process, but we want to ensure that there is a good fit in regards to a potential collaboration, our culture and our way of working. All interviews are conducted online and the entire procedure is planned in advance to keep momentum.

jobs.title: Ønsker du å jobbe som kommunikasjonsrådgiver?
jobs.description:
Vil du gjøre en synlig forskjell i en kommune i utvikling? – se her:

100 % fast stilling som kommunikasjonsrådgiver

Nord-Fron kommune er midt i en spennende utviklingsperiode. Vi planlegger og bygger for framtida med nye Sundheim og ny 1–10-skole, og vi setter i gang flere store prosjekter som berører mange innbyggere. Samtidig tar vi i bruk ny teknologi og kunstig intelligens for å gi innbyggerne bedre tjenester. Da trenger vi en dyktig kommunikasjonsrådgiver som kan fortelle historiene, forklare endringene og synliggjøre kommunens aktiviteter.

Stillingen er ny og blir en del av kommunens sektorovergripende stab - et lite og tett fagmiljø med kort vei til kommunedirektøren og hennes ledergruppe.

Stillingen er i hovedsak operativ, med et tydelig strategisk ansvar. Du rapporterer til assisterende stabsleder og samarbeider med ledere og ansatte på tvers av hele organisasjonen. Du blir også en del av kommunens informasjons- og støttestab i beredskapssammenheng.

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Gi kommunikasjonsfaglige råd til ledere og ansatte.
  • Planlegge og gjennomføre kommunikasjon og innbyggerdialog i kommunens utviklingsprosjekter.
  • Delta i prosjektteam for større investeringsprosjekter, slik som «nye Sundheim» og «ny 1–10-skole».
  • Bidra i kommunens arbeid med KI og digital transformasjon, både i egen fagutøvelse og i kommunikasjonen om endringene.
  • Delta i kommunens informasjons- og støttestab og bidra i krise- og beredskapskommunikasjon.
  • Bistå organisasjonen med mediehåndtering.
  • Planlegge, produsere og publisere innhold (tekst, foto, video og grafikk) til kommunens hjemmeside, sosiale medier og intranettet.
  • Drifte og videreutvikle kommunens hjemmeside og intranett.
  • Planlegge og gjennomføre kampanjer, blant annet innen rekruttering, inkludert målrettet annonsering i sosiale medier.
  • Veilede ansatte i klarspråk og god skriftlig kommunikasjon, og bidra med språkvask.

Kvalifikasjoner

  • Høyere utdanning innen kommunikasjon, journalistikk, medier eller tilsvarende. 
  • Svært god skriftlig og muntlig formidlingsevne.
  • Erfaring med innholdsproduksjon i digitale kanaler og sosiale medier.

På grunn av arbeidsoppgavene må søkere kunne kommunisere godt på norsk, både muntlig og skriftlig.

Det er en fordel om du har

  • Erfaring med kommunikasjon i prosjekter eller saker som engasjerer og berører mange.
  • Erfaring med publiseringsverktøy for nettsider.
  • Kompetanse innen tekstproduksjon, foto, video og grafisk design.
  • Erfaring med eller interesse for bruk av KI i kommunikasjonsarbeid.
  • Førerkort klasse B.

Vi ønsker å ansette en medarbeider som

  • Er strukturert, har god gjennomføringsevne og prioriterer godt.
  • Er kreativ og ser gode historier i kommunens hverdag.
  • Kan gjøre sammensatt informasjon enkel og forståelig.
  • Møter innbyggerne med respekt og tydelighet, også i krevende saker.
  • Jobber godt både selvstendig og i team.
  • Er trygg og har god vurderingsevne, også når det står på.
  • Er nysgjerrig på ny teknologi og nye arbeidsmåter.

Personlige egenskaper for stillingen vil tillegges stor vekt.

Er du på utkikk etter nye utfordringer ved en spennende arbeidsplass? Ta gjerne kontakt om det er noe du lurer på og send oss en søknad.

Vi kan tilby

  • En spennende og utfordrende stilling i en fremtidsrettet kommune.
  • Gode muligheter for faglig og personlig utvikling.
  • Konkurransedyktige betingelser.
  • Et godt arbeidsmiljø med engasjerte kollegaer.
  • Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger.
  • Flyttegodtgjørelse.

Forutsetninger / vilkår

Arbeidstakere i Nord-Fron kommune blir ansatt på de vilkårene som til enhver tid fremgår av gjeldende lover, reglement og Hovedtariffavtalen og det blir trukket 2 % av brutto lønn til pensjon.

Arbeidsplassene i Nord-Fron kommune skal preges av mangfold og våre ansatte skal gjenspeile kommunens befolkning. Vi oppfordrer alle som er kvalifisert, uansett alder, funksjonsevne, kjønn eller etnisk bakgrunn til å søke jobb hos oss.

Unntatt offentlighet må begrunnesNord-Fron kommune praktiserer meroffentlighet, jf. Offentleglova § 11.Dette betyr at alle søkere oppføres på offentlig søkerliste. Det må foreligge særskilte omstendigheter for å få innvilget unntak jf. Offentleglova § 25.

Søknaden sendesAlle søknader på ledige stillinger skal skje via vårt elektroniske rekrutteringssystem. Søknader skal ikke sendes som e- post.Kopi av attester og vitnemål blir etterspurt ved behov.

Link til søknadsskjema: Søk her

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Nord-Fron kommune med byen Vinstra og tettstedene Kvam og Skåbu ligger i Gudbrandsdalen, midt mellom Trondheim og Oslo. Kommunen har ca. 5 600 innbyggere. Nord-Fron skal være det attraktive midtpunktet i Gudbrandsdalen og våre verdier er: SYNLIG: Gjennom åpen og aktiv tilstedeværelse viser vi hva vi står for. Vi engasjerer oss i lokalsamfunnet og Nord-Fron kommune lytter til innbyggernes behov og jobber åpent for å skape tillit og forståelse for våre beslutninger og tjenester. SAMLENDE: Vi jobber sammen for å utvikle samfunnet vårt. Vi er stolte av vår historie, kultur, natur og samfunn. Gjennom inkludering, samarbeid og fellesskap bygger vi sterke relasjoner og fremmer en kultur der alle føler seg verdsatt og hørt. Vi tror på kraften i å stå sammen og jobbe mot felles bærekraftige mål. SOLID: Vi er trygge, bærekraftige og pålitelige. Vi bygger et inkluderende samfunn basert på gjensidig respekt, langsiktig planlegging og effektiv ressursforvaltning. Dette sikrer trygghet og livskvalitet for alle innbyggere.

jobs.title: Business Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Business Systems Engineer to own the systems that turn a signed deal into a correct invoice and accurate revenue numbers. You’ll work across our go-to-market and finance stack: CRM, quoting and CPQ, billing, the data warehouse, and the integrations between them. Salesforce is one important part of that stack, not the whole job. This is an engineering role with business ownership: you’ll design how data and money move between Sales, Finance, Billing Ops, and Data teams, build the automation that keeps them in sync, and use AI to remove manual work and surface timely signals to reps and operators. You’ll partner closely with Sales, Deal Desk, Billing Ops, Revenue Accounting, and Data Engineering.

This role is based in one of San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.




WHAT YOU’LL ACHIEVE

 - The big bet: Create a reliable GTM and quote-to-cash foundation across CRM, CPQ, billing and finance systems, marketing automation infrastructure, the data warehouse, and the integrations between them.

 - By day 90, build a clear understanding of the critical data flows between GTM systems, finance systems, and the warehouse, then ship an initial improvement to a high-value integration or workflow.

 - By day 90, develop AI-powered and agent-based workflows that reduce manual work for reps, Deal Desk, and Billing Ops while improving the quality of signals available to reps and operators.

 - By the end of your first year, automate billing-critical workflows such as upgrades and prorated refunds, early renewals, true-ups, and credit deferment, with audit trails Finance can trust.

 - By the end of your first year, improve data integrity and reporting through clear data models, deduplication, validation rules, reconciliation, and monitoring—including accurate ARR, pipeline, dashboard, and forecasting infrastructure.

 - Raise the bar for how the team ships and operates: sound access, change management, and release practices; thoughtful documentation and tool decisions; reusable tests, runbooks, code review, and AI-assisted development practices.
   
   


SKILLS YOU’LL NEED TO BRING

 - Demonstrated experience in business systems engineering, GTM engineering, revenue operations, or a technical sales or marketing operations role, with the ability to own problems end to end and work effectively across functions.

 - Strong SQL skills and experience working with a data warehouse such as Snowflake or BigQuery; you design for clean, traceable data and understand how to protect its integrity across systems.

 - Experience building integrations with APIs, webhooks, event-driven services, reverse ETL, or automation platforms such as Zapier, Workato, or Tray.io http://Tray.io. Scripting in Python or JavaScript, or building serverless integrations, is a plus.

 - Familiarity with finance systems and concepts such as quote-to-cash, billing, invoicing, and revenue recognition, and the ability to work effectively with Finance and Billing Ops. Experience with an ERP such as NetSuite is a plus.

 - Hands-on Salesforce development experience with Apex, triggers, Lightning Web Components, and Salesforce automation, following the team’s development and release practices: source control, pull requests, code review, automated testing, and the deployment pipeline - is a plus.

 - Hands-on experience with Salesforce CPQ, Revenue Cloud, or a similar CPQ tool — including product and pricing data models, price books, bundles, and approval rules — is a plus.

 - Genuine curiosity about AI, with experience applying it to day-to-day work through AI-assisted development, agents, or workflow automation. Familiarity with Salesforce administration and customization—including objects, flows, permissions, and integrations—is a plus, not a requirement.

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco and NYC, the estimated base salary range for this role is $167,000 - $228,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550?pvs=74 and NYLL 144 https://notion.notion.site/Ashby-AI-Bias-Audit-2b0efdeead05803bbbfae159ec86c528.



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: DIRECTEUR D'HÔTEL - H/F
jobs.description: Description :Au sein de la franchise Best Western Plus, nous recherchons un(e) Directeur / Directrice pour notre hôtel 4 étoiles de 48 chambres, situé dans le 12e arrondissement de Paris.L'établissement fait partie du portefeuille hôtelier de Square Groupe, société d'investissement indépendante spécialisée dans le développement et la gestion d'actifs hôteliers.L'hôtel s'apprête à connaître une rénovation complète, offrant une belle opportunité de participer à la transformation de l'établissement et de contribuer à une expérience client renouvelée.En lien avec la Responsable des opérations du siège, vous assurez la gestion globale de l'hôtel, le management des équipes et le suivi de sa performance opérationnelle, commerciale et financière. VOS MISSIONS : 1. GESTION ADMINISTRATIVE * Veiller au respect des obligations réglementaires, des normes de sécurité et des procédures internes. * Superviser les achats, les commandes et le suivi des stocks. * Contrôler les bons de livraison et les factures. * Transmettre les éléments nécessaires aux services comptabilité et paie. * Assurer un reporting régulier auprès du siège.VOTRE PROFIL : * Vous justifiez idéalement d'au moins deux ans d'expérience en direction d'hôtel ou disposez d'une expérience significative en direction adjointe avec une forte autonomie opérationnelle. * Vous possédez une bonne connaissance de l'exploitation hôtelière et des standards de qualité d'un établissement 3 ou 4 étoiles. * Vous maîtrisez les fondamentaux du management, de la gestion budgétaire et du revenue management. * Vous êtes à l'aise avec les PMS, channel managers et outils de réservation. * Vous faites preuve de leadership, de rigueur, d'autonomie et d'un bon sens des priorités. * Vous avez le goût du terrain, le sens du service client et une réelle capacité à fédérer les équipes. * Vous maitrisez le français et l'angalis (oral et écrit)POURQUOI NOUS REJOINDRE? * Prendre la direction d'un établissement à taille humaine, avec une vision globale de son exploitation. * Participer à la transformation d'un hôtel grâce à un projet de rénovation complète. * Bénéfi...

jobs.title: StayinOslo søker salgskonsulenter og koordinatorer – heltid med 100 % provisjon
jobs.description:
Bor du i Oslo og vil bygge Stay in Oslo videre? Vi søker proaktive salgskonsulenter og koordinatorer til kontoret vårt. Heltid på hverdager, normalt kl. 08–16, med behov for fleksibilitet. Opplæring og PC inkludert. Lønnen er ved oppstart 100 % provisjonsbasert, uten fastlønn.

Hva vi ser etter

Vi ser etter deg som liker å ta initiativ, skape kontakt og følge opp det du setter i gang. Du motiveres av salg og resultater, samtidig som du forstår at god koordinering og fornøyde kunder er avgjørende for langsiktig vekst.

Bosted og tilgjengelighet

Vi søker kun kandidater som allerede er bosatt i Oslo, Norge. Søkere bosatt utenfor Oslo eller i utlandet er ikke aktuelle for denne stillingen. Lokal tilstedeværelse er viktig fordi rollen krever fysisk oppmøte og fleksibilitet når arbeidsmengden varierer.

Du:

• Behersker norsk og engelsk flytende, både muntlig og skriftlig, slik at du kan håndtere kundedialog, tilbud og koordinering på begge språk.

• Kan presentere produkter og tjenester på en tydelig og overbevisende måte, tilpasse budskapet til kundens behov og svare på spørsmål på norsk og engelsk.

• Er fleksibel og kan tilpasse deg kortere og lengre arbeidsdager etter avtale og innenfor avtalte rammer.

• Ønsker å vokse med selskapet og vise gjennom konkrete resultater hvordan du skaper verdi for kunder og virksomheten.

• Er proaktiv, engasjert og komfortabel med å kontakte nye kunder og følge opp salgsprosesser.

• Jobber strukturert og selvstendig, prioriterer oppgaver og holder oversikt når flere ting skjer samtidig.

• Er tillitsskapende, serviceinnstilt og tydelig i kommunikasjonen med kunder og kolleger.

• Tar ansvar, holder avtaler og bidrar til å løse utfordringer før de vokser seg store.

• Er lærevillig, tar imot tilbakemeldinger og ønsker å utvikle deg innen salg og koordinering.

• Har grunnleggende digitale ferdigheter og kan bruke PC, e-post og digitale arbeidsverktøy.

• Trives med en fullt provisjonsbasert lønnsmodell og forstår at inntekten varierer med salgsresultatene.

Erfaring fra salg, kundeservice, tilbudsarbeid eller koordinering er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Vi gir opplæring og legger vekt på motivasjon, gjennomføringsevne og vilje til å lære.

Vi ønsker søkere med ulike bakgrunner velkommen. Fortell kort om relevant erfaring, hvorfor denne rollen passer deg, og hva du kan bidra med hos Stay in Oslo.

Arbeidsoppgaver

Hos Stay in Oslo kombinerer du aktivt salg med god kundeoppfølging og praktisk koordinering. Du bidrar til å skaffe nye oppdrag og sørger for at avtaler blir fulgt opp fra første henvendelse til gjennomføring. Fordelingen mellom salg og koordinering tilpasses rollen.

Arbeidsoppgaver:

• Kontakte potensielle kunder via telefon, e-post og digitale kanaler, og følge opp innkommende henvendelser.

• Kartlegge kundens behov, presentere tjenestene våre og følge opp tilbud frem til avtale.

• Følge opp forespørsler og tilbud gjennom Mittanbud og andre salgskanaler.

• Bygge kunderelasjoner gjennom tydelig kommunikasjon, god service og pålitelig oppfølging.

• Koordinere oppdrag, avtaler og fremdrift i samarbeid med kundene og medarbeiderne som utfører arbeidet.

• Sørge for at utførende medarbeidere har nødvendig informasjon, slik at arbeidsdagen blir enklere og oppdragene gjennomføres som avtalt.

• Holde oversikt over kundehenvendelser, tilbud, avtaler og salgsaktiviteter i våre systemer.

• Bidra til bedre salgsrutiner, arbeidsflyt og utvikling av tjenestene våre.

Salget foregår fra kontoret via telefon og digitale kanaler. Stillingen innebærer ikke dørsalg.

Vi tilbyr

• Fulltidsarbeid fra kontoret, normalt mandag til fredag kl. 08.00 til 16.00. Fri lørdag og søndag. Arbeidsmengden kan variere, og vi trenger fleksibilitet for kortere og lengre arbeidsdager etter avtale. Arbeidstid, pauser og eventuell merarbeid eller overtid avklares skriftlig.

• Opplæring i tjenestene, salgsarbeidet, systemene og rutinene våre, med oppfølging underveis.

• Tilrettelagt arbeidsplass med PC og gode kontorlokaler.

• Mulighet til å påvirke egen arbeidshverdag, komme med ideer og bidra til å bygge virksomheten videre.

• En variert rolle med salg, kundekontakt, koordinering og ansvar for egen oppfølging.

Lønn og bonus

Lønnen er ved oppstart 100 % provisjonsbasert, uten fastlønn. Inntekten avhenger av salgsresultatene dine. Provisjonssats, beregningsgrunnlag, utbetalingstidspunkt og hvordan koordineringsoppgaver inngår i lønnsmodellen, avklares før ansettelse og nedfelles skriftlig. Resultatbaserte bonuser kan bli aktuelt over tid etter nærmere avtale.

Mulighet for videre utvikling og fastlønn

For deg som viser gode resultater over tid, tar ansvar og skaper verdi, kan det bli aktuelt med tilbud om fast ansettelse og en mer forutsigbar lønnsmodell med fastlønn. Dette vurderes ut fra resultater og selskapets behov og forutsetter en egen skriftlig avtale. Overgang til fastlønn er en mulighet, ikke en garanti.

Arbeidssted og omfang

Arbeidssted: Amruveien 22. Stillingen krever fysisk oppmøte på kontoret. Det er ikke mulighet for hjemmekontor ved oppstart. Vi søker først og fremst medarbeidere til heltid. Deltid kan eventuelt vurderes etter avtale.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Stay in Oslo (Stayinoslo AS) bygger videre på sine tjenester og søker engasjerte medarbeidere som vil bidra til salg, god kundeoppfølging og effektiv koordinering av oppdrag. Hos oss får du være tett på utviklingen av virksomheten og bidra med initiativ, struktur og nye ideer. Vi jobber fra kontoret og legger til rette med opplæring, PC og gode arbeidsomgivelser.

jobs.title: Junior Operations Specialist – Produktion & Backoffice (20%-40%)
jobs.description:

Du begleitest unsere Produkte durch jeden Schritt – von der Produktion bis zur Installation beim Kunden.

Die Stelle passt zu Dir, wenn Du Abwechslung magst, gerne mit Hardware und Dokumenten arbeitest und sehen möchtest, wie ein KMU hinter den Kulissen funktioniert. Du arbeitest vor Ort in unserem Büro in Zürich Altstetten.

Backoffice
