jobs.title: Förskollärare
jobs.description: 1 plats(er). Välkommen att arbeta i ett projekterande förhållningssätt på Bullerbyns förskola!Att arbeta som förskollärare innebär unika och betydelsefulla möjligheter i att vara med och bidra till barns utveckling och lärande. TILLSAMMANS och FRAMTIDSTRO är värdeord vi har tagit ställning för i den utbildning vi erbjuder barnen på förskoleenhet 5 där Bullerbyns förskola ingår.På förskoleenhet 5 arbetar vi projekterande och med pedagogisk dokumentation som förhållningssätt. Projektet tar sin utgångspunkt i enhetens gemensamma tema. Projekterandet är vårt sätt att arbeta systematiskt och ämnesövergripande.Med hjälp av verktygen observation, dokumentation och reflektion synliggör du barns inflytande och läroprocesser; enskilt och i grupp. Arbetet med en hundraspråklig pedagogisk dokumentation utgör en självklar och viktig del i det systematiska kvalitetsarbetet och i vår verksamhetsutveckling. Förskolorna i Vaggeryds kommun arbetar tillsammans med Remida som är en pedagogisk verksamhet och ett center för spillmaterial. ReMidas filosofi utgår från att materialet blir pedagogiskt i barnens händer och där kreativitet och hållbar framtid alltid ställs i relation till det som erbjuds. Remida är för oss också en arena för kollegialt lärande där pedagoger möts i olika nätverk.Bullerbyns förskola är en förskola med sex avdelningar med ett professionellt och gott arbetsklimat. Tjänsten är på en avdelning i arbete med de yngsta barnen på förskolan. Vi arbetar tillsammans och nära varandra mellan avdelningarna.KvalifikationerVi söker dig som har förskollärarexamen. Du bör ha ett intresse för pedagogisk dokumentation som förhållningssätt, erfarenhet av detta är meriterande. En god samarbetsvilja och intresse av att leka tillsammans med de yngsta barnen är viktiga förmågor som vi värdesätter högt i rekryteringen.För dig som är nyexaminerad förskollärare, erbjuder vi en mentor.Övrigt I enlighet med Skollagen krävs utdrag ur belastningsregistret före anställning. Beställ gärna detta i samband med din ansökan då polisens handläggningstid är ca 2 veckor.I denna rekryteringsprocess ingår intervjuer och referenstagning. Inför anställning behöver du visa upp utdrag ur polisens belastningsregister. Ett utslag i detta register kan komma att påverka din möjlighet till anställning hos oss.Till din intervju behöver du ha med dig pass/nationellt ID och eventuellt bevis på uppehållstillstånd om du har ett medborgarskap utanför EU/EES. Detta för att vi som arbetsgivare behöver säkerställa din identitet samt säkra att du har rätt att arbeta i SverigeTill de tjänster där det finns krav på utbildning kommer du som går vidare i rekryteringsprocessen att få lämna in underlag som styrker din utbildning, t.ex. legitimation eller examensbevis. Du kan även bifoga dem direkt i din ansökan.Om du har du skyddade personuppgifter ber vi dig att kontakta rekryterande chef, istället för att söka via vårt digitala system. Vi hjälper dig vidare på ett säkert sätt.Till dig som företräder bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag: Vi undanber oss vänligt men bestämt erbjudanden om annonserings- och rekryteringshjälp.Löneform: Månadslön.Anställningsform: Tidsbegränsad anställning.Varaktighet:, tillträde: 2026-12-02  eller enlig överenskommelse så snart som möjligt., upphör: 2027-07-18  .Omfattning: 80%Arbetstid: Dagtid.

jobs.title: Lead Mechanical / Piping Commissioning Engineer
jobs.description: The Lead Mechanical / Piping Commissioning Engineer will report to the Commissioning & Start-Up (CSU) Manager and lead the commissioning, start-up and performance testing of mechanical equipment and piping systems.The role requires extensive knowledge of static and rotating equipment, piping systems, nitrogen-helium leak testing, flange management, piping testing and associated commissioning activities. Strong technical, organisational and leadership skills are essential to manage mechanical completion, pre-commissioning, commissioning, start-up and handover in accordance with project requirements, industry standards and HSSE expectations.Key ResponsibilitiesCommissioning & Start-Up    Lead commissioning and start-up activities for mechanical equipment and piping systems, coordinating with multidisciplinary project teams.    Develop and execute commissioning plans, schedules, procedures and test requirements covering mechanical completion, pre-commissioning, commissioning and start-up.    Coordinate system readiness and commissioning priorities in line with project schedules and operational requirements.    Support plant start-up, performance testing and transition to stable operations.Mechanical & Piping Technical Leadership    Provide technical leadership for static and rotating equipment and associated piping systems.    Oversee nitrogen-helium leak testing, flange management, piping integrity testing and other pre-commissioning activities.    Ensure mechanical and piping systems comply with approved engineering specifications, relevant standards and project requirements.    Review system configuration, piping arrangements, test requirements and commissioning documentation.    Provide technical guidance to commissioning engineers, contractors and vendor representatives.Testing & Inspection    Oversee testing and inspection of mechanical equipment and piping systems to verify integrity, functionality and readiness.    Ensure piping test packages, leak testing and mechanical inspection activities are completed and documented.    Verify completion of required inspections and tests prior to system energisation, introduction of process media or start-up.    Monitor deficiencies and ensure outstanding items are addressed before handover.Troubleshooting & Issue Resolution    Identify and resolve mechanical and piping issues encountered during pre-commissioning and commissioning.    Work with engineering, construction, vendors and operations teams to investigate faults and implement appropriate solutions.    Identify technical constraints affecting system readiness and escalate critical issues where required.Documentation & Handover    Maintain accurate commissioning records, including test results, checklists, punch lists and relevant as-built documentation.    Ensure commissioning documentation and completion evidence are accurate, traceable and ready for handover.    Manage punch-list close-out and support system walkdowns and acceptance activities.    Support final system handover to operations.Performance Testing    Lead mechanical and piping aspects of plant performance testing.    Verify systems and equipment meet defined performance and operational criteria.    Support optimisation and corrective activities identified during start-up and performance testing.HSSE & Compliance    Ensure commissioning activities comply with project HSSE requirements, industry standards and applicable regulations.    Promote safe working practices and a strong safety culture throughout mechanical and piping commissioning.    Ensure appropriate controls are applied to pressure testing, leak testing and other high-risk commissioning activities.Stakeholder & Team Coordination    Collaborate with the CSU Manager, engineering, construction, operations, vendors, contractors and other commissioning disciplines.    Coordinate commissioning interfaces and ensure activities align with overall project objectives and schedules.    Provide leadership, technical guidance and mentoring to commissioning personnel.    Identify opportunities to improve commissioning methods, system readiness and execution efficiency.Technical Skills    Extensive knowledge of static and rotating mechanical equipment and piping systems.    Strong expertise in nitrogen-helium leak testing, flange management and piping integrity testing.    Knowledge of mechanical completion, pre-commissioning, commissioning, start-up and performance testing.    Strong understanding of relevant ASME, ANSI and API standards.    Experience with piping and commissioning systems/software; SmartPlant or Hexagon experience is advantageous.    Strong planning, scheduling, resource management and project coordination capability.    API 570, ASME B31.3 or other relevant mechanical/piping certification is advantageous.    Strong troubleshooting and technical problem-solving skills.Qualifications & Experience    Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.    Minimum 10 years' experience commissioning mechanical equipment and piping systems within major industrial projects.    Demonstrable experience with static and rotating equipment, piping systems, mechanical completion and commissioning.    Proven expertise in leak testing, flange management, piping testing, pre-commissioning, start-up and plant performance testing.    Strong knowledge of industry standards and regulatory requirements applicable to mechanical and piping systems.    Ability to lead commissioning activities within complex, fast-paced project environments.    Strong communication, leadership and stakeholder-management skills.    Proficiency with relevant commissioning systems and software.    Green hydrogen and/or green steel experience is advantageous.    Project management experience or qualifications are advantageous.    Fluent English required; Swedish language skills are advantageous but not essential.

jobs.title: Vil du være med å videreutvikle Nye Bybo som nå drifter på enkeltkjøpsavtaler?
jobs.description:
Kirkens Bymisjon jobber for å avdekke urett, lindre nød og påvirke årsakene til at nød og urett oppstår. Som ansatt må du kunne slutte deg til visjonen vår om at alle mennesker erfarer respekt, rettferdighet og omsorg uavhengig av livssituasjon, livssyn eller kulturell bakgrunn. 

Nye Bybo tilbyr boliger i Oslo for mennesker som av ulike grunner er vanskeligstilte på boligmarkedet og som har utfordringer med å bo. Beboerne har ulike behov, men de fleste har til felles at de har erfart bostedløshet over lengre tid, og har utfordringer knyttet til rusavhengighet og/eller psykiske helseutfordringer. Faglig har vi sterkt fokus på stabilisering gjennom et langsiktig boligperspektiv, med vanlige husleiekontrakter, helhetsperspektiv og stor vekt på relasjonsarbeid og praktisk tilrettelegging. Dette skjer i tett samarbeid med våre oppdragsgivere. Nye Bybo har 21 leiligheter fordelt på to adresser, Pilestredet 30 og Thaulows vei 4.

Ønsker du en variert og meningsfull stilling hvor du får kombinere miljøterapeutisk arbeid, koordinering, samarbeid med oppdragsgivere og utvikling av tjenestetilbudet? Da kan dette være stillingen for deg.

Vi søker en miljøterapeut til en fast 100 % stilling i turnus med arbeid dag/kveld og for tiden hver 4. helg.

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Være kontaktperson for en gruppe beboere og sikre helhetlig oppfølging gjennom kartlegging, mål- og tiltaksarbeid, koordinering av ansvarsgrupper og samarbeid med oppdragsgivere, pårørende og øvrig nettverk.
  • Ivareta delegerte administrative og driftsrelaterte oppgaver.
  • Bidra til vurdering og inntak av nye beboere.
  • Planlegge, tilrettelegge og gjennomføre aktiviteter på individ- og gruppenivå.
  • Delta i praktiske oppgaver sammen med beboerne for å fremme relasjoner, mestring og selvstendighet.
  • Bidra til utvikling og oppfølging av aktivitetstilbud, inkludert søknader, rapportering og dokumentasjon knyttet til aktuelle tilskuddsordninger.
  • Bidra med rapportering og dokumentasjon overfor oppdragsgivere, sertifiseringsordninger og øvrige relevante instanser.
  • Bidra til dokumentasjon av virksomhetsdriften, herunder kostnadsoppfølging, samt samarbeid med interne støttefunksjoner som økonomi, regnskap, eiendom og øvrige fagmiljøer.
  • Samarbeide med og bidra til koordinering av frivillige knyttet til virksomheten.
  • Bidra til kvalitetsutvikling, brukermedvirkning og kontinuerlig forbedringsarbeid.
  • Delta i virksomhetens møtestruktur, rapportering og daglige organisering.
  • Bidra til et godt fagmiljø gjennom kollegastøtte, veiledning og erfaringsdeling.

Vi ser etter deg som

  • Har relevant treårig høyskoleutdanning innen helse-, sosial- eller velferdsfag.
  • Har erfaring fra rus- og psykisk helsearbeid og oppfølging av mennesker i eget hjem.
  • Trives med tverrfaglig samarbeid og har evne til å bygge gode relasjoner med beboere, pårørende, oppdragsgivere og samarbeidspartnere.
  • Har erfaring med koordinering, brukermedvirkning, kvalitets- og forbedringsarbeid, eller ønsker å videreutvikle deg innen disse områdene.
  • Har god digital kompetanse og kommuniserer godt både muntlig og skriftlig.
  • Er strukturert, selvstendig og samtidig en lagspiller som bidrar til et godt fagmiljø.

Personlig egnethet vil bli vektlagt.

Vi kan tilby

  • Spennende arbeidshverdag
  • Jobb i en verdibasert organisasjon
  • Faglig dyktige kollegaer
  • En engasjert og mangfoldig arbeidsgruppe
  • Systematisk opplæring i digital kompetanse
  • Lønn og ansettelse i henhold til tariffavtale
  • God pensjonsordning, Storebrand Hybridordning

Kirkens Bymisjon er en livssynsåpen organisasjon som verdsetter mangfold og like muligheter, og oppfordrer kvalifiserte kandidater, uavhengig av bakgrunn, til å søke.

Alle søknader må sendes inn elektronisk gjennom rekrutteringsportalen.

(Ønsker ikke kontakt med telefonselgere).

Kirkens Bymisjon - Om oss

Link til søknadsskjema: Søk her

Kirkens Bymisjon er en ideell, diakonal organisasjon. Vi er til stede i mer enn 50 byer og tettsteder i Norge, og har ca. 2400 ansatte og mer enn 4000 frivillige på landsbasis. jobs.title: Project Engineer DRP
jobs.description: Research shows that women and other under-represented groups within our industry hesitate to apply unless they tick most boxes of a role description. At Stegra, we are building an impact company with sustainability at its core. We need a diverse, inclusive, and authentic team to rally behind our purpose of de-carbonizing hard-to-abate industries, starting with steel.So, if you are equally passionate about our purpose yet concerned that your experience doesn’t perfectly align with the qualifications stated in the job advert, we strongly encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate, either for this role – or for another upcoming role in our rapidly growing business.About us:Stegra is on a mission to disrupt the global steel industry by producing green steel, with the end goal of bringing down CO2 emissions to zero. By using green hydrogen and fossil-free electricity instead of coal; water and heat will be our primary emissions. By 2030, our ambition is to produce 5 million tonnes of green steel annually in our fully integrated, digitalized, and sustainable plant in Boden, located in northern Sweden - currently in construction phase. But this is just the beginning – our expertise in green hydrogen will enable us to decarbonize other industries in addition to steel, and we look forward to what’s next in store for us.We are looking for talented, innovative, and purpose-driven people to join our rapidly growing and diverse team. Our employees get to learn everyday, implement the latest technology and test and put their ideas into practice. Together, we are building an impact company with sustainability at its core – for our people, customers, investors, society, and planet.Work location: BodenWhat you’ll doRight now, we are looking for a Project Engineer for our Project Delivery team. In this role you will work closely with our Groundworks Manager, Construction teams, EPCM Area Leads, planners, and contractors to support the delivery of civil and early works across the Boden project.As Project Engineer, you will help turn engineering packages into construction-ready scopes. You will coordinate documentation, interfaces, and execution requirements to ensure workfronts are properly prepared before being released to contractors. This is a hands-on role suited to someone who enjoys working close to both engineering and site execution.Specific to this role, the day-to-day tasks will include the following but as we are a growing company with very little silos between teams, other tasks might be included as well.    Coordinate preparation and release of groundworks scopes, ensuring drawings, quantities, and execution requirements are ready for construction    Maintain the Groundworks Scope Tracker and consolidate inputs from EPCM partners, design teams, and planners    Support forecasting and planning of upcoming groundworks activities    Coordinate scope clarifications between Engineering, Planning, Construction, and contractors    Support and maintain a structured RFI process between contractors and engineering stakeholders    Help align groundworks activities with project schedules, civil milestones, and interface dependencies    Participate in coordination meetings and support progress reporting and issue resolution    Monitor contractor readiness, access conditions, and documentation prior to site executionWhat you’ll bringYou’re curious and believe that real progress happens when we work together. You’re not afraid to challenge old ways of thinking and you treat others with respect while doing it. At Stegra, we value people who take initiative, build trust, and help create a workplace where everyone can do their best.This role is well suited to someone who has built a solid foundation in civil engineering or construction and wants to continue developing in a large-scale industrial project environment.Specific to this role, we would like to see that you can tick off a fair amount of the boxes below    Degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or a related technical field    Around 3–7 years of experience from large-scale industrial, construction, or infrastructure projects    Good understanding of civil construction, design documentation, and site execution    Experience working in EPCM, contractor, or major project environments is considered an advantage    Strong coordination skills and the ability to work across multiple teams and disciplines    Familiarity with Primavera P6 or similar planning tools is considered an advantage    Experience with Swedish AMA/AB04 standards is considered a plus    Fluency in English; Swedish is considered an advantage

jobs.title: Mates and Masters to the Fleet Department
jobs.description: Are you our new team member?Our Fleet Department is growing! We are looking for Mates and Masters who want to be part of a close-knit team on board our survey vessels, delivering survey operations across Europe.About us:Njord Survey was founded in 2015 with a clear ambition: to challenge how offshore surveys are delivered. By combining state-of-the-art technology with innovative thinking, we deliver high-quality hydrographic and geophysical surveys more efficiently, for navigation, dredging, charting, marine construction for renewable energy and more.We are in an exciting phase of growth, now with more than 120 dedicated employees delivering tailored solutions to meet each project’s and client’s needs.Scope of work:At Njord Survey, we use state-of-the-art technology to operate efficient survey vessels with a lower environmental footprint. Our vessels typically carry a crew of 2 to 8 people, depending on vessel size and project, which allows us to stay flexible and adapt quickly to our clients’ needs. Data is collected on board and processed by our onshore team at the Gothenburg office.On board, we work as one team. The vessel operates independently in planning and executing survey operations, in close collaboration with the office and our onshore processing team. Together, the crew is responsible for the safe navigation, operation and maintenance of the vessel, including onboard planning, procurement, inventory and reporting to project management. On some vessels there is no dedicated engineer, so everyone contributes where needed. We are constantly developing how we operate, and your experience and ideas are part of that.Masters carry overall responsibility for the vessel, crew and safety, while Mates support the Master and take operational responsibility during assigned watches. Both work closely with the survey team on board to ensure high-quality data acquisition.Learn more about what it's like to work at Njord Survey from our colleague Axel here!Who we are looking for:You thrive in small teams and understand that it is the team that makes the vessel work. You enjoy new challenges, are comfortable adapting when plans change, and are always ready to lend a hand where it is needed. You have an interest in technology, and experience from smaller vessels is an advantage.The organisational language is English, so you need professional proficiency in both spoken and written English.Requirements and merits:For applicants applying as Master:Requirements:    EU/EEA citizenship and residency in Sweden    B driving licence    Medical certificate, ENG1 or equivalent    Basic safety STCW    Restricted Operator’s Certificate (ROC)    Medical Care STCW VI/4.2    Deck Officer Class I (Master Mariner), or RYA/MCA and/or M200GT    Electronic Chart Display and Information System (ECDIS)Merits:    General Operator’s Certificate (GOC)For applicants applying as Mate:Requirements:    EU/EEA citizenship and residency in Sweden    B driving licence    Medical certificate, ENG1 or equivalent    Basic safety STCW    Restricted Operator’s Certificate (ROC)    Deck Officer Class V / VI or M200GT or RYA/MCA Master of yacht Limited    Electronic Chart Display and Information System (ECDIS)Merits:    General Operator’s Certificate (GOC)Location: OffshoreWorking time: 2 weeks of work followed by 4 weeks off from work, with 12-hours workdaysOur offers to you:We offer a workplace for you to grow and to stay. At Njord Survey you become part of an experienced team who have fun together and build on each other’s ideas. We invest in our personnel and believe that competence development should be a combination of gained experience from diverse projects together with courses, workshops and activities.We offer a wide range of employee benefits such as a wellness benefit of 5000 SEK/year, private medical insurance, access to our personnel benefit’s portal, team activities and more.Our recruitment process:The recruitment process consists of several evaluation steps to ensure a qualitative process. First a phone interview for us to learn more about your ambitions and for you to get to know Njord Survey and our offers better, followed by online tests and a competence-based interview with the department manager. The aim of the process is for you to learn about the content of the role and for us to evaluate if you have the right profile for the position. You can read more about our recruitment process at the career page here.Feel free to hand in your application in Swedish or English.The application will be open until the 15th of November 2026Candidate selection is ongoing, please hand in your application as soon as possible.We are looking forward reading your application!We kindly ask to not be contacted for external recruitment services.The company is covered by the collective agreement Utveckling & Tjänster. A local trade union representing Sveriges Ingenjörer/Saco can be contacted at saco@njordsurvey.se.

jobs.title: Electrical & Automation Commissioning Engineer
jobs.description: We are seeking an experienced Electrical & Automation Commissioning Engineer to support the commissioning of a prototype hydrogen-to-green steel plant in Boden, Sweden.The role requires strong engineering and commissioning experience across LV/MV/HV distribution systems, transformers, switchgear, drives and steel plant equipment, covering installation through cold and hot commissioning. The successful candidate will combine strong electrical technical knowledge with an understanding of steelmaking processes, systemisation and completions management.Key ResponsibilitiesCommissioning & Installation    Oversee installation, testing, commissioning and start-up of electrical and automation systems.    Execute commissioning of LV/MV/HV distribution systems, transformers, switchboards, motors, variable speed drives, overhead cranes and associated equipment.    Develop and execute commissioning plans, procedures and test scripts.    Conduct cold and hot commissioning of steel plant equipment in accordance with project specifications, safety requirements and schedules.    Verify installation, functionality and readiness of electrical equipment before energisation and operation.    Identify and resolve commissioning issues, ensuring effective technical close-out.Electrical Systems    Apply European electrical standards and specifications covering LV/MV/HV systems, switchgear, cables, underground cabling, overhead lines, wiring, electrical safety, earthing and grounding.    Execute and validate electrical protection systems, including protection relays, protection coordination and transformer differential protection.    Conduct testing, calibration and troubleshooting of protection relays and electrical equipment.    Ensure earthing and grounding systems are correctly installed, tested and compliant with applicable requirements.Engineering & Design    Provide technical input during engineering and design to optimise systems for commissioning, operation and maintainability.    Review electrical drawings, specifications and technical documentation.    Identify and resolve design or installation issues that could impact commissioning.    Apply knowledge of relevant requirements for electrical equipment installed in hazardous areas.Process Knowledge & Systemisation    Apply knowledge of steelmaking processes to support effective equipment and system commissioning.    Support systemisation of the plant, including boundary drawings and definition of systems and subsystems.    Use Completions Management Systems to track, verify and report commissioning and completion progress.    Coordinate system readiness and ensure electrical interfaces are aligned with mechanical, instrumentation, automation and process requirements.Completions, Handover & Documentation    Prepare and manage Inspection and Test Records (ITRs), ensuring required testing is completed and signed off.    Lead and participate in system walkdowns and punch-list management.    Ensure deficiencies are identified, tracked and resolved before system handover.    Maintain accurate commissioning records, test documentation and completion evidence.    Support safe and efficient handover of completed systems to operations.Collaboration & Reporting    Work with engineering teams, contractors, equipment vendors and suppliers to ensure activities align with project priorities.    Coordinate with mechanical, process, instrumentation and automation disciplines to enable integrated commissioning.    Provide technical reports and commissioning progress updates to project stakeholders.    Support resolution of technical and interface issues affecting commissioning progress.Health, Safety & Compliance    Maintain a strong safety focus throughout installation, energisation, testing and commissioning.    Ensure activities comply with applicable electrical codes, standards, project specifications and local requirements.    Promote safe commissioning practices and effective risk management.Key Requirements    Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience.    Extensive experience in electrical commissioning within steel plants or comparable heavy industrial environments.    Proven cold and hot commissioning experience.    Strong understanding of the steelmaking process and industrial electrical systems.    In-depth knowledge of LV/MV/HV distribution systems, motors, transformers and switchgear.    Experience with HV/MV variable speed drives and overhead cranes.    Strong knowledge of electrical protection systems, protection relays, protection coordination and transformer differential protection.    Strong knowledge of earthing and grounding systems.    Knowledge of electrical equipment requirements for hazardous areas.    Experience with plant systemisation, boundary drawings and system/subsystem definition.    Strong knowledge of Completions Management Systems, ITRs, walkdowns, punch lists and system handover.    Strong troubleshooting, analytical and problem-solving capability.    Ability to work effectively with multidisciplinary teams, contractors, suppliers and stakeholders.    Proficiency with relevant commissioning, reporting and completions management software.    Strong understanding of electrical safety standards and regulatory requirements.Advantageous Experience    Certification or training relating to HV/MV systems, electrical protection or completions management.    Experience with hydrogen, green steel or other large-scale energy transition projects.    Familiarity with Swedish electrical standards and industrial regulations.    Previous experience commissioning complex steelmaking or process plant facilities.LocationThis is a site-based position in Boden, Sweden, working within a fast-paced project environment through installation, commissioning and system handover.The successful candidate will combine strong hands-on commissioning capability with electrical engineering expertise, systemisation knowledge and an understanding of steel plant operations.What I changed: I removed duplicated requirements, stripped out the HTML, combined related responsibilities, and retained the important candidate-search keywords including LV/MV/HV, switchgear, transformers, VSDs, protection relays, cold/hot commissioning, ITRs, systemisation, completions management, steelmaking and hazardous areas.

jobs.title: Cafe Flottenheimer is looking for a Floor Manager
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about hospitality, quality service, and effective restaurant teamwork? Cafe Flottenheimer is seeking a dedicated and experienced Floor Manager to lead our waiting team and help ensure our guests enjoy an exceptional dining experience every day.

 

About the Role

As Floor Manager at Cafe Flottenheimer, you will coordinate daily front-of-house operations, combining hands-on waiting duties with supervision of the service team. You will work closely with the kitchen to maintain smooth service, a welcoming atmosphere, and consistent standards of guest care.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Welcome guests, take orders, and serve food and beverages

  • Coordinate daily service, allocate sections, and organize waiting staff duties

  • Brief, guide, and train waiting staff to maintain service standards

  • Coordinate orders and service timing with the kitchen team

  • Monitor beverage stocks, arrange replenishment, and minimize waste

  • Handle reservations, guest enquiries, and complaints professionally

  • Oversee payments, opening and closing routines, and dining-area cleanliness

 

Working Conditions

  • Full-time position

  • Work in a guest-facing restaurant environment, outside the kitchen

  • Working hours may include mornings, evenings, weekends, and public holidays

  • Responsibility for maintaining service, hygiene, safety, and operational standards throughout each shift

 

We Expect

  • Solid experience as a Floor Manager, Head Waiter, or in a similar supervisory service role

  • Strong leadership and communication skills, including the ability to coordinate a busy team

  • Knowledge of beverage service, stock control, and payment systems

  • Passion for hospitality and delivering attentive, professional guest service

 

We Offer

  • An exciting and welcoming workplace

  • Salary based on qualifications

  • Opportunity to influence service routines and the development of the waiting team

  • A committed team and professional work environment

 

Sounds interesting? Send your application and CV to info@cafeflottenheimer.dk and become part of Cafe Flottenheimer. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, and the position is available as soon as possible.

The application deadline is 16 November 2026. We look forward to hearing from you.

Aktiv ungdom søker tålmodig og engasjert BPA-assistent
jobs.description:
📍 Arbeidsgiver: Mio BPA📅 Tiltredelse: Snarest📌 Stillingstype: Tilkallingsvikarer, med mulighet for fast⏰ Arbeidstid: Primært ettermiddag/kveld, og helg

Hei! 😊

Jeg er en aktiv og livlig gutt på 15 år som går siste året på ungdomsskolen. Jeg bor landlig til i Trøgstad sammen med familien min. På fritiden elsker jeg å være på farten, utforske nye steder og bade! Bading er favorittaktiviteten min, så det er viktig at du er en trygg og god svømmer. Jeg er kreativ, leken og har mye fantasi, så du må tørre å by på deg selv og være aktiv i lek og aktiviteter. Jeg liker også gaming, trampolineparker, lekeland og jeg elsker å kaste steiner i vannet. Jeg liker også alt som har hjul og har tidligere vært aktiv i motorsport. Det er også viktig at du er trygg på å kjøre bil, siden vi ofte vil være på farten og dra til steder jeg liker. Vi har ATV hjemme, så kanskje vi kan kjøre en tur?

Jeg har spesielle behov og kan til tider ha utfordringer med regulering av følelser og reaksjoner. Derfor trenger jeg mennesker rundt meg som klarer å bevare roen, skape trygghet og stå stødig i utfordrende situasjoner. Jeg ser derfor etter en tålmodig og forståelsesfull assistent som kan bidra til at jeg får en trygg og meningsfull hverdag. Som BPA-assistent vil du veilede og støtte meg i daglige gjøremål, sosial deltakelse og utvikling av ferdigheter som gir meg større selvstendighet.

Stilling og arbeidstid

Jeg søker etter to tilkallingsvikarer som kan stille opp ved behov når det skulle være sykdom, ferieavvikling eller annet behov. Arbeidstiden vil i hovedsak være fra jeg kommer hjem fra skolen rundt kl.15.30 til kl.21.30 i ukedager, fleksible vakter lørdag og søndag. Du er også være tilkallingsvikar som avlaster (at jeg er på besøk hos deg fra fredag etter skoletid til søndag kveld).

På grunn av stillingens natur oppfordres menn til å søke.

Arbeidsoppgaver:

  • Være med meg i hverdagen hjemme og på aktiviteter

  • Være en trygg person som støtter og veileder ved behov

  • Bidra til gode opplevelser

  • Kjøre bil

  • Praktisk hjelp i hjemmet og i aktiviteter

Personlige egenskaper

  • Rolig og trygg i krevende situasjoner

  • Tålmodig og omsorgsfull

  • Initiativrik og selvgående

  • Fleksibel og løsningsorientert

  • Liker å jobbe med ungdom

  • Gir av seg selv og bygger gode relasjoner

Kvalifikasjoner

  • Plettfri politiattest

  • Gode norskkunnskaper

  • Førerkort klasse B

  • Egen bil

  • Erfaring med ungdom er en fordel

  • Personlig egnethet og kjemi vektlegges

Høres dette ut som en jobb for deg? Da håper jeg du sender inn en søknad. Kanskje er akkurat du den assistenten jeg leter etter! 😊

Ved spørsmål angående stillingen, kontakt rekrutterer Karen Tonette Bulæg på epost karen.bulag@mio.no. Søknader sendes inn via eget søknadsskjema.

Vi tilbyr:

  • En meningsfylt jobb

  • Erfaring fra helse- og omsorgssektoren

  • Lønn etter tariff: Timelønn 236,49,-, kveldstillegg på 67,- og helgetillegg på 70,-

  • Teoretisk og praktisk opplæring, i tillegg til relevante kurs

  • Fordelsportal med rabattavtaler på blant annet hotell, hvitevarer, nettbutikker etc.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Mio BPA er en av Norges største BPA-leverandører. Vi har lang og bred erfaring, og leverer tjenester i over 150 norske kommuner. Vi har som mål å levere Norges beste BPA-tjenester, og tilbyr skreddersydde BPA-løsninger i henhold til den enkeltes behov. Det er viktig for oss å kunne gi våre kunder den aller beste tjenesten og at vi er den beste arbeidsplassen for våre medarbeidere. Mio BPA er en del av Mio-konsernet som er 100 prosent norskeid.

Vi jobber alltid ut ifra disse verdiene:

• Respektfull: Vi er åpne og møter andre med vennlighet og forståelse. Alle vi møter skal føle seg sett, anerkjent for den de er og verdifulle.

• Pålitelig: Vi er til å stole på og holder det vi lover. Vi opptrer på en måte som gir tillit og trygghet.

• Modig: Vi utgjør en forskjell for hvert enkelt menneske vi møter. Vi gir mennesker et bedre liv og frihet til å leve slik de vil.

jobs.title: Kok søges til Restaurant Rimini – vi har brug for flere hænder i køkkenet! - Chef Wanted at Restaurant Rimini – Join Our Kitchen Team!
jobs.description:

● Relevant higher education (Bachelor's or Master's degree) in economics, business administration, international trade, finance, or a related field.

● In-depth understanding of the Norwegian business landscape, regulatory framework, and economic environment.

● Strong interest in international trade and fostering bilateral economic relations.

Personal Characteristics

● Proactive, independent, and self-driven with a strong sense of initiative.

● Excellent interpersonal and networking skills, with the ability to build and maintain professional relationships.

● Solution-minded and commercially oriented.

● Analytical mindset with the ability to manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced diplomatic environment.

Vous êtes kinésithérapeute, mais vous avez envie de faire plus que d'enchaîner des séances individuelles ?

Vous aimez travailler avec les personnes âgées, chercher ce qui les fait encore bouger, marcher, participer et prendre plaisir à utiliser leurs capacités ?

Les troubles cognitifs vous intéressent et vous pensez que la mobilité peut aussi se travailler par le jeu, la musique, les activités quotidiennes, les parcours, la marche ou le mouvement en groupe ?

Votre profil nous intéresse.

Alegria développe actuellement une nouvelle organisation paramédicale et renforce en particulier son projet d'accompagnement des personnes vivant avec des troubles cognitifs.

Nous recherchons un(e) kinésithérapeute qui souhaite combiner une pratique clinique rigoureuse avec une implication plus large dans la mobilité, la prévention et notre projet démence.

Votre mission de kinésithérapeute

Vous disposez de votre propre portefeuille de résidents et êtes responsable de la qualité de leur suivi :

  • bilans fonctionnels ;

  • objectifs thérapeutiques individualisés et réévalués ;

  • travail de la marche, de l'équilibre, des transferts, de la force et de l'endurance ;

  • prévention des chutes et du déconditionnement ;

  • maintien de l'autonomie ;

  • suivi des prescriptions ;

  • documentation rigoureuse des prises en charge.

La qualité clinique et la tenue du dossier font pleinement partie du travail thérapeutique.

Une seconde casquette : mobilité & démence

Une partie de votre temps pourra être consacrée au développement d'approches adaptées aux personnes vivant avec des troubles cognitifs.

Nous voulons notamment développer :

  • des groupes de mobilité adaptés ;

  • des parcours moteurs et activités d'équilibre ;

  • la marche accompagnée ;

  • le mouvement associé à la musique ou au jeu ;

  • des activités motrices intégrées à la vie quotidienne ;

  • la prévention des chutes ;

Vous contribuerez également, avec la psychologue, l'éducatrice spécialisée, la psychomotricienne, les équipes de soins et les autres paramédicaux, à faire évoluer le projet démence d'Alegria.

Nous cherchons donc volontiers un kinésithérapeute qui possède une vraie fibre d'animation et de créativité, sans perdre la rigueur clinique propre à son métier.

Votre profilVotre profil

constitue un réel atout.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager - Data Integration
jobs.description: A provider changes their API without warning. Your team catches it before a single customer notices. And the only feedback you get is a question about why the next integration is taking so long.If that sounds familiar, we should talk.At Anyfin, we're looking for an Engineering Manager who doesn't just keep the integrations running, but builds the team and the platform that make the next one easier. Someone who can lead people, set technical direction and still be useful in a pull request.The foundation is built. Now it needs to scale.Anyfin helps people refinance expensive consumer credit on better terms. Since 2017 we've helped people across Sweden, Finland and Germany take back control of their finances. We're profitable, we have a banking licence that lets us operate across the EU, and we're getting ready to launch new products and enter new markets. Our ambition is to be a pan-European company by 2030.Almost every one of those steps starts with an integration. A new market means new credit bureaus, banks and payment providers, each with its own formats, quirks and opinions about uptime.The team is small and intentionally so. We'd rather grow what each engineer can do than how many engineers we have.The actual jobYou'll lead a small team of engineers building and running the integrations that connect Anyfin to the outside world. You'll own how the team works, what it builds next and how good it gets at it. You'll report to our CTO.You'll build the team. Hiring, onboarding, 1:1s, feedback and growth. You'll help each engineer get better at what they do and make the team stronger than the sum of its parts.You'll make integration repeatable. The first integration in a new market shouldn't feel like the first integration ever. You'll shape the patterns, tooling and data contracts that turn each new provider from a project into a routine.You'll own reliability. When an integration fails, a credit decision or a payout can fail with it. You'll make sure the team knows first, fixes fast and learns something each time.You'll stay close to the code. This is a hands-on role. You'll review, pair, design and build alongside the team, because good technical leadership needs proximity.You'll balance speed and quality. Regulated lending doesn't forgive sloppy systems, but it doesn't reward over-engineering either. You'll know the difference and help the team know it too.You'll work across the business. Product, credit, data and operations all depend on the data your team brings in. You'll shape priorities with them, not just receive them.Leading a team that builds with AIAI isn't a side tool here. It's built into how we work across engineering, analytics, operations and product, and our tech team has built an AI-connected data and code environment on frontier models.Integration work is a good place to see the difference. Reading provider documentation, mapping schemas, writing tests and investigating odd payloads are exactly the kind of work AI can speed up. But the data you bring in increasingly feeds systems that act on it without questioning it.Part of this role is working out how to lead in that world. Not by mandating tools, but by helping the team get better with them, and being honest about where they don't help yet.The peopleYou'll work with talented engineers, data engineers, product managers and credit experts who care a lot about getting things right. Share a half-formed idea on Friday and someone will have a prototype on Monday. We prefer it that way.They're also generous with what they know, quick to laugh and happy to change their minds when you make a better case. As long as you can back it up.This sounds like you if…You've led engineering teams for several years, ideally with a focus on backend systems or data integration in a product company. You've hired and developed engineers, and you've learned something from every team you've led.You've built mission-critical backend software in TypeScript and Node and deployed it on Kubernetes, ideally on GCP. You've integrated with external APIs and providers, and you know that the documentation is a starting point, not a promise. Our main stack is TypeScript and Node on the backend, React and React Native on the frontend, plus Python, Go, Kubernetes and GCP. The judgment you bring matters more than ticking every box.You're pragmatic. You care about clean, maintainable code, get a little too excited about reliability and have very little patience for over-engineering.You make decisions and create clarity without creating politics. People want to work for you, and they get better while they do.Experience from fintech, lending or another regulated environment is a plus, but not a requirement.More than anything, you can tell us about a team you made better. Not just what it shipped, but how it worked differently because you were there.This is a hands-on leadership role. If you want to step fully away from the code, or if what you really want is to stay an individual contributor, this probably isn't your role.A few practical notesThis role is based at our office on Drottninggatan 92 in Stockholm, and we work from the office. We think great teams and culture are built when people meet in person, especially at this stage.EU work authorisation is required.If you'd rather build integrations that just work than explain why the last one broke, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Superassistenter søkes til fast deltidsstilling på kveld og helg
jobs.description:
Jeg er en kvinne i 30-årene som søker en ny brukerstyrt personlig assistent (BPA) som fast på kveld og helg til teamet mitt. Jeg ser spesielt etter deg som har ønske om et langvarig ansettelsesforhold.

Ved ferieavvikling og sykefravær hos de andre faste ansatte er det fint om du er innstilt på å ta på deg ekstravakter.

Jeg er utdannet journalist og jobber med å fullføre en mastergrad. Hverdagen min varierer mye, og jeg trenger assistanse til det meste av fysiske gjøremål gjennom hele døgnet.

Jeg har assistanse 24 timer i døgnet, hele året – det betyr at du som fast ansatt må være innstilt på at helligdager også er en del av turnusen hos meg. Vi lager dog egen turnus for sommer og jul slik at alle også får avviklet egen ferie.

For tiden er jeg mye hjemme i påvente av en operasjon, og dagene mine er preget av en del smerter. Dette er noe du må være komfortabel med at blir en naturlig del av arbeidshverdagen. Samtidig, når formen tillater det, liker jeg å komme meg ut – enten det er kulturopplevelser i Oslo, sosiale aktiviteter eller tid med venner.

Hos meg vet du aldri helt hvordan dagen blir. Noen dager er rolige hjemme, andre er mer aktive og foregår ute av huset. Derfor passer denne stillingen spesielt godt for deg som trives med variasjon og kan tilpasse deg ulike situasjoner.

Stillingen som er ledig:

Jeg søker deg som er interessert i en fast stilling på 50% på kveld og helg. Frem til nyttår vil det være litt varierende vakter avhengig av hva vi har ledig fra uke til uke, men fra og med januar 2027 har stillingen fastsatt turnus med følgende faste vakter:

- Hver mandag kveld 16.00-24.00

- Arbeid annenhver helg (partallsuker):

Hver 4. helg: fredag (16.00-01.00), lørdag (09.00-17.00), søndag (17.00-24.00)

Hver 4. helg: lørdag (17.00-01.00) og søndag (09.00-17.00)

Noe fleksibilitet må beregnes i stillingen.

Hva går jobben ut på?

Jobben handler om å assistere meg i alle livets situasjoner, og det er mange av dem! Du vil hjelpe til med alt fra forflytning, praktiske oppgaver i hjemmet, være med på alt fra legebesøk til reiser, konserter, bursdager – og ganske enkelt sørge for at jeg får gjort det jeg har lyst til.

Hvem ser jeg etter?

Jeg søker deg som ser etter et langsiktig arbeidsforhold, slik at vi kan bli godt kjent og jeg kan få stabilitet i livet og du får en forutsigbar arbeidshverdag.

Du trenger ikke ha erfaring – opplæring gis, men det viktigste er personlig kjemi og gode egenskaper. Jeg ser etter deg som:

- Er kvinne (av hensyn til jobbens intime karakter)

- Snakker og skriver flytende norsk

- Er trygg, fleksibel og løsningsorientert

- Er fysisk sterk og tåler forflytninger og aktivitet

- Har respekt for at du jobber tett på et annet menneske

- Takler både gode og dårlige dager

- Ønsker en jobb med variasjoner - og gjerne erfaring fra serviceyrker

Hva får du?

  • Tarifflønn, med ansiennitet

  • Pensjon og forsikring (inkl. AFP)

  • Trygt og ryddig arbeidsforhold

  • God opplæring og støtte

  • Assistentkurs gjennom Humana

  • Tilgang til ansattfordeler:

    • Rabatt på SATS og Nr1 Fitness

    • Ansatt-hytte på Hovden

    • Visma LogBuy-fordelsprogram

  • Brukervennlig app for rutiner og vaktplan

  • En meningsfull jobb, hvor du gjør en reell forskjell i et annet menneskes liv

Arbeidssted:

jobs.title: Head of Avionics & Electrical Department
jobs.description: As Head of the Avionics & Electrical Department, you will play a central role in shaping the electrical and electronic architecture of our satellite platforms and ensuring the reliable performance of our missions. Our customers include major space companies, agencies, and commercial players across Europe and worldwide.OHB Sweden develops advanced small satellite systems for scientific and Earth observation missions. These missions require highly reliable avionics and electrical systems that form the backbone of the spacecraft, enabling power generation and distribution, communications, command and data handling, and mission operations.The Avionics & Electrical Department is responsible for the design, development, verification, and support of the satellite's electrical and electronic systems. The department currently consists of approximately 23 highly skilled engineers and specialists working in areas including:    Electrical Architecture    Electrical Power Systems (EPS)    TT&C and Communications Systems and RF Systems    EMC / EMI    Electronics Design    Radiation Engineering and EEE Component Usage    Data Handling Systems and Onboard Computers    Harness Design    FPGA Design    EGSE designThe department contributes throughout the complete spacecraft lifecycle, from early mission concepts and proposal activities, through design studies, detailed development, subsystem and system verification, launch preparation, and operational support.The space industry is evolving rapidly, driven by increased satellite autonomy, software-defined systems, miniaturized electronics, higher levels of integration, growing constellation markets, and increasing demands on cybersecurity, resilience, and manufacturability. At the same time, OHB Sweden is transitioning towards a higher degree of productization and industrialization of its satellite platforms. In this context, the Avionics & Electrical Department will play a key role in defining future platform architectures, technologies, methodologies, and engineering practices. As Head of Department, you will lead this evolution and ensure OHB Sweden remains a competitive and technically leading provider of advanced small satellite systems.As Head of the Avionics & Electrical Department, you will be mainly responsible for:    Driving staff recruitment, onboarding, and development to build a motivated and high-performing team.    Managing resource planning to balance project demands and support business growth, in close collaboration with project managers and other department heads.    Acting as a key point of contact for customers, partners, and suppliers on avionics, electrical, communications, electronics, and onboard computing matters.    Ensures that engineering processes relevant for the department activities exist and are properly implemented.    Ensures that proper engineering tools are efficiently used in the department    Owns the department ways-of-working.    Implementing strategic and operational decisions from the Company Management Team within the department.    Ensuring the department's skills and expertise align with the evolving needs of the company and its projects.    Reporting to employees and managers.    Overall responsibility for the technical deliveries from the department to the project in quality, time and cost.    Managing resource planning to balance project demands and support business growth, in close collaboration with project managers and other department heads.    Contributing to proposals by estimating costs and evaluating staffing.    Leading budgeting within your area of responsibility, covering general expenses, training, laboratories, equipment, and investments.What We're Looking For    Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Engineering Physics, or a related discipline.    At least 10 years of experience as an engineer and technical leader within avionics, electronics, electrical systems, communications, or a related field.    Proven leadership skills, with experience managing teams and coordinating complex, multidisciplinary engineering activities.    Strong understanding of spacecraft avionics and electrical systems, including electrical architectures, power systems, communications, onboard computing, electronics development and testing.    Understanding of EMC, radiation effects, reliability, and engineering standards applicable to space systems.    Strong analytical skills and the ability to foster innovation and continuous improvement within the team.    Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.    Fluency in English; knowledge of Swedish is a plus.    A collaborative mindset, with experience working in multicultural and multidisciplinary environments.What We Offer    A unique opportunity to lead one of the key engineering departments responsible for the core avionics and electrical capabilities of our satellite platforms.    Involvement in all phases of satellite projects, from early studies and proposal work to launch and operations.    A supportive and innovative work environment, with opportunities for personal and professional growth.    Competitive salary and benefits, with flexibility for work-life balance.The Head of Avionics & Electrical Department will report to the Head of Engineering & Technology and play a key role in the company's technical leadership team. This position may require occasional travel, primarily within Europe.Join us and help shape the next generation of satellite avionics and electrical systems!

jobs.title: Experimental Quantum Engineer
jobs.description:
About Us

QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. We do this with our unique VIO™ technology, the only QPU architecture that breaks the hardware barriers that have held quantum computing back, unlocking the path to MegaQubit quantum processors.

With VIO, we are paving the way for the hyper-scale quantum computers that will change the world. And delivering on that vision demands people who don’t shy away from tackling the hardest challenges of our time. That’s where you come in!

QuantWare is seeking an Experimental Quantum Engineer to join our growing Operations team. The mission of QuantWare’s Operations team is to consistently deliver high quality quantum hardware and make advanced quantum technologies accessible to customers all over the world.

Together with your colleague Experimental Quantum Engineers, you will be in charge of several state of the art cryogenic setups. You’ll use these setups to perform advanced qubit measurements and guarantee the quality of all devices before they are shipped to customers. Whenever you spot abnormalities, you’ll search for root causes and countermeasures, together with your colleagues from Fabrication or Design. Product volume and complexity of our products increase - so the challenge is to stay one step ahead by continuously improving our measurement setups, software and processes.

What you will be doing

  • Own QuantWare’s cryogenic measurement setups: purchase and build them, and keep them state-of-the-art (maintenance, upgrades).

  • Manage the hands-on physical operation of cryogenic quantum hardware, working directly with the dilution refrigerators.

  • Develop measurement code to implement and refine Python-based routines for device characterization.

  • Characterize quantum chips to evaluate and improve the performance of superconducting qubits and amplifiers - to guarantee QuantWare’s customers receive perfect devices and to support new product development and research.

Your Profile

  • Education: master’s degree in physics or electrical engineering, preferably with a focus on quantum computing.

  • Experience: Hands-on experience with programming, preferably Python.

  • Knowledge: Experience with superconducting circuits and microwave measurement techniques is a plus, but not required.

  • Skills: you are tech-savvy, learn fast and get things done: regardless if that means getting your hands dirty or deep in the python code. You enjoy solving problems and methodically improving our processes.

This is a description of our ideal candidate, not a filter. If most resonates and you're keen to learn the gaps, apply. We hire for trajectory, not perfection.

What We Offer:

At QuantWare, you’ll be part of a high-performing team of world-class experts in an ambitious, fast-moving environment. From day one, you’ll have the trust, tools, and support to do your best work. Here’s what you can expect:

Competitive salary - A salary that reflects the impact and importance of the role (and of course 8% holiday allowance)

Pension that’s built to last - A generous and future-proof pension plan that includes partner and dependent coverage.

Flexibility built on trust - We focus on outcomes. Work flexibly, in a hybrid setup, with an open vacation policy that lets you manage your time

Personal growth - We invest in your L&D, with a budget available to each team member, dependent on their individual ambitions, development needs, and performance

A connected team - We make space to celebrate wins together, with team events, offsites, and spontaneous moments that bring us closer

Diversity & Inclusion at QuantWare

We’re an ambitious company, not only for our goals but also to become an even more diverse and inclusive team. We know great candidates don't always follow a straight path, and we value diverse experience, perspectives, and ways of thinking. We know this helps us make better decisions, drives more innovation, and strengthens our culture.

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer
jobs.description:
Looking for a new adventure? You’ve come to the right place.

We're an Amsterdam-based team of 95+ (and counting) with 20+ nationalities amongst us! A varied bunch of “Citizens of The World” with a wide range of skills and hundreds of thousands of kilometers under our travel belts. And we have something important in common (other than our very well-worn passports): We want to change the way people travel.

And that's exactly what we're doing, with the travel app to plan, track, and relive trips in a smart and beautiful way.

Polarsteps has over 22 million users already, but, for us, this is just the beginning. We have big plans for the future, and so we need even more talented and enthusiastic people to help us on our journey.

Want to know more about us? Here you go.

Your expedition: Product Design at Polarsteps

We’re a small team, doing big things.

At Polarsteps, everyone, our CEO, support specialists, developers, product managers, and more, cares about design. It’s part of our DNA and embedded in every discussion. This gives you, as a Product Designer, the opportunity to make full use of your skills and craft your designs to perfection.

Our relatively small team consists of like-minded design enthusiasts who can geek out over the nitty-gritty details–corner radius, shadows, colors–for hours. We are big on collaboration, challenge each other, and make meetings as fun as they are productive. We dream big, move fast and welcome ideas, from anyone.

Your itinerary

What your journey at Polarsteps will look like on a typical day.

Lead the design of our “Digital Relive” team, focused on one of travel’s most meaningful moments: looking back on it all. We’re building new ways for travelers to relive their trips, both on the road and once they’re home, from in-app experiences to shareable formats like Trip Reels and Map Video.

You will:

  • Oversee the full product lifecycle of concepting, prototyping, and iterating based on design reviews, user testing, feedback, and data like share rates.

  • Implement and maintain the existing design & brand guidelines while also creating and adapting guidelines to elevate the overall Polarsteps design, including the look and feel of our shareable formats.

  • Own your product pillar, while maintaining close collaboration with the other pillars. Proactively ask for and share feedback to keep our product smooth, consistent, and awesome.

  • Collaborate with Product Managers and Engineers to ensure your designs are well-specced and built as intended, down to the last pixel and color.

The equipment in your backpack

What we’re hoping you’ll bring with you.

✅ Being a seasoned professional with 5+ years of experience designing lovable products;
✅ A strong portfolio, with shipped designs, that demonstrates end-to-end (hybrid UX and UI) product design, with a strong visual eye for typography, layout, and storytelling;
✅ Experience designing for native mobile apps;
✅ Hands-on experience with user insights and testing, like A/B tests and usability studies;
✅ A proactive mindset, with a passion for getting involved in the entire product development process, thinking and problem-solving like a product manager;
✅ Fluency in modern design tools such as Figma/Sketch or similar;
✅ Experience in prototyping tools such as Principle/Protopie or similar;
✅ Skills in partnering with engineers to drive QA processes and uphold implementation fidelity;
✅ A genuine interest in motion, video, and visual storytelling, and the curiosity to grow in it. You don’t need to be an After Effects pro, but you get excited about how things move and feel.

Bonus points if you have:

✨ Hands-on experience with motion or video tools (like After Effects or Premiere), or with designing for social platforms like Instagram and TikTok. Not a dealbreaker if that’s not your world yet; it’s something we’re happy to grow together.

 

1st class extras

Some cool things to make the journey extra sweet.

  • Salary range: Between EUR 75.000 - 90.000 gross per year incl 8% holiday allowance (based on 40 hours/week). Where you land in the range depends on your experience and skills, assessed during the interview process.

  • Equity: You'll be able to participate in our Polarsteps SAR Plan.

  • A yearly free flight or train ride to a random location! Give our Teleporter a spin here.

  • A shiny new MacBook to work your magic on.

  • Hybrid working, our way. Work from home and the office, we ask everyone to be in the office 2 days a week. It’s how we stay flexible, focused, and meaningfully connected in person.

  • An extensive home office set-up, everything from noise-canceling headphones to a standing desk.

  • 30 days of vacation (for adventures or sitting on the couch, it's up to you)

  • Two paid Culture Days for days that are important to you but not recognized by the official Dutch calendar.

  • The option to switch up your Zoom background by working from another country for up to 8 weeks a year.

  • A personal development budget for that curious mind of yours!

  • A pension plan to help you save for those around-the-world retirement trips.

  • Delicious daily team lunches.

  • Awesome monthly parties, as well as team trips away.

  • A lively office in downtown Amsterdam, with travel costs reimbursed.

  • Free Polarsteps Travel Books to contain all your far-flung adventures.

At Polarsteps, we believe the best products are built by people as diverse as the travelers using our apps! That's why we specifically encourage people underrepresented in the tech industry to apply for a role with us. Because we believe that diversity, be it age, race, sexual orientation, physical ability, ethnicity, or gender identity, makes both the world and the workplace better.

  • Systems testing and team support: Train new colleagues on our ERP purchase tools to keep processes compliant. Test upcoming changes to the Purchasing module and share ideas to refine the software. Review Accounts Payable postings in our reporting tool to keep numbers accurate.

What you bring

  • Over 4 years of experience in Accounts Payable or other related accounting roles within a Finance team;

  • Good understanding of accounting, tax and financial reporting principles and practices and regulations;

  • Fluency in both English and Dutch is required;

  • Excellent knowledge of MS Office and familiarity with ERP systems (i.e. SAP or equivalent, Odoo);

  • Strong attention to detail, analytical acumen and organizational skills;

  • Ability to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment;

  • Good communication and collaboration skills and ability to communicate well across cultures and backgrounds.

What we offer

  • Working for a Great Place to Work® certified company;

  • Comprehensive pension plan;

  • Commuting allowance;

  • 30 days of paid holiday leave (with the possibility to buy 3 additional days);

  • Opportunities to develop your skills even further through training and certifications;

  • High quality laptop/desktop, monitor, headphones, and any other equipment necessary for your role;

  • An international team of 30+ nationalities, full of high performance colleagues you can exchange experiences with and learn from. As well as having a lot of fun in our social events and Friday drinks!

Our work shows up at airports, wind farms, military sites and nature reserves around the world.

At our core, we are a team of passionate trading and tech enthusiasts committed to revolutionizing trading through automation. Our collaborative approach ensures that everyone contributes to achieving our ambitious goals.

jobs.title: Backend Engineer – Real-Time Video
jobs.description:
About Stream

Stream powers real-time Chat, Video, Activity Feeds, and AI Moderation for more than 1 billion end users across 4,000+ apps, from Strava and Bumble to eBay and Patreon. Our platform processes billions of API requests per month and supports applications with millions of concurrent users, while delivering highly reliable, low-latency services and a great developer experience.

The role

We're looking for a Staff Backend Engineer to join Stream on our mission of elevating the quality of apps for billions of users globally. You'll own the technical direction of Stream Video's media plane and the infrastructure it runs on.

This is a full-time role, hybrid with 3 days a week in our Amsterdam office, or remote from anywhere in the EU.

What you'll work on

Stream Video runs on an SFU we built in Go on top of Pion, plus ingest and recording fleets, all on a global edge network we own across more than one cloud. Nobody at Stream has owned this media plane end to end before. Our central infrastructure team is tuned for request-based services, and video breaks in different ways: live sessions can't be dropped, bandwidth is the biggest cost, and placement is the main lever. That's why this is a Staff role. You'll set the direction for the video backend and its infrastructure with your own roadmap, reporting to our Director of Engineering with a direct line to our CTO. The Video SDK teams own the client side, and you'll work closely with them and with infrastructure. Part of the fleet is mid-move to Kubernetes.

Job responsibilities:

  • Architecture: write the architecture and roadmap for Stream Video's backend and media infrastructure, and decide what ships.

  • Scale livestreaming: architect the SFU and media pipeline (WHIP, WHEP, RTMP, SRT, HLS, SVC), including the path from WebRTC to CDN-backed HLS for very large audiences.

  • Own the fleet: reliability, autoscaling, placement, rollouts, observability and cost for long-lived sessions across clouds, with cost per gigabyte as a first-class metric.

  • Gate production changes: define the validation that decides which changes, including AI-generated ones, reach live media, using behaviour tests on realistic networks, nightly telemetry scans and a public quality benchmark.

  • Take the final escalation: handle the hardest quality, latency and production incidents, and work with enterprise customers on advanced integrations.

  • Raise the bar: mentor senior engineers through design review, code review and hiring.

About you

You've owned systems where a dropped session or a bad rollout is visible to users within seconds, and you think about cost and reliability as much as features. You'd rather write the hard design doc than wait for one. A founder background is an asset here. The team is small, so you'll still write and review plenty of code. If you're looking for a large organisation with a platform team to hand problems to, or a management track, this role won't suit you.

You have:

  • Extensive backend engineering experience, including significant time owning architecture for high-scale production systems

  • Expert proficiency in Go or an equivalent systems language (Rust, C++, Java)

  • A track record owning real-time, stateful or latency-sensitive systems at very high scale

  • Deep knowledge of distributed systems and networking: failure modes, placement, capacity planning and cost

  • Strong experience with real-time media or streaming: WebRTC, SFU/MCU concepts, RTP/RTCP, DTLS, or RTMP, SRT and HLS

  • Clear written communication: design docs and RFCs that others can act on

  • Hands-on experience adopting AI coding and agent tools, and judgement on how to make them safe in production

Bonus points:

  • Built or operated an SFU, or contributed to Pion or another WebRTC stack

  • Moved a stateful fleet to Kubernetes, or ran media workloads across more than one cloud

  • Knowledge of bandwidth estimation, congestion control, simulcast, SVC and codecs (Opus, VP8/VP9, AV1)

  • CockroachDB/PostgreSQL, RocksDB, Raft and Redis at scale

  • Experience at developer tooling, API or SDK companies

  • Founder or early-stage startup experience building real-time products

  • Python or Rust alongside Go

  • Conference talks, technical writing or notable open-source work in real-time media

What makes this role exciting

  • Scope: the infrastructure direction for video is yours to run as a product, with the authority to decide what ships.

  • Impact: Video is Stream's most complex product, and many customers run it alongside Chat, Feeds and Moderation, so this work matters across the company.

  • Stack: Go, Pion, WebRTC, WHIP/WHEP, RTMP, SRT, HLS, Protobuf, CockroachDB/Postgres, RocksDB, Raft and Redis, with Claude, Cursor and ChatGPT Codex in daily use.

  • Starting point: a concrete first 90 days. Ship a validation gate on every infrastructure change that reaches production media, and move part of the fleet to Kubernetes with a cost-per-gigabyte number attached.

Why join Stream?

We're a Series B company with offices in Boulder, Amsterdam, Skopje and Toronto, and a team of 140+ people from 37 nationalities. We're backed by Felicis Ventures, GGV Capital, 01 Advisors, Techstars, and Arthur Ventures, with angels including Dick Costolo (ex-CEO of Twitter), Olivier Pomel (CEO of Datadog), Tom Preston-Werner (co-founder of GitHub), and Nicolas Dessaigne (co-founder of Algolia).

We'll be straight with you: a startup is more demanding than a large company. There's no fixed playbook, you'll own things end to end, and you'll sometimes pick up work outside your title. That's also what makes it a fast place to grow. If you want real ownership and high scale more than structure and a set career ladder, you'll feel at home here.

What we offer

  • Company equity

  • 28 days paid time off plus Dutch public holidays

  • Pension plan with a company contribution

  • NS Business Card or a company bike, covered

  • Personal development budget of EUR 500 per year

  • Catered lunches in the office

  • MacBook Pro

  • Up to EUR 60 a month toward a gym or sports club membership of your choice

  • Highly skilled migrant (kennismigrant) visa sponsorship and relocation support if you're moving to Amsterdam

This list applies to Netherlands-based employees and is adjusted to your location of residence. If you work remotely from another EU country, you'll be employed through our Employer of Record partner and get company equity plus local benefits depending on your country of employment.

Our culture

Stream is a casual, transparent team that aims high and supports each other. In engineering, we care about ownership and quality, and our goal is to ship stable software. Management stays hands-on, with less middle management and more time spent doing the work. If that sounds like the environment you want next, apply now.

We hire on skills and experience, and we don't discriminate based on age, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, ethnicity, nationality, religion or belief, political opinion, disability or chronic illness, marital status, working hours, type of contract, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you need an adjustment at any point in our hiring process, let us know.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Technology Risk Assurance
jobs.description:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

 

How you'll make impact

You’ll build and scale a practical Second Line of Defence technology risk assurance function for a fast-growing, regulated fintech.

  • Recruit, mentor, and lead a lean, high-performing team of technology risk engineers and assurance specialists, fostering technical depth, code-first assurance, and cross-functional agility.

  • Lead second-line assurance across ITGCs and IT application controls, cloud infrastructure and database management, CI/CD and change enablement, IAM and privileged access, API and automated data pipeline integrity, and business continuity and disaster recovery.

  • Build an automation-first assurance engine using AI agents, automated workflows, and custom Python and SQL scripts for continuous control testing, evidence retrieval, and remediation validation.

  • Establish automated finding lifecycle and remediation governance, surfacing control failures to engineering leads and validating fixes without drawn-out re-audit cycles.

  • Design and execute control frameworks for generative AI, LLMs, agentic workflows, machine learning models, and automated decision engines.

  • Partner with external auditors and global regulators to defend autonomous testing scripts and AI-agent methodologies, ensuring automated evidence is trusted and relied upon.

  • Translate complex technology risk into clear recommendations for engineers, senior executives, and board-level risk committees, drawing on frameworks and expectations including NIST, ISO 27001, SOC 1, SOC 2, DORA, MAS TRM, FCA, HKMA, ASIC, and FinCEN.

You’ll work from our Amsterdam or London office three days a week.


What we're looking for

Essentials

  • 8+ years of progressive experience in technology risk, IT audit, information security assurance, or technology compliance, including proven experience in a Second Line of Defence risk assurance capacity.

  • Big Four background.

  • Experience building and testing risk controls.

  • A track record of recruiting, mentoring, and leading high-performing technical risk or assurance teams.

  • Deep practical expertise in ITGCs, IT application controls, automated business controls, and SOX compliance within complex distributed architectures.

  • Hands-on experience assessing cloud risks across AWS or GCP, particularly IAM, privileged access and segregation of duties, Firefighter workflows, CI/CD pipelines, database controls, and modern API security.

  • Practical ability to write and use SQL, Python, or API scripts to query databases, automate evidence extraction, and reduce manual sampling.

  • Strong conceptual and practical understanding of risks and controls around AI/ML systems, LLMs, and automated decision engines, including data drift, access guardrails, and model integrity.

  • Proven ability to constructively challenge First Line engineering leads while maintaining the credibility to defend automated testing methodologies to external auditors and regulatory examiners.

  • Solid working knowledge of industry control frameworks such as SOC 1/2, ISO 27001, and NIST CSF.

Preferred

  • Direct experience building or deploying AI agents, LLM-driven audit assistants, or automated compliance and testing pipelines.

  • Fintech experience, particularly within a high-growth fintech, payments platform, digital bank, or cloud-native technology company.

  • People management experience.

  • Familiarity with international financial technology regulations and expectations, including MAS TRM, FCA, HKMA, DORA, ASIC, and FinCEN.

  • Experience integrating GRC platforms, BI dashboards such as Tableau or Looker, and continuous compliance monitoring tools.

  • Relevant certifications such as CISA, CISSP, CRISC, CISM, or AWS/GCP certifications.


You'll thrive here if

  • You’re comfortable owning the roadmap yourself.

  • You own the outcome and you don't wait for permission to fix what's broken.

  • You're comfortable with ambiguity. Give you a problem, not a prescription, and you'll run with it.

  • You say what you mean. You're direct, but you lead with respect.

  • You simplify complexity rather than hiding behind it.


Learn more about your team

Risk is part of Regulatory & Compliance at Airwallex.

Regulatory & Compliance is where we build the trust, discipline, and operational resilience required to scale a generational financial platform.

As Airwallex grows across 30+ markets, this team turns regulatory complexity into strategic control. You'll lead compliance, enterprise risk, and regulatory engagement in a way that protects the business while letting it move with conviction. Our ambition goes beyond meeting expectations: we're building a risk posture that acts as a competitive moat, grounded in ownership, proactive regulatory partnerships, and frameworks that scale globally while respecting local nuance.

It's a team for strategic operators with sharp judgment, high standards, and the confidence to execute at pace in a high-stakes environment. You'll thrive here if you can balance rigor with progress and influence across functions.

If you want to architect the benchmark for trust and resilience in global finance, your work here will have a massive impact.

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.
