jobs.title: MHPSS Advisor
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced Mental Health and Psychosocial Support (MHPSS) professional with a passion for advancing evidence-based MHPSS practice in humanitarian settings? Danish Red Cross (DRC) is looking for a MHPSS Advisor to provide technical expertise, capacity development, and quality assurance to the Red Cross Red Crescent National Societies (RCRC) National Societies delivering community-based MHPSS interventions in humanitarian settings.

About the position and the assignments  

You will be based at the Danish Red Cross HQ in Copenhagen and will be part of the Health Team in the Technical Quality and Impact Unit of the International Department. The Health Team comprises technical advisors within health and mental health and psychosocial support. It ensures the availability of the necessary technical capacities to provide timely and relevant assistance and advice to DRC-supported operations, with a primary focus on the Africa, while also supporting MHPSS interventions in MENA, Europe and Asia regions as needed.

As a member of the Health Team, you will be working under the line management of the Health Team Lead and will also work closely with other colleagues at the DRC HQ and Regional and Country Offices (COs), as well as with NSs staff and volunteers. You will also collaborate with the colleagues from the International Federation of the Red Cross Red Crescent (IFRC) and the International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC). The position does not have programme management responsibilities but supports programmes through technical accompaniment, mentoring, and quality assurance.

Your main responsibilities will be to:

  • Strategic planning and direction: Contribute to defining and rollout of DRC’s strategic directions within MHPSS in humanitarian settings. Support development and rollout of strategies, policies, and technical frameworks for MHPSS in humanitarian settings.
  • Technical support and guidance: Provide evidence-based guidance and advice to DRC COs and National Societies on MHPSS priorities, approaches and activities, remotely or through country visits and missions to ensure that MHPSS interventions follow industry standards and good practice. Support development or adaptation and rollout of relevant technical tools and guidelines to meet operational needs.
  • Strengthening of capacities: Support National Societies in assessing technical capacity needs, and in designing and implementing capacity-strengthening plans, including trainings, coaching, mentoring, and technical supervision. 
  • Program monitoring and evaluation:  Support planning and undertaking of assessments, baselines, endlines, reviews and evaluations, and monitoring of MHPSS interventions.
  • Advocacy: In close collaboration with relevant humanitarian diplomacy (HD) colleagues, contribute to DRC’s policy influencing, advocacy and HD efforts on MHPSS in humanitarian settings.
  • Resource mobilisation: Support proposal development by contributing to the design and quality assurance of MHPSS components in the project proposals that align with donor requirements and organisational goals and priorities.
  • Partnerships and collaboration: Foster thematic partnerships and joint MHPSS initiatives within the RCRC Movement and with external stakeholders. 
  • Surge deployments: Undertake MHPSS surge/deployments in support of DRC bi-lateral operations and wider RCRC Movement responses, including multilateral deployments with the ICRC and the IFRC.  

 

Your profile

We are looking for an experienced MHPSS professional with at least five years of experience working on community-based MNHPSS with humanitarian and development organisations, including at least three years in international postings in Africa and MENA regions. You hold a master's degree, or equivalent experience, in MHPSS, social sciences, or another relevant field. You have sound technical, strategy and advisory skills within community-based MHPSS in humanitarian settings and migration. You have proven experience developing and adapting technical guidance, tools and training materials, as well as designing and facilitating capacity-development initiatives for staff and volunteers of partner organisations. 

You have experience supporting assessments, technical reviews, evaluations, and the development of quality assurance processes for community-based MHPSS interventions. You are an excellent facilitator and communicator with strong interpersonal and cross-cultural skills. You work collaboratively, are well organised, and are able to manage multiple priorities while meeting deadlines. You are willing and able to undertake field missions, including emergency deployments, with travel of up to four months per year. Professional working proficiency in both English and French is required. Experience of working for the International RCRC Movement is considered an asset. 

We offer

A job with an opportunity to improve the lives of the most vulnerable people around the world. We further offer a unique opportunity to influence the strategic development and mainstreaming of MHPSS in humanitarian settings.

The position is a full-time position - 37 working hours per week. The position is 12 months with possibility for extension.

Salary and employment conditions are in accordance with Danish Red Cross’s collective bargaining agreement with HK and AC, depending on experience and qualifications. The position is based at the Danish Red Cross headquarters in Copenhagen and requires on-site presence. As this is a national position based in Denmark, the salary package does not include relocation assistance to Denmark and housing or family-related allowances.

Your future workplace

The International Red Cross and Red Crescent network is the largest humanitarian network in the world, with a presence and activities in almost every country. All Red Cross and Red Crescent activities have one central purpose: to help those who suffer, without discrimination, whether during conflict, in response to natural or man-made disasters, or due to conditions of chronic poverty. Our work is guided by seven fundamental principles: humanity, impartiality, independence, voluntary service, unity, and universality. 

DRC’s international department’s approx. 300 staff supporting RCRC NSs with planning and implementing humanitarian and development interventions in some of the most challenging contexts in 20 countries across Africa, MENA, Asia, and Europe.

We offer a meaningful work at a purpose-driven workplace with truly engaged colleagues. We focus on professional challenges, well-being and a flexible organising of your work life. All of us contribute to a great work environment and colleagueship. 

 

Application and further information

For any specific questions about the position, please contact us at zesd@rodekors.dk subject “MHPSS Advisor 2026”.

Interviews will take place in the second part of November with an expected start date as soon as possible and no later than 01 January 2027. 

We look forward to receiving your application and CV no later than 18 November 2026. Application and CV in English are accepted only through our online recruitment system. Applications made by email will not be reviewed.

jobs.title: Senior Scientist within Applied Nuclear Technology
jobs.description:
The Institute of Energy Technology (IFE) is an independent research foundation in Norway, with locations in Kjeller and Halden. We are an internationally leading research environment that actively develops innovative solutions through people and technology. We operate under the mission 'Research for a better future'. IFE is a broad interdisciplinary research organization with top-level international expertise in digital technologies, material and process technology, flow and analysis technology, environmental technology, critical raw materials, radiopharmaceutical technology, and nuclear technology and safety.

The Tracer Technology Department at IFE is an internationally recognized research department with a strong and growing focus on applied nuclear technology. For more than 40 years, the department has pioneered tracer technologies and tracing methods used globally to study fluid flow, mass transport, and complex industrial and environmental processes. Today, we have extended our R&D competence and know-how on: tracers for Oil & Gas Industry, tracers for geothermal applications, environmental monitoring, critical raw materials and applied nuclear technology. We conduct research and innovation spanning within radiochemistry, medical radionuclides, neutron technologies, radiation-based industrial services, environmental radioactivity, advanced radioanalytical methods and process analytical chemistry. We are a core member of the Norwegian Nuclear Research Centre (NNRC), and we are hosting a national infrastructure project on neutron generators (HUNT).

A major strategic investment is IFE's future laboratory building, which is planned to house a whole floor of dedicated radioactivity laboratories designed to support advanced research, technology development, testing, and commercial services involving radionuclides, radioactive materials and irradiation. The department has responsibility for the on-going development, and use of IFE’s future radioactivity laboratories when these will be completed. They will comprise of state-of-the-art B-laboratories, neutron generator laboratories, irradiation facilities, a laboratory for processing of radioactive industrial sources, calibration of radiation measuring instruments and has access to extensive radioanalytical laboratories. By combining expertise in nuclear science, radiochemistry, analytical chemistry, and engineering disciplines, the department develops innovative research-based solutions and commercial services that contribute to technological advancement, industrial competitiveness, and the green transition. These facilities will provide a unique national capability for applied nuclear technology research and innovation, enabling us to translate scientific advances into practical solutions for the industry, the public authorities and international partners and customers.

Main responsibilities and work tasksWe are looking for a motivated and business-oriented senior researcher with expertise in Applied Nuclear Technology, with emphasis on irradiation technologies, neutron-based systems, radiation effects, and industrial applications of ionizing radiation.The successful candidate will generate and lead new research initiatives, secure funding from national, international, and industrial sources, and develop commercially relevant services based on irradiation technologies and radiation science. The role includes working with neutron generators, irradiation facilities, and other advanced radiation-based technologies, while collaborating closely with industrial customers to transform scientific advances into practical and valuable applications. You are strongly expected to develop and further expand the capabilities of the new radioactivity laboratories, and maximize the commercial and R&D potential of these facilities on national and international level.Educational Background

PhD (or equivalent experience) in Nuclear Engineering, Applied Nuclear Physics, Radiation Science, Experimental Nuclear Physics or a related field with preferably 5-10 years relevant experience after the completion of the Ph.D.Technical qualificationsDemonstrated experience in neutron generators and accelerator-based neutron sources is desired and in addition in one or more of the following areas:

  •  Gamma irradiation facilities
  •  Radiation effects testing of materials and electronic
  •  Radiation detection and measurement systems
  •  Nuclear instrumentation
  •  Neutron imaging and non-destructive testing
  •  Industrial applications of ionizing radiation
  •  Radioisotope production or radiochemical applications

Project generation qualifications

  •  Demonstrated track record of generating externally funded R&D projects from national, European, or industrial funding sources.
  •  Experience developing commercial research-based services and engaging with industrial partners.

Further experience

  •  Project leading experience is necessary.
  •  Experimentalist, with hands-on laboratory work experience.
  •  Contribution to development of regulatory documents for internal use or for the authorities regarding the instruments or the facility is expected.
  •  Strong awareness towards Health Safety Environment and Radiation Protection regulations compliance. The latter is highly important.
  •  Knowledge of nuclear instrumentation is an advantage but not required.
  •  Excellent communication in oral/written English. Norwegian language skills both oral and written or the genuine interest to learn within two years.
Personality

We are looking for a person who is a genuine team player, who creates safe and trust-based relationships both within our organization and with our customers.

  • Motivated and engaging person within the professional area and towards the colleagues.
  •  Proactive with high degree of initiative and creativity.
  •  Safe, clear and transparent communicator.
  •  You can lead project teams while also be a team-member.
  •  You should be solution-oriented.
  •  Structured.
  •  You take responsibility.
  •  You take decisions in line with the department and the organization.
  •  You enjoy cooperating with both academic and industrial partners.
We offer
  •  Competitive salary, pension- and insurance schemes.
  •  Exciting and challenging tasks in a team that works in the forefront of research.
  •  Participation in a leading international research team.
  • Collaboration with other departments.
  •  Competent and easy to collaborate colleagues in a professional environment that values mutual growth.
  •  A growing and healthy organization that is focused on individual and group development.
  •  Flexible working hours.

 

How to ApplyThe following application materials must be submitted through the IFE job application portal:

  • Cover Letter
  •  Curriculum Vitae
  •  Diplomas
We place great emphasis on your personal suitability for the position. IFE is subject to the Security Act, which includes requirements for the organisation’s management of critical national information, as well as other relevant legislation concerning the management of sensitive information. The successful applicant for the position advertised will have access to classified information and critical national objects and infrastructure. In order to meet the qualification criteria, the applicant must therefore meet the security clearance and/or authorisation requirements. Note that relevant applicants will be asked questions that are necessary to ascertain this. This includes questions about any ties to countries that the PST has classified as a ‘high-risk country’ in its open threat assessment. Background checks are performed as part of our recruitment process.ContactsGeorgios Kalantzopoulos, Department Head Christian Dye, Research Director, 415 11 823 LocationInstituttveien 18 2007 Kjeller Key information:Employer: Institutt for energiteknikk (IFE) Reference number: 5188929381 Percentage of full-time: 100% Permanent position Application deadline: 07/11/2026

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Research for a better future IFE conducts research for a better future. Since 1948, we have been a frontrunner in international energy research. We contribute to new solutions in renewable energy, petroleum and industry. We develop zero-emission transport solutions, digital systems and ground-breaking cancer medicine. IFE develops new solutions for the industry and public sector in over 30 countries. IFE is host to the international OECD NEA Halden Projects. We are about 550 employees and the annual turnover is about NOK 1,2 billion. Read more about IFE at www.ife.no/en

jobs.title: Aktiviteettipäällikkö Holiday Club Saimaan Rauhaan
jobs.description: Tykkäätkö keksiä uutta, innostaa ihmisiä ja saada asioita tapahtumaan? Haluaisitko olla mukana luomassa elämyksiä, jotka tekevät asiakkaidemme lomasta ja vapaa-ajasta entistäkin ikimuistoisemman?Etsimme nyt joukkoomme idearikasta, innostavaa ja toimeen tarttuvaa aktiviteettipäällikköä vastaamaan Holiday Club Saimaan Rauhan aktiviteettien suunnittelusta, kehittämisestä ja toteutuksesta. Tehtävässä johdat omaa tiimiäsi, kehität palvelutarjontaa sekä vastaat aktiviteettien vetovoimasta ja kannattavuudesta. Osallistut myös käytännön tekemiseen arjen toiminnassa. Tarjoamme vakituisen ja kokoaikaisen tehtävän.TehtävästäAktiviteettipäällikkönä vastaat Saimaan Rauhan aktiviteettikokonaisuudesta sekä aktiviteettitiimin esihenkilötyöstä. Työskentelet tiiviissä yhteistyössä Resort Managerin kanssa ja raportoit tehtävässäsi hänelle. Tehtävässä yhdistyvät liikunta- ja elämyspalveluiden kehittäminen, ihmisten johtaminen, käytännön tekeminen sekä liiketoiminnallinen vastuu.Etsimme henkilöä, jolla on kokemusta palveluliiketoiminnan kehittämisestä ja esihenkilötyöstä. Sinulla on liikunta-alan osaamista ja ymmärrystä hyvinvointiin, liikuntaan ja aktiiviseen vapaa-aikaan liittyvien palveluiden suunnittelusta ja ohjaamisesta. Innostut uusien ideoiden kehittämisestä, osaat motivoida ihmisiä ja luoda mieleenpainuvia kokemuksia erilaisille ja eri-ikäisille asiakasryhmille.Liikunta ja hyvinvointi ovat tärkeä osa työnkuvaasi, mutta meillä aktiviteetit tarkoittavat paljon muutakin. Liikunnan rinnalla ne voivat olla tapahtumia, teemallisia ohjelmia, yhdessä tekemistä tai täysin uusia konsepteja. Arvostamme rohkeutta kokeilla uutta, kykyä tunnistaa mahdollisuuksia sekä taitoa viedä ideat käytäntöön. Osallistut myös itse aktiviteettien ohjaamiseen ja toteuttamiseen.Esihenkilönä johdat ja innostat aktiviteettitiimiä, huolehdit arjen sujuvuudesta ja luot edellytyksiä sille, että tiimi onnistuu työssään. Kehität toimintaa asiakaslähtöisesti ja huolehdit samalla siitä, että aktiviteettitarjonta tukee myös resortin liiketoimintaa.Tehtävä on lähityötä Holiday Club Saimaan Rauhassa, sillä aktiviteettien kehittäminen, toteuttaminen ja tiimin johtaminen edellyttävät vahvaa läsnäoloa paikan päällä.KohteestaHoliday Club Saimaan Rauha on Saimaan rannalla sijaitseva monipuolinen lomakeskus, jossa yhdistyvät majoitus, ravintolat, kokous- ja tapahtumapalvelut sekä laaja aktiviteettitarjonta. Resortissa on yli 200 hotellihuonetta, lähes 300 loma-asuntoa ja vuosittain yli 60 000 vierailijaa. Tarjontaan kuuluvat muun muassa kylpylä, golfkenttä, spa, Angry Birds -sisäleikkipuisto, kuntosali sekä monipuoliset peli- ja liikuntamahdollisuudet. jobs.title: Brøndby PPR søger psykologer til en fast stilling og et barselsvikariat
jobs.description:
Brøndby PPR søger psykologer til en fast stilling og et barselsvikariat

I PPR Brøndby søger vi to psykologer – en til en fast stilling og en til et barselsvikariat. Vi har bl.a. fået flere ressourcer til samarbejdet med Heldagstilbuddet Nørregård, som er Brøndby kommunes vidtgående specialiseret skole- og fritidstilbud for børn med autismespektrumsforstyrrelser og betydelige funktionsnedsættelser.

I PPR Brøndby er vi optagede af at bidrage til at skabe afgørende positive forandringer for børn og unge i deres udviklingsmiljøer og fællesskaber. Det gør vi både via vores arbejde med de ”traditionelle” PPR-opgaver og vores nye indsatser, der for psykologgruppens del bl.a. omfatter NUSSA, supervision i dagtilbud/skole og Diamantforløb. Udover dette er det psykologerne i PPR, der varetager en stor del af opgaverne inden for vores lettilgængelige behandlingstilbud. I tillæg til dette er vi vilde med prøvehandlinger, som vi løbende sætter i gang i og på tværs af faggrupperne. I PPR Brøndby er kulturen præget af nysgerrighed, faglige drøftelser og engagement. Hvis du kan se dig selv ind i det, så vil vi elske at byde dig velkommen fra d. 1. januar 2027

Lidt om, hvad du træder ind i

Det er vigtigt for os at være relevante samarbejdspartnere for såvel børn, unge og deres familier som for fagprofessionelle på området. Vi har derfor fokus på at gøre en reel forskel tæt på hverdagen og i praksis. Det gør vi med afsæt i høj faglighed, gode samarbejdsvaner, kreative løsninger samt blik og omsorg for den situation og kompleksitet, som både børn, unge, familier og eksterne kolleger står i.

For at understøtte et højt fagligt niveau har vi bl.a. regelmæssig ekstern supervision for alle psykologer og specialpædagogiske vejledere samt særligt tilrettelagte supervisionsforløb for psykologer under autorisation. Derudover er der løbende muligheder for at deltager på konferencer og kurser. 

Som ny medarbejder kan du forvente et godt introduktionsforløb, så du føler dig klædt på til at træde ud i opgaverne der venter – uanset, om du kommer med meget eller lidt erfaring. Derudover får du også tilknyttet en mentor ifm. din opstart. Derudover er både psykologfaglig koordinator, teamleder og PPR-leder alle psykologer med flere års erfaring fra PPR. 

Hvad ligger der i jobbet?

Du kommer til at indgå i tværfaglige såvel som selvstændige opgaver. Vi har opgaver både på almen- og specialområdet og samarbejder om alle børn dækkende gruppen 0-18-årige i kommunen og der er bl.a. også mulighed for at understøtte samarbejdet omkring meget funktionsnedsatte børn. I alle disse opgaver indgår sparring og rådgivning til pædagoger, lærere og ledelse, inddragelse af forældre, psykologiske undersøgelser (herunder test og observationer), og hvad du ellers fagligt vurderer vil kunne understøtte børn og unges udvikling, læring og trivsel. Der arbejdes i vid udstrækning med at understøtte de voksne i netværket omkring barnet/den unge, ligesom vi har et skærpet fokus på ikke at se barnet/den unge isoleret fra dets kontekst, men rette indsatser mod barnet/den unges undervisnings- og læringsmiljø. 

Brøndby kommunes lettilgængelige behandling varetages primært af psykologer i PPR og psykologerne i PPR også varetager kommunens krisestøtte til børn og unge, hvorfor dette også kan være en af dine opgaver. Det er væsentligt for os at sammensætte en opgaveportefølje, der giver mening både for den enkelte men også for den samlede opgaveløsning. 

Din profil

Vi håber at se din ansøgning, hvis du kan genkende dig selv i profilen:

  • Er uddannet psykolog og gerne autoriseret/med praksisuddannelse.
  • Er nyuddannet psykolog med mod på PPR-området.
  • Har erfaring med PPR eller andre aspekter af børne-/ungeområdet. 
  • Står godt i din psykologfaglighed og forstår at anvende den til at formidle, inspirere og inddrage andre i deres arbejde omkring børn, unge og fællesskaber – til tider med afsæt i psykologiske vurderinger, men langt overvejende i din psykologfaglige sparring og inspiration.
  • Arbejder og samarbejder både fleksibelt og målrettet med afsæt såvel det at være PPR-medarbejder og det at være psykolog. 
  • Forstår at navigere i den kompleksitet, som ofte præger opgaver i PPR. Du holder modet oppe og pulsen nede. 
  • Har gode erfaringer med mødeledelse og blik for positioneringer i kommunikationen – både for dig selv og for andre.
  • Er indstillet på, i en ånd af dialog, at lade dig udfordre både i din praksis og dine tanker/ideer – ligesom du er generøs med din viden og positivt bidragende til den fælles opgave med at skabe høj faglighed, godt kollegaskab og god trivsel.
  • Arbejder samskabende og forebyggende sammen med de voksne, der omgiver børn og unge.
  • Har erfaring for at arbejde med målgruppen for heldagstilbuddet Nørregård.

Kort om PPR Brøndby 

PPR’s arbejde har afsæt i en systemisk, kontekstuel og relationel forståelse af børn og unges adfærd, trivsel, oplevelser og muligheder for udvikling og deltagelse. PPR er en enhed under Børne-, Kultur- og Idrætsforvaltningen i Brøndby kommune. PPR understøtter Brøndby Kommunes Strategi 2030 og Sammenhængende Børne- og Ungepolitik, herunder det fælles børnesyn som lyder:

”Børn og unge gør det bedste, de kan, med de kompetencer, de har. Det er de voksnes ansvar at inddrage børn og unge i positive fællesskaber og læringsmiljøer med lige adgang til at udfolde og udvikle sig og trives”.

PPR Brøndby udgøres aktuelt af 6 sansemotoriske terapeuter, 9 specialpædagogiske vejledere, 14 logopæder, 19 psykologer, 3 administrative medarbejdere, 4 fagkoordinatorer, 2 teamledere og 1 PPR-leder. 

Du kan læse mere om PPR på https://www.brondby.dk/Borger/Familie-og-boern/Skole/Saerlig-stoette/PaedagogiskPsykologiskRaadgivning.aspx

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår:

Tiltrædelse: 1. januar 2027, eller før hvis muligt.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst.

Stillingen er på 37 timer ugentligt, eller ned til 32 timer hvis du ønsker det.

 

Yderligere information:

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte os. Teamleder, Trine Bornhøft kan kontaktes på tlf. 23 71 21 92. TR, Christian Lau Godskesen kan kontaktes på tlf. 92 43 25 14.

PPR har til huse på Brøndby Rådhus, Park Alle, 2605 Brøndby samt på distriktskontorer i kommunen, men vores opgaver løses primært ude på Brøndby kommunes skoler og dagtilbud. I forbindelse med ansættelse vil der blive indhentet børne- og straffeattest. I forbindelse med ansættelse vil der blive indhentet børne- og straffeattest.

Rekrutteringsprocessen: 

Ansøgningsfrist: d. 12.november 2026

Vi udvælger kandidater d. 16. november 2026 og inviterer efterfølgende til samtaler

Første samtaler: 19. november 2026 

Anden samtaler: 24. november 2026

 

Søg stillingen via 'ansøg'-knappen. Her kan du uploade din ansøgning og CV samt evt. relevant dokumentation. Alle interesserede ansøgere uanset alder, køn, handicap, religion eller etnisk tilhørsforhold opfordres til at søge stillingen.I Brøndby Kommune er der en generel politik om, at nyansatte skal forevise straffeattest. Ved beskæftigelse og direkte kontakt med børn under 15 år, indhentes der også en børneattest.Brøndby Kommune har røgfri arbejdstid. Brøndby er en centralt beliggende hovedstadskommune med cirka 40.000 indbyggere. Byens puls er præget af fællesskab, mangfoldighed og en stærk idrætskultur. Vi er en kommune med kant og spændende kontraster med bolig- og erhvervsområder, skove, grønne områder og Strandparken med havet og indsøerne.

jobs.title: Gram Equipment Graduate Program
jobs.description:
Unleash your potential in the Gram Equipment Graduate talent program - Experience hands-on learning in real business settings, open doors to global career opportunities, and join a community of change-makers!

About Us:

Gram Equipment is a global leader in providing innovative solutions for the ice cream and dairy industry. We are dedicated to pushing the boundaries of technology and driving forward the future of our industry. As part of our commitment to nurturing talent and fostering excellence, we are excited to announce our Graduate Program, designed to provide an immersive experience for aspiring professionals who are passionate about both mechanical engineering and commercial business.

Program Overview:

Our Graduate Program offers a unique opportunity for candidates with diverse backgrounds to gain a well-rounded experience in our organization. The program spans a duration of 24 months, divided into four rotations of six months each. This structure ensures that participants gain a comprehensive understanding of both mechanical engineering and commercial aspects of our business.

Qualifications:

We are seeking candidates who have or will graduate either in 2026 or in 2027, and who meet the following criteria:

  • Mechanical Engineering Background with Commercial Interest:

Candidates with a mechanical engineering background who possess a strong interest in commercial business and project management.

  • Commercial Engineering Background with Mechanical Engineering Interest:

Candidates with a commercial/business-oriented Engineering background who are keen to explore the world of mechanical engineering.

Key Program Highlights:

  • Mentorship: Participants will have the opportunity to work closely with a personal mentor from our global management team, offering valuable insights and guidance throughout the program.
  • Continuous Development: Gram Equipment is committed to fostering the growth and development of its talent. Participants will have access to the Gram Academy, a platform dedicated to ongoing learning and skill development.
  • International Rotation: Possibility for an international 6 month rotation in either our Turkish or US location.
  • Community Building: Join a vibrant and peer -based community of talented individuals within our organization, creating opportunities for networking, knowledge sharing, and collaboration.

How to Apply & Our Recruitment Process:

Our recruitment process is designed to identify and nurture potential talent. We believe in comprehensive evaluation, from video interviews and cognitive assessments to in-depth interviews and real-world business case evaluations during the Assessment Day, ensuring we welcome the best fit for our Graduate Program.

  1. Application and Assessment: Apply before 1st of March 2027, and if shortlisted, you'll complete a video interview and cognitive assessment.
  2. Interview and Evaluation: Promising candidates proceed to a comprehensive evaluation phase, which evaluates their behavioral competencies and business acumen, including a detailed assessment of a business case.
  3. Contract and Start Date: Upon impressing us at every stage, you'll sign a contract and officially begin your journey with the Gram Equipment Graduate Program on 1st of September 2027.

Join Us in Shaping the Future:

At Gram Equipment, we believe that innovation is driven by diverse perspectives and talents. Join our Graduate Program to embark on a journey that will equip you with the skills, knowledge, and experiences needed to excel in both the mechanical engineering and commercial aspects of our dynamic industry.

We look forward to welcoming the next generation of leaders to our team.

“For me, the biggest value being part of the Gram Equipment Graduate Program has been the people I have worked with along the way and the understanding I have gained of how the different parts of the organization come together.”Tommy Bui (ENG Integrated Design - SDU) - Project Manager at Gram Equipment

“The Graduate program gave me a strong network across the entire company and useful insights into many of our internal processes.” / “Contributing to such a significant change as a graduate was both empowering and a clear example of how my work could make a meaningful difference.”Luciana Apachitei (ENG in Global Business Engineering - VIA University College) - Engineering Excellence Project Manager "At Gram Equipment, I have shaped the company's direction and the projects related to it. I have had the chance to choose the projects that interested me. Many of the things I have learned in my studies, I have been able to apply to what I am doing at Gram Equipment, from engineering work to business understanding. I am actively involved in the strategy work, engineering practices and various digitalization tools. I use a lot of theoretical knowledge that I have acquired in my Engineering studies in relation to my daily work. My business background helped me understand how the business is working, and because the company foundation is at the technical aspect, my background has helped me identify its strengths and weaknesses very fast." -Rudy Mandrup Cazelles (ENG Product Development and Innovation - SDU) - Business Developer at Gram Equipment

Gram Equipment is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.description: Raskaan kaluston asentaja vakituiseen työsuhteeseen. Etsitkö vakaata työpaikkaa, jossa on reilu meininki, mahdollisuus kehittyä ja osaamista arvostava palkkaus?Asiakkaamme on pitkään toiminut ja hyvämaineinen huoltokorjaamo, joka etsii nyt tiimiinsä kokoaikaista ja vakituista raskaan kaluston asentajaa. Tässä roolissa pääset työskentelemään monipuolisesti kuorma-autojen, perävaunujen ja erilaisten työkoneiden parissa. Työskentelet pääasiassa arkipäivisin klo 7.00–17.30 välillä. Toivomme kuitenkin joustavuutta, sillä työpäivien pituudet saattavat vaihdella työtilanteen mukaan. Tulevaisuudessa yrityksessä on mahdollista siirtyä 2-vuorotyöhön, ja toisinaan töitä tehdään myös viikonloppuisin. Saat vahvan tuen ja perusteellisen perehdytyksen – meillä kaveria ei jätetä yksin. Palkkaus määräytyy AKT:n huoltokorjaamoalan työehtosopimuksen ja kokemuksesi mukaan. Erikoisosaamisesta olemme valmiita maksamaan erillistä ekstraa.Mikäli muutat työn perässä toiselta paikkakunnalta, voimme auttaa sinua asunnon hankinnassa. Odotamme sinulta alan koulutusta ja jonkin verran aikaisempaa työkokemusta raskaan kaluston parista, oikeaa asennetta ja vastuuntuntoa sekä tiimihenkeä. Suomen kielen C1 (Taitavan kielitaidon perustaso) vaaditaan työturvallisuuden vuoksi, sekä sujuvaan kommunikointiin muiden työntekijöiden ja asiakkaiden kanssa. Mikäli tämä työ kiinnostaa sinua, laita hakemuksesi tulemaan samantien sillä käymme niitä läpi jo hakuaikana ja paikka täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä. Toivomme sinulta:- Hyvää asennetta ja halua sitoutua mukavaan työpaikkaan ja työympäristöön- Joustavuutta työaikojen suhteen- Voimassa olevaa Työturvallisuuskorttia- Hyvää fyysistä kuntoa- Ajokorttia c-kortti iso plussa hakijalle- Oma-aloitteisuutta ja ahkeruutta- Mielellään kokemusta raskaan kaluston asennuksista  Tarjoamme sinulle: - Luotettavan ja hyvän työnantajan- Kattavan perehdytyksen työhön- Laadukkaat työvarusteet- Mahdollisuuden työllistyä pitkäaikaiseen työhön- Työterveyshuollon Palkkausperuste: Tuntipalkka 16,47-19,85 €/hBenevanilla arvostamme: - Luotettavuutta - tehdään mitä sovitaan- Asennetta -teet aina parhaasi ja olet oma-aloitteinen- Työturvallisuutta - arvostamme työntekijöitä, joille työturvallisuus on tärkeää- Uskallus tarttua uusiin haasteisiin

jobs.title: Vi søger forskellige erfarne mekanikere til spændende automotive virksomhed i Dragør
jobs.description:
RENTEQ Automotive søger efter tre praktiske og dygtige mekanikere, der kan tage hånd om skrueopgaver i forbindelse med konvertering fra diesel til el på primært maskiner og som har det rette mindset til at arbejde i en produktion, hvor processerne løbende optimeres.

Om RENTEQ Automotive

RENTEQ Automotive er en ung dansk virksomhed med en ambition om at reducere CO₂-udledningen ved at elektrificere varebiler og entreprenørmaskiner samt at bygge batteritrailere. Vi har udvikling i Dragør og produktion på vores fabrik i Gedved, og vi tager hele rejsen på os – fra ingeniørarbejde og udvikling helt frem til serieproduktion.

Jobbet

Som mekaniker på vores udviklingsværksted arbejder du med den praktiske af- og remontage på maskiner og andre køretøjer. Produktionen er stadig ung, så der er masser af plads til at forbedre den. Du arbejder tæt sammen med ingeniør- og produktionsteamet, bidrager til problemløsning tidligt og hjælper os med at bygge klogere fra gang til gang. Du er med til at sikre, at hver eneste komponent behandles korrekt og dokumenteres præcist, idet dit arbejde er fundamentet for hele konverteringsprojektet.

Dine typiske opgaver vil være:

●      Montage efter foreløbige arbejdsinstruktioner

●      Montering af elektriske komponenter, kabelføring og drivline i chassis og karosseri

●      Tilpasning og fejlfinding på komponenter i tæt samarbejde med elektronik- og software-teamet

●      Kvalitetskontrol og dokumentation af alle monteringssteps og fund undervejs i produktionen

●      Løbende forbedring af proces og arbejdsgange – du kan bidrage til de guider og checklister, vi udvikler

●      Sammen holder vi altid produktionen organiseret, udstyr vedligeholdt og processer dokumenteret for at sikre den højest mulige kvalitet.

Er det dig?

●      En central rolle i vores produktionsteam, hvor din praktiske viden sætter direkte aftryk på, hvordan vi konverterer maskiner

jobs.title: Er du dygtig til dit håndværk
jobs.description:
Klejnsmed søges til alsidig landsbysmedie i Allingåbro

Har du styr på dit håndværk, kan du svejse i sort stål, og trives du i et uformelt miljø, hvor tonen kan være kontant, men humøret er højt? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter!

På vegne af FK Smedie i Allingåbro søger Komplex A/S en dygtig og alsidig klejnsmed til et spændende vikarforløb med henblik på fastansættelse for den rette kandidat.

Om jobbet:

FK Smedie er det, man kalder en rigtig, klassisk landsbysmedie. Her producerer vi ikke én specifik ting – vi laver derimod alt muligt. Dine arbejdsdage vil aldrig være ens, og du vil komme til at arbejde med en bred vifte af forskellige smedeopgaver. Opgaverne spænder bredt fra reparationer og specialopgaver til diverse konstruktioner i sort stål.

Vi søger en kollega, der:

  • Er en dygtig håndværker: Du har stolthed omkring dit fag, har erfaring som klejnsmed (eller lignende) og kan dit kram.

  • Kan svejse i sort: Du har solid erfaring med bearbejdning og svejsning i sort stål.

  • Har en solid rygrad: Vi har et fantastisk sammenhold, men arbejdsmiljøet er præget af en til tider hård og direkte tone. Du skal kunne tage en joke, give et svar igen og trives med "værkstedshumør".

  • Er fleksibel og løsningsorienteret: Da vi laver alt muligt, skal du kunne omstille dig og tænke kreativt, når en ny udfordring lander på bordet.

Hvad tilbyder vi?

  • En arbejdsplads med stor variation i opgaverne – du kommer ikke til at kede dig!

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer samt ordnede forhold via Komplex A/S.

  • Mulighed for fastansættelse for den rette profil.

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Da vi mangler dig hurtigst muligt, behandler vi ansøgninger løbende. Send din ansøgning og dit CV med det samme via linket https://komplex.peopletrust.dk/candidate/?module=candidateweb&page=Job&action=readMore&jobId=1004340

jobs.title: Markkinoija / asiakashankkija (osa-aikainen)
jobs.description: Etsitään kasvuhenkistä markkinoijaa / asiakashankkijaa (osa-aikainen)Etsitkö joustavaa osa-aikatyötä opintojen ohelle tai lisäansaitsemiseksi? Haluatko päästä tekemään näkyvää tulosta ja kokeilemaan siipiesi kantoa käytännön markkinoinnissa ja asiakashankinnassa? Me Savon energiaratkaisut OY:llä etsimme tiimiimme markkinointi- ja uusasiakashankintavastaavaa. Roolissasi otat vetovastuun siitä, että oikeat asiakkaat löytävät meidät – ja me löydämme heidät.Mitä tehtävään kuuluu?Päätehtäväsi on yrityksemme näkyvyyden kasvattaminen ja uusien asiakasvirtojen avaaminen eri kanavissa. Sinulla on vapaus kokeilla eri menetelmiä ja löytää parhaiten toimivat tavat. Monikanavainen markkinointi: Sosiaalisen median kanavien (esim. LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok) hallinta, sisältöjen ideointi ja julkaisu. Proaktiivinen asiakashankinta: Potentiaalisten asiakkaiden tunnistaminen ja heidän tavoittamisensa verkossa (esim. suora lähestyminen, uutiskirjeet, kampanjat). Aktiivinen kokeilu: Hakukonekykyisyys (SEO), maksettu mainonta tai verkostoituminen – saat hyödyntää omia vahvuuksiasi ja oppia uutta. Seuranta: Tulosten analysointi yhteistyössä yrittäjän kanssa.Mitä toivomme sinulta?Oma-aloitteisuutta ja "tartutaan toimeen" -asennetta: Et jää odottamaan valmiita ohjeita, vaan uskallat ehdottaa ja testata eri kanavia. Ymmärrystä nykyaikaisesta markkinoinnista: Sujuvaa viestintää: Soveltuvia opintoja tai kokemusta: Esimerkiksi tradenomi-, kauppatieteiden tai viestinnän opinnot ovat eduksi, mutta aito kiinnostus tulokselliseen markkinointiin ratkaisee!Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?Joustavuuden: Työaika on n. \[esim. 10–15 h/vko\]. Voit tehdä työtä joustavasti opintojesi ja muun elämäsi aikataulujen mukaan. Etätyömahdollisuuden: Voit työskennellä pääosin etänä tai sopimuksen mukaan toimistoltamme käsin. Käytännön vastuuta: Pääset näkemään suoraan oman kädenjälkesi ja tuloksesi yrityksen kasvussa – tämä on erinomainen merkintä ansioluetteloon! Kilpailukykyisen palkan: Tuntipalkka + tulosbonus.Miten haet? jobs.title: Ajoneuvoasentaja Vaasaan
jobs.description:
Ajoneuvoasentaja Vaasaan!

Haemme asiakkaallemme ajoneuvoasentajaa kokoaikaiseen työsuhteeseen Vaasaan.

Nopeasta reagointikyvystään ja laadukkaasta kiinteistöpalvelustaan tunnettu yritys etsii nyt tiimin vahvistukseksi kokenutta ja ammattitaitoista ajoneuvoasentajaa.

Työtehtävät:

Asentajana vastaat yrityksen oman kaluston kuten pakettiautojen, pyöräkuormaajien ja muiden koneiden kunnossapidosta, huolloista, vianhausta ja korjaustöistä. Työ pitää sisällään monipuolisesti korjauksia, varusteluja, perushuoltoja sekä päivittäisen kaluston toimintakuntoon liittyviä tehtäviä yrityksen omalla korjaamolla. Toimit itsenäisesti ja varmistat omalla panoksellasi, että kentällä tarvittavat koneet ja autot pysyvät liikkeellä ilman turhia katkoksia.

Odotamme sinulta:

 * Soveltuvaa ammatillista koulutusta (esim. ajoneuvoasentaja, raskaskoneasentaja)
 * Käytännön kokemusta autojen ja työkoneiden huolto- ja korjaustöistä.
 * Sujuvaa suomen ja/tai ruotsinkielen taitoa.
 * Vastuullista työotetta, ongelmanratkaisukykyä ja halua pitää huolta siitä, että kalusto pysyy kunnossa.

Tarjoamme sinulle:

 * Vakituisen ja kokoaikaisen työpaikan vakavaraisella ja arvostetulla paikallisella toimijalla.
 * Vaihtelevan ja itsenäisen työnkuvan, jossa näet kättesi jäljen välittömästi.
 * Vakaat olosuhteet, hyvät työvälineet ja mukavan matalan hierarkian työyhteisön.
 * Palkkauksen osaamistasi ja kokemuksesi mukaan.

jobs.title: Supply chain manager (h/f) (H/F)
jobs.description: Safran est un groupe international de haute technologie opérant dans les domaines de l'aéronautique (propulsion, équipements et intérieurs), de l'espace et de la défense. Sa mission : contribuer durablement à un monde plus sûr, où le transport aérien devient toujours plus respectueux de l'environnement, plus confortable et plus accessible. Implanté sur tous les continents, le Groupe emploie 110 000 collaborateurs pour un chiffre d'affaires de 31,3 milliards d'euros en 2025, et occupe, seul ou en partenariat, des positions de premier plan mondial ou européen sur ses marchés. Safran est la 2ème entreprise du secteur aéronautique et défense du classement « World's Best Companies 2025 » du magazine TIME.Safran Helicopter Engines est le leader mondial des moteurs d'hélicoptères et le seul industriel à s'être spécialisé sur ce marché. Implantée dans le monde entier, la société emploie 6100 personnes dans le monde et possède plus de 2 500 clients répartis dans 155 pays et plus de 21 500 moteurs en service.Parce que nous sommes persuadés que chaque talent compte, nous valorisons et encourageons les candidatures de personnes en situation de handicap pour nos opportunités d'emploi.Descriptif missionAs Supply Chain Manager, you'll play a pivotal role in shaping and optimising our end-to-end supply chain. Reporting to the Chief Operating Officer, you'll lead strategic procurement, inventory control, and purchasing operations while overseeing Noria, Warranty, Pool, and Logistics activities that keep our production and commercial goals on track. This is a high-impact role where your ability to drive efficiency, ensure on-time delivery, and uphold quality standards will directly contribute to our success, while aligning the supply chain with the company's broader strategic vision.Key ResponsibilitiesAs the Supply Chain Manager, you will be responsible for leading and optimising key supply chain functions across inventory, logistics, procurement, and team management to support production and commercial goals. Your main responsibilities will include:Inventory Planning & Management:o Develop and maintain accurate inventory forecasts aligned with business needso Balance customer demand with inventory levels to optimise availability and minimise excess stocko Analyse consumption patterns, seasonal trends, and market dynamicso Manage repairable and unserviceable inventory, including buy-back processeso Monitor inventory usage to identify obsolescence risks and recommend solutionso Maintain stock accuracy through cycle counts, stocktakes, and proactive replenishment strategieso Collaborate with suppliers to resolve issues, improve service levels, and support sourcing initiativesLogistics Management:o Oversee transportation services, including providers, freight costs, customs compliance, and export controlso Ensure timely delivery of products and materials while optimising shipping efficiencyo Support warehousing operations, including material handling, storage, and dispatcho Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives in logistics and warehouse processesPurchasing & Procurement:o Maintain accurate supplier records and oversee onboarding of new vendorso Manage requests for quotations (RFQs) and source suppliers to meet business requirementso Maintain purchase orders and monitor subcontracted repair activitieso Evaluate vendor performance against quality, delivery, and cost standardsExport Control and Customs Complianceo Provide support to Export Compliance Officer, Customs Compliance Officer and Empowered Official in the execution of Safran Export Control and Customs Compliance Standards.Leadership & Team Management:o Lead, coach, and manage the supply chain team to achieve high performanceo Manage staff qualifications, training, leave, and performance managemento Provide support to Procurement Coordinator, Warehouse Supervisor, and Noria/Warranty/Pool Coordinator

jobs.title: Ingénieur / Ingénieure de développement informatique (H/F)
jobs.description: Chez Thales, nous sommes fiers de travailler ensemble pour imaginer des solutions innovantes qui contribuent à construire un avenir plus sûr, plus vert et plus inclusif. Un avenir de confiance. Mais ces technologies ne viennent pas de nulle part. L'intelligence humaine est le moteur derrière la technologie qui fait la renommée de Thales. Les projets que nous conduisons sont complexes et nos clients exigeants. Pour répondre aux besoins actuels et futurs de nos clients, nous maîtrisons plus d'une centaine de disciplines, de l'optique à la physique quantique, du traitement du signal à la connectivité et à l'intelligence artificielle. Rejoindre Thales, c'est repousser les limites de la technologie et la mettre au service du progrès et du développement durable de nos sociétés. C'est donc être au cœur d'une formidable aventure technique. Une attention portée à l'équilibre des collaborateurs au service de leur réussite. C'est pourquoi, notamment, nous nous efforçons de créer un environnement de travail accueillant et d'accorder la flexibilité nécessaire à l'équilibre entre vie professionnelle et vie personnelle. Nous savons que cet équilibre est essentiel à votre épanouissement et à la réussite des projets que nous vous confierons. Des parcours professionnels riches. Chez Thales, nous jouons collectif. Ce qui signifie travailler en équipe, côtoyer des experts et donc apprendre et développer ses compétences en permanence tout en faisant bénéficier le Groupe de son savoir-faire. C'est aussi la possibilité d'évoluer, de changer de fonction ou d'activité, voire de pays.    Lieu : Rennes, France    Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance    Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d'activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l'environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d'euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l'innovation tels que l'IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays.      Nos engagements, vos avantages     * Une réussite portée par notre excellence technologique, votre expérience et notre ambition partagée     * Un package de rémunération attractif     * Un développement des compétences en continu : parcours de formation, académies et communautés internes     * Un environnement inclusif, bienveillant et respectant l'équilibre des collaborateurs     * Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu    Votre quotidien    En nous rejoignant à Rennes, vous intégrez un site dynamique regroupant nos activités de services numériques permettant d'opérer les systèmes d'informations critiques de nos clients et de les accompagner dans leur transformation numérique sécurisée    Au sein de la direction APC (Automation Platforms & Cloud), en tant qu'Architecte Cloud GCP, vous serez responsable de la conception, de l'implémentation et de l'optimisation de nos solutions cloud sur la plateforme Google Cloud Platform. Vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la définition de notre stratégie cloud et accompagnerez nos équipes dans leur adoption des meilleures pratiques.    Description du projet / rôle / missions :     * Participer au cadrage de la compréhension de l'expression de besoin afin de proposer une solution adéquate / pertinente répondant aux exigences fonctionnelles et non-fonctionnelles. Comprendre les enjeux et les besoins de nos clients et les transcrire en solution technique.     * Assurer la conception de la solution en s'appuyant sur les services Cloud (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS...) en adéquation avec les besoins exprimés et la stratégie technique de l'Entreprise et les besoins de sécurité, en lien et en support avec les autres rôles et fonctions de l'Entreprise.     * Structurer et établir une stratégie de migration d'un parc applicatif dans le cadre d'un projet de Move To Cloud.     * Accompagner et échanger avec les équipes de réalisation sur la mise en place de la solution utilisant les infrastructures et services offerts par les Cloud providers, ainsi que la réalisation du Move To Cloud.    Votre Profil    Vous êtes diplômé(e) d'un Bac+5 en informatique (École d'ingénieur ou Master) avec une spécialisation en DevOps, Cloud ou Systèmes et une expérience significative d'au moins 4 ans en architecture de systèmes d'information, dont 2 années minimum dédiées à Google Cloud Platform.    Vous êtes certifié GCP Professional Cloud Architect ou GCP Professional Security Engineer et possédez les compétences suivantes:     * Expertise approfondie de Google Cloud Platform et de ses mécanismes de sécurité     * Maîtrise des services GCP : Cloud Identity, Security Command Center, Cloud KMS,...

jobs.description:
Imavere Saeveski

Tööülesanded: Otsid töökohta usaldusväärses ettevõttes? Stora Enso Eesti Imavere Saeveski pakub tööd MEHHATROONIKULE​ Usaldame Sulle järgmised tööülesanded:​ - tootmisseadmete (elektri-, automaatika- ja mehaanikaosade) hooldus, remont ja tõrkeotsing​ - andurite, ajamite, juhtseadmete, sagedusmuundurite ja teiste automaatikakomponentide kontrollimine ja häälestamine​ - masinate ja tootmisliinide ennetava hoolduse teostamine vastavalt hooldusplaanile​ - masinate töökindluse tõstmine: väiksemate arendus- ja täiustustööde teostamine​.

Omalt poolt pakume: - igapäevaselt on meie peamine prioriteet ohutus - tagame Sulle põhjaliku ohutuskoolituse ning isikukaitsevahendid​- väärtustame oma töötaja tervist, lisahüvena saad valida Stebby spordikompensatsiooni ja Meliva terviseplaani vahel​ - arenguvõimalusi koolituste ja mitmekesiste tööülesannete kaudu, mis aitavad Sul ka tõsta palgataset​ - isikliku sõiduki kütusekulude osalist hüvitamist - paljud meie töötajatest elavad saeveskist kaugemal, soovime tagada, et kellelgi ei tekiks tööle tuleku tõttu lisakulusid pelgalt vahemaa tõttu​ - kanname hoolt, et Sinu päev oleks täis energiat võimaldades osaliselt kompenseeritud toitlustust

Muud nõuded: Ootame Sinult:- tehnilist haridust elektroonika-, mehhatroonika-, elektri- või automaatika erialal varasemat kogemust puidutööstuses, eelistatult tööstusseadmete hoolduse, elektri- või automaatikasüsteemide valdkonnas - head arusaama elektriskeemidest, seadmete juhenditest ja tehnilistest joonistest - oskust diagnoosida ja lahendada mehaanika-, elektri- ja automaatikarikkeid - baasteadmisi anduritest, ajamitest, sagedusmuunduritest, pneumaatikast ja hüdraulikast - kasuks tuleb kogemus sagedusmuundurite, servosüsteemide või tööstuslike võrkudega (nt Profinet, Profibus), töökogemus PLC-dega (eelistatult Siemens), keevitus- või mehaanikaoskused ning kogemus tööstusautomaatika projektide või tehniliste arendustega - analüütilist mõtlemist, probleemilahendusoskust, täpsust, korrektsust - valmisolekut töötada meeskonnas ühise eesmärgi nimel ning samuti töötada iseseisvalt - valmidus töötada vahetustes

jobs.title: VP, Communication
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


VP of Communications, Replit

Replit is changing who gets to build software. As an agentic software creation platform, Replit enables anyone, from individual creators to teams inside the world’s largest companies, to turn natural language into applications, internal tools, dashboards, workflows, websites, and software that solves real problems.

We are looking for a Director or VP of Communications to lead Replit’s next chapter of storytelling, trust building, and market leadership.

This is a senior communications role for a creative, strategic, and hands-on leader who can build and scale the communications function as Replit grows from a beloved developer platform into a defining company in AI, software creation, and enterprise transformation. This person will own Replit’s external and internal communications strategy, including strategic positioning and company narrative, media relations, analyst relations, executive communications, internal communications, crisis communications, customer storytelling, flagship thought leadership, policy-related communications, and global awareness.

The role requires someone who can push through the noise, make the Replit story heard, and keep it part of the conversation. The Director / VP of Communications will develop a compelling narrative that evolves with the company, the product, and the market, and deliver it across media, policymakers, partners, customers, prospects, and employees. The role will also support Replit’s international awareness, with a focus on key markets in Europe and Asia.

This person must be both strategic and execution-oriented. They should have built or helped lead a communications function at a fast-growing technology company, or led communications and positioning for a leading institution. This is not a traditional press office role of adopting another company’s playbook in its entirety.

The person must be creative, scrappy, maybe even spiky: able to take what they know works as a foundation and build on it to make Replit a unique player that punches above its weight in a crowded, competitive marketplace.

Role

 - Lead and scale Replit’s communications function, including communications strategy, team structure, agency management, operating rhythms, and execution standards.

 - Build an AI-native communications function, with agents running repeatable work so a lean team focuses on judgment, relationships, and creative leaps.

 - Develop and evolve Replit’s corporate narrative as the company expands across AI, developer tools, enterprise, consumer, education, and global markets.

 - Own Replit’s strategic positioning: the upstream frameworks and intellectual capital that make every launch, stage, and story land better.

 - Lead communications programs across company announcements, product launches, enterprise momentum, customer stories, partnerships, policy-related issues, executive visibility, awards, events, and thought leadership.

 - Shape how the market understands Replit as an agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language.

 - Build clear, credible narratives around AI-powered software creation, developer productivity, enterprise adoption, security, governance, education, and the future of work.

 - Develop flagship thought leadership, signature reports, and third-party validator relationships that build enterprise and institutional trust.

 - Partner with the CEO, executive team, and functional leaders on positioning, reputation, media strategy, internal communications, and high-stakes company moments.

 - Build and maintain strong relationships with technology, business, AI, enterprise, developer, policy, and international media.

 - Partner closely with product, engineering, marketing, sales, partnerships, legal, policy, people, and finance to create coordinated communications programs that support company priorities.

 - Lead or support internal communications, including company meetings, leadership messaging, employee announcements, change communications, and moments that help the company stay aligned as it scales.

 - Manage proactive and reactive communications, including rapid response, issues management, crisis communications, and sensitive topics.

 - Prepare executives and spokespeople for media interviews, podcasts, conferences, customer events, internal moments, and industry presentations, and earn premier stages for Replit’s leaders.

 - Support Replit’s global communications strategy, with particular focus on expanding awareness in Europe and Asia.

 - Track the AI, software, developer, enterprise, startup, and policy landscape to identify where Replit should lead, respond, or reframe the conversation.

 - Build a communications culture that values speed, clarity, creativity, judgment, and proof.

Qualifications

 - BA/BS degree or equivalent practical experience.

 - 12+ years of experience in communications, PR, media, corporate affairs, or related fields for Director level; 15+ years for VP level.

 - Experience building, scaling, or significantly expanding a communications or strategic positioning function at a fast-growing technology company or leading institution.

 - Proven experience working directly with founders, CEOs, executives, and senior cross-functional leaders.

 - Strong relationships with technology, business, enterprise, AI, developer, and/or policy media.

 - Experience managing external agencies and cross-functional communications programs on a global level.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to tailor messages for users, developers, enterprise buyers, employees, policymakers, partners, and the press.

 - Strong understanding of the AI landscape and how AI is changing software development, enterprise productivity, and the future of work.

 - Hands-on fluency with AI and agentic tools, with a vision for AI-native communications operations.

 - Track record of flagship thought leadership: signature reports, executive platforms, and ideas that shape an industry’s conversation.

 - Experience earning third-party validation from leading institutions and policy communities for a scrutinized or emerging technology.

 - Experience guiding communications through major inflection points: public-company transitions, landmark policy moments, category creation.

 - Experience across several communications disciplines, including external communications, internal communications, media relations, executive communications, crisis communications, and strategic messaging.

 - Ability to translate complex technical ideas into clear, compelling stories without losing substance.

 - Cross-functional leadership experience, with the ability to influence and collaborate across product, engineering, sales, marketing, legal, policy, finance, and people teams.

 - Ability to see the big picture while operating in execution mode.

 - Passionate about their craft and the impact they can have.

 - Strong judgment in fast-moving, high-pressure environments.

 - A creative, resourceful, “do more with less” mindset.



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability

🚼 Paid Parental, Medical, Caregiver Leave

🏝 Flexible Time Off (FTO) + Holidays

🚗 Commuter Benefits  (In-Office & US Only)

📱 Monthly Wellness Stipend

🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment

🖥 In Office Set-Up Reimbursement (In-Office Only)

🚀 Quarterly Team Gatherings

☕ In Office Amenities (In-Office Only)

jobs.title: Erfaren cykelmekaniker med sans for salg søges
jobs.description:
Vi søger ikke bare en mekaniker – vi søger den person, der kan blive butikkens ansigt udadtil og tage ansvar, som var det sin egen forretning.

Er du en dygtig og selvstændig cykelmekaniker med solid erfaring? Trives du med ansvar, kundekontakt og en varieret hverdag, hvor du selv er med til at få butikken til at fungere? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter.

Om jobbet

Vi søger en erfaren cykelmekaniker, der kan tage ansvar for både butik og værksted i det daglige. Du skal være tryg ved at arbejde selvstændigt og kunne håndtere alt fra almindelige serviceeftersyn til fejlfinding og større reparationer på alle typer cykler, herunder ladcykler - har du erfaring med elcykler, er det et plus.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

* Har flere års erfaring som cykelmekaniker.

* Kan diagnosticere og løse alle typer mekaniske problemer på cykler.

* Er vant til at arbejde alene og tage ansvar for dagens opgaver.

* Er serviceminded og god til at rådgive kunder.

* Arbejder struktureret, effektivt og med fokus på kvalitet.

* Forstår at mersalg er en del af servicen.

Vi tilbyder

* En konkurrencedygtig løn, der matcher dine kvalifikationer.

* En varieret hverdag i en lille, lokal cykelbutik i Søborg.

* Stor frihed under ansvar og mulighed for at præge den daglige drift.

* Et uformelt arbejdsmiljø med korte beslutningsveje.

* Mulighed for at blive en vigtig del af en butik, hvor godt håndværk og god kundeservice er i fokus. Vi sætter pris på vores ⭐️'er.

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Så send din ansøgning og dit CV på mailen nedenunder. Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

Michelle Rasmussen

JM Cykler

jobs.title: Power Electronics Simulation Engineer, Tampere
jobs.description: About the roleThis is a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of power electronics and electrical grid technology. You will join a niche team of experts where your work directly impacts how high-voltage grids operate globally.In this position, you will be part of the NPI (New Product Introduction) team, focusing on the simulation and validation of advanced grid solutions. Your main tool will be the RTDS (Real-Time Digital Simulator), and your daily work involves Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) simulations. Because the role requires hands-on management of RTDS hardware and laboratory equipment, this position is fully office/lab-based in Tampere.Work tasksYour main responsibilities include:- Running and designing Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) simulations.- Managing and developing RTDS hardware setups.- Using Matlab &amp; Simulink for simulation and building test benches.- Analyzing fault situations and system performance in a high-voltage grid context.- Collaborating closely with design engineers to validate control systems.You are offered...- Long-term Mentorship: A thorough and supportive onboarding process into a niche technology area.- International Opportunities: While the base role is in Tampere, there is a possibility for global site assignments (1–2 years down the line) for those interested in international travel.- Cutting-edge Tech: Access to the latest simulation hardware and the chance to work on large-scale grid projects.We are looking forWe value potential and learning agility above all else. This is a highly specialized field, and we are prepared to provide long-term onboarding for the right person. Whether you are a recent graduate with a strong academic background or a professional looking to pivot into grid technology, your ability to grasp complex systems is what matters.Requirements:- Technical Education: A University degree (M.Sc.) in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics, or Control Engineering.- Control Theory: A deep understanding of the interface between power electronics and the electrical grid (control side expertise is critical).- Software Tools: Proficiency in Matlab &amp; Simulink.- Communication: Ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly in English (our primary working language).- Location: Readiness to work onsite in Tampere (no remote work option due to hardware requirements).We appreciate if you'll have...- Previous experience with RTDS, HIL testing, or high-voltage laboratories.- Familiarity with the power electronics industryOur recruitment processThis recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

jobs.title: Investment Analyst / Investment Manager - Green Energy & Infrastructure
jobs.employer: Impact Fund Denmark (tidl. Investeringsfonden for Udviklingslande)
jobs.description:
Are you motivated by making green commercial investments across Africa, Asia, and Latin America?

Impact Fund Denmark is Denmark’s largest impact fund and is internationally recognized as a best-in-class impact investor.  We manage our own private equity funds, debt capital, and concessional capital with a focus on creating sustainable businesses that deliver measurable social, economic and climate impact alongside solid financial returns.

We are strengthening our Green Energy and Infrastructure team and are looking for an Investment Professional to join us in our headquarters in Copenhagen. Depending on your experience, you may join us as Investment Analyst or Investment Manager.

Green Energy and Infrastructure invests in businesses and infrastructure that accelerate the green transition in emerging markets. Our investment focus spans renewable energy, circular economy, electric mobility, and water infrastructure. Through equity and debt investments, active ownership and strategic partnerships, we drive impact and value creation aligned with the Sustainable Development Goals. We typically invest between DKK 100-350 million per transaction.

You will be reporting to a Managing Director in Green Energy and Infrastructure and work closely with colleagues in Copenhagen and our regional offices across Europe, Africa, Asia and Latin America on investments throughout the investment lifecycle.

 

Investment Analyst

As an Investment Analyst, you will be a key analytical resource in transaction teams, focusing on commercial and financial analysis of investment opportunities.

You will:

  • Screen and analyse new investment proposals using Impact Fund Denmark’s tools and processes.

  • Assist in preparing investment papers, financial analyses and financial modelling.

  • Support due diligence, valuation and deal structuring.

  • Contribute to preparing and presenting investment recommendations and materials for the investment committee and board.

  • Collect and analyse commercial and financial data for deal teams.

  • Help maintain information systems for pipeline tracking and portfolio data.

  • Participate in networking activities to support investment sourcing and promotion.

  • Support project managers in active ownership and portfolio monitoring.

  • Ensure timely and accurate updates of systems with project documents, and financial and sustainability reporting.

  • Assist in assessing exit timing and support execution.

 

Qualifications:

  • Master’s degree in a relevant field, such as finance or economics with strong academic results.

  • 1-2 years of relevant experience from impact investing, private equity, M&A, corporate finance or consulting.

  • Solid understanding of financial analysis and valuation.

  • Skilled user of Excel and with an interest in and aptitude for financial modelling.

  • Detail-oriented with a structured working approach.

  • Fluent in English (written and spoken).

  • Curious to broaden your understanding of the world and keen to travel.

 

Investment Manager

As an Investment Manager, you will take the lead on many of the tasks performed by an Investment Analyst. You are thus expected to work independently, drive workstreams, and take ownership of parts of the investment process.

You will:

  • Screen and analyse new investment proposals using Impact Fund Denmark’s tools and processes.

  • Lead preparation of parts of investment papers, financial analyses and financial modelling with guidance from the project manager (Senior Investment Manager or Investment Director).

  • Support and lead due diligence, valuation and deal structuring workstreams.

  • Contribute to preparing and presenting investment recommendations and materials for the investment committee and board.

  • Lead the analysis of commercial and financial data for deal teams.

  • Take part in negotiating terms and drafting legal documentation.

  • Help maintain information systems for pipeline tracking and portfolio data.

  • Participate in networking activities to support investment sourcing and promotion.

  • Support project managers in active ownership and portfolio monitoring.

  • Assist in assessing exit timing and support exit negotiations and execution.

 

Qualifications:

  • Master’s degree in a relevant field such as finance or economics with strong academic results.

  • 3-5 years of relevant experience from impact investing, private equity, M&A, corporate finance or consulting.

  • Independent mindset and experienced in owning and managing workstreams.

  • Solid understanding of financial analysis and valuation.

  • Expert user of Excel and with an interest in and aptitude for financial modelling.

  • Detail-oriented with a structured working approach.

  • Fluent in English (written and spoken).

  • Strong interpersonal skills and business judgment.

  • Curious to broaden your understanding of the world and keen to travel.

  • Experience in emerging markets and green energy is an advantage but not a prerequisite.

 

Working at Impact Fund Denmark

Learning is an important element of working in Impact Fund Denmark, and we will support your personal development through training, sparring and by ensuring that you get exciting and challenging tasks and new opportunities for growth. When joining Impact Fund Denmark, you will take part in our extensive onboarding program to get the best possible start in your new role.

We have a diverse and inclusive working environment with more than 170 talented individuals from 30+ different nationalities. We work seamlessly together with colleagues around the corner, across the organisation and between offices in Asia, Africa, Latin America and Europe.

About Impact Fund Denmark

Impact Fund Denmark (IFU – the Investment Fund for Developing Countries) is a Danish impact investor contributing to green, just and inclusive societies as well as supporting the Sustainable Development Goals. Impact Fund Denmark provides risk capital to companies operating in developing countries across Africa, Asia, Latin America and parts of Europe. Investments are made on commercial terms in the form of equity, loans and guarantees. Impact Fund Denmark has co-invested in over 1,300 companies in more than 100 developing countries and emerging markets. Contracted investments total EUR 31 billion, of which Impact Fund Denmark has contributed EUR 3.4 billion. Capital under management will be growing from EUR 2.1 billion to EUR 5.0 billion over the next few years. Read more at Impact Fund Denmark

jobs.title: Vi søger en sælger/mødebooker – deltid eller fuldtid | Varme leads, fleksibelt skema og meningsfuldt salg
jobs.description:
Vi søger en elevrådgiver til Vinduespudserskolen – deltid eller fuldtid

Kunne du tænke dig at arbejde med mennesker og hjælpe dem med at finde ud af, om de skal tage springet og starte deres egen forretning?

På Vinduespudserskolen hjælper vi personer med at skifte deres nuværende job ud med deres egen vinduespudserforretning. Eleverne lærer håndværket fysisk på skolen i København og modtager grundig undervisning i forretningsudvikling. Tilsammen giver det dem fundamentet til at bygge en succesfuld vinduespudserforretning.

Vi søger nu en ny kollega, der skal tale med de mange personer, som henvender sig til os med interesse for skolen, og hjælpe dem med at finde ud af, om det er det rigtige valg for dem.

Dine primære opgaver bliver at:

  • Tale med potentielle elever, der allerede har vist interesse for Vinduespudserskolen.

  • Sætte dig ind i deres nuværende situation, baggrund, ambitioner og hvad de gerne vil opnå.

  • Rådgive dem om vores undervisningsforløb, og hvad det kræver at starte sin egen vinduespudserforretning.

  • Hjælpe dem med at vurdere, om skolen og livet som selvstændig er det rigtige match for dem.

  • Følge op på interesserede elever via telefon, SMS og e-mail.

  • Hjælpe de rette personer videre med tilmeldingen til skolen.

Du kommer til at tale med mennesker med vidt forskellige baggrunde og livssituationer. Nogle har været lønmodtagere hele livet, andre driver allerede virksomhed, og nogle står måske midt i et større skifte i deres liv.

For mange er det en stor beslutning, både personligt og økonomisk. Derfor handler jobbet ikke om at overtale nogen til at starte, men om at forstå deres situation og rådgive dem ordentligt.

Vi optager heller ikke nødvendigvis alle, der ønsker at starte. Vores elever bliver en del af et fællesskab, hvor vi kommer til at bruge mange timer sammen, både under undervisningen og efterfølgende. Derfor er det vigtigt for os, at vi lærer folk ordentligt at kende, inden de starter.

Du kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med Asger og Malte, som også står for din oplæring. Vi forventer ikke, at du kender noget til vinduespudsning på forhånd, men du skal have lyst til at sætte dig grundigt ind i vores forløb, så du med tiden kan rådgive potentielle elever på egen hånd.

Vi forventer, at du:

  • Har erfaring med rådgivning, salg eller anden form for kundekontakt, eller blot har lyst til at lære det.

  • Kan lide at tale i telefon og gerne tager mange samtaler i løbet af en dag.

  • Er god til at forstå forskellige mennesker og deres situation.

  • Er god til at lytte, stille spørgsmål og give ærlig rådgivning, også når skolen ikke er det rigtige valg for personen.

  • Kan arbejde fysisk fra vores kontor i København.

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for dine egne opgaver.

  • Trives i en virksomhed, der arbejder som en startup med mange selvstændige og engagerede mennesker.

  • Føler dig hjemme i jargonen på en skole med over 500 elever, som nok bedst kan beskrives som ”en masse meget friske fyre”.

Du behøver ikke have mange års erfaring med salg eller rådgivning. Det vigtigste er, at du er god til mennesker, nysgerrig og har lyst til at lære.

Arbejdstid og praktisk information

Vi er åbne for både deltids- og fuldtidsansættelse, men forestiller os især, at stillingen kunne passe godt til en studerende, der gerne vil have et fleksibelt job ved siden af studiet.

Arbejdstiden ligger mellem kl. 9 og 18 på hverdage, og vi er meget fleksible med planlægningen. Det betyder eksempelvis, at du sagtens kan arbejde 10 timer den ene uge og 30 timer den næste, alt efter hvordan det passer med dit studie eller andre forpligtelser.

Arbejdet foregår fysisk på vores kontor på Vestergade i København, hvor du bliver en del af teamet og får en grundig oplæring.

Løn efter kvalifikationer med mulighed for bonusordning.

Er du ikke selv den rette, men kender du en, så anbefal endelig vedkommende. Vi ansætter, så snart vi finder den rigtige, med opstart hurtigst muligt.

Læs mere og ansøg på linket her https://www.vinduespudserskolen.dk/job-key-account-manager
