We are currently seeking a full-time Field Phlebotomy Supervisor interested in joining a high-growth stage startup. The mandate of the Field Phlebotomy Supervisor is simple but challenging: assist our Operations Manager with the day-to-day operations throughout the market and ensure our patients have the best experience possible.

 

The Field Phlebotomy Supervisor oversees the quality of territories patient operations. You will be responsible for ensuring that every Getlabs experience meets and exceeds the patient's expectations. You will also help train and ensure quality for our team of hourly phlebotomists.  Above all, we are seeking candidates who are self-starters and are resourceful, organized, detail-oriented, communicative, and friendly.

 

This position is currently limited to candidates residing within a one-hour commute of the San Francisco Bay Area.

  • Interview and hire new mobile phlebotomists

What we are looking for:

jobs.title: Solutions Engineer
jobs.description:
Consequential Work. Dedicated People.


About Onebrief

Onebrief builds collaboration and AI-powered workflow software for military planning and operational coordination.

Military planning is complex by nature, requiring teams to coordinate information, people, and decisions across systems and locations. Onebrief brings planning, collaboration, simulation, and AI into one connected environment, helping teams test strategies, adapt to changing conditions, and make decisions with greater clarity when the stakes are real.

We are a distributed team of builders from military, operational, and technology backgrounds who care deeply about improving how important work gets done. Some team members work remotely, while others work directly alongside customers in operational environments around the world.

Founded in 2019, Onebrief is backed by leading investors including General Catalyst, Battery Ventures, Insight Partners, Sapphire Ventures, and Human Capital. Valued at more than $2 billion, we continue to invest in product innovation, AI capabilities, and team growth.

Why This Role Exists

As a Solutions Engineer at Onebrief, you work where mission, engineering, and compliance meet.

You'll own technical solution design and deployment readiness, translating customer requirements into secure, scalable deployment architectures. You'll partner with Platform Engineering, SRE, and our Cybersecurity team to validate infrastructure, configure environments, resolve technical blockers, and successfully transition solutions into production.

Youâll work with our go-to-market and customer facing teams to meet with planners, operations officers, and network owners to understand how they work today. Youâll help show them what that work looks like in Onebrief, and then you'll make it real.

You connect a staff's planning problem to a live, accredited Onebrief deployment.

What You'll Do

Core responsibilities:

  • Run technical discovery. With Sales and Engineering, map a staff's current workflow and pain points, specifically focusing on their technical constraints: networks, hosting, identity, and integration requirements, especially in multi-network environments.

  • Lead deployment engineering. Coordinate the technical delivery of new deployments, including infrastructure validation, network configuration checks, and system readiness verification. Write code to configure new deployments and support new environments.

  • Support accreditation. Help create and review security documentation, including STIG checklists and ATO artifacts, alongside our cybersecurity team so deployments are accredited on the customer's timeline.

  • Align stakeholders. Get technical stakeholders on both sides to agree on requirements, constraints, and tradeoffs, so customers see value sooner. Ensure those technical requirements are properly translated into contract deliverables.

  • Scope integrations. Design how Onebrief Connect fits into a command's ecosystem: APIs, data pipelines, Foundry and Maven Smart System, CUOPS tools, and dashboards.

  • Deliver tailored demos. Lead technical demonstrations and solution validation, partnering with Sales and customer-facing teams to demonstrate Onebrief's technical capabilities, deployment architecture, security posture, and integration options.

  • Run pilot deployments. Configure Onebrief in new and untested environments to enable limited uses in support of new sales.

  • Turn field experience into patterns. Convert what you learn in deployments into structured workflows and reusable implementation patterns, and feed clear requirements to Product and Engineering.

  • Travel 30â50% of the time to customer sites and exercises.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Top Secret clearance with SCI eligibility.

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

  • 4+ years in solutions engineering, infrastructure or deployment engineering, or forward-deployed engineering, working closely with go-to-market and operational teams

  • Experience in DoW environments and their security and compliance requirements (RMF, STIGs, ICD 503)

  • Strong expertise with containers (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes)

  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and on-premises virtualization (RHEL)

  • Solid understanding of networking concepts and protocols, and of security best practices for highly sensitive environments

  • Strong presence with customers, from action officers to senior leaders, and clear, concise writing

  • Calm under pressure, and focused on forward motion

Preferred Qualifications

  • Proficiency in a scripting language (Python, Go, or Bash)

  • Infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible)

  • Monitoring and logging tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Datadog) and service mesh (Istio, Linkerd)

  • Experience as a military planner or staff officer, or with mission command systems, Foundry, or Maven Smart System

  • Presales experience, including building and delivering demos


Notice to Third Party Recruitment Agencies

In the event a recruiter or agency submits a resume or candidate without an agreement Onebrief explicitly reserves the right to pursue and hire those candidate(s) without any financial obligation to the recruiter or agency. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to hiring managers, shall be deemed the property of Onebrief.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Compute Platform
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



About the role: 

We are seeking talented distributed systems engineers who are passionate about building innovative solutions for application deployment. Your mission will be to enhance the capabilities of Replit Infrastructure, optimize performance across global regions, and drive efficiency while delivering an exceptional user experience. If you have a strong foundation in software development, a deep understanding of cloud technologies, and a track record of delivering high-quality code, we want to hear from you. 



In this role you will:

 - Expand Replit's cloud infrastructure offerings: Launch new cloud products to be used by Replit Agent to build complex apps. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design and implement these features, empowering developers with a comprehensive suite of tools to build and deploy their applications efficiently.

 - Enhance reliability and scalability: Identify bottlenecks, optimize critical paths, and implement robust monitoring and alerting systems. Work closely with the SRE team to ensure high availability and minimal downtime. Enable our customers to seamlessly scale their applications to meet the demands of their growing user base.

 - Improve utilization of cloud infrastructure: Analyze our infrastructure costs and identify opportunities for optimization. Implement strategies to reduce cloud expenses without compromising performance or reliability. This could involve techniques such as resource provisioning, auto-scaling, cost-aware scheduling, and data lifecycle management. Your efforts will directly contribute to the financial efficiency of our cloud services.



Required skills and experience:

 - Distributed systems: Track record of working with platform-as-a-service, distributed storage, or information retrieval systems. Experience in designing scalable architectures and optimizing systems for latency or cost. 

 - Problem-solving mindset: Ability to approach complex challenges pragmatically and devise effective solutions. You think radically but ship incrementally.

 - Self-directed and autonomous: Able to work independently, set priorities, and drive projects forward. You take ownership and initiative.

 - Versatility and flexibility: Able to wear multiple hats and tackle a wide range of challenges. You are comfortable working across different layers of the stack and adapting to the needs of the project.

 - Continuous learning and adaptability: Passionate about staying up-to-date with industry trends and expanding your skill set. You embrace change and adapt quickly.



Nice to have:

 - Experience working on cloud infrastructure or platform products, particularly in the areas of application deployment, serverless computing, or container orchestration.

 - Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services and tools, such as GCE, GKE,, Cloud Run, or Cloud Storage.

 - Contributions to open-source projects related to cloud technologies, deployment frameworks, or developer tools. We love OSS!



Tools + Tech Stack for this role

 - Golang, Rust



This role may not be a fit if

 - You are a generalist backend engineer who hasn’t built scalable distributed systems.

 - You cannot take part in the oncall rotation of min 6 people.

 - You do not enjoy diving into Linux internals. 



This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The hybrid role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability

🚼 Paid Parental, Medical, Caregiver Leave

🏝 Flexible Time Off (FTO) + Holidays

🚗 Commuter Benefits  (In-Office & US Only)

📱 Monthly Wellness Stipend

🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment

🖥 In Office Set-Up Reimbursement (In-Office Only)

🚀 Quarterly Team Gatherings

☕ In Office Amenities (In-Office Only)



Want to learn more about what we are up to?

Interviewing + Culture at Replit

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer (image & video generation)
jobs.description:
Working language: English (Estonian not required). Remote; Tallinn optional.

Work tasks: MyArchitectAI is AI rendering software for architects and interior designers. Users upload a design and get a photorealistic render in seconds that keeps their geometry and materials. Then they can swap materials, change lighting and objects, upscale, or turn the still into a video. We're a small founder-led team and we move fast. Our working language is English. We're looking for an engineer who rapidly turns promising image- and video-generation techniques into evaluated, shipped MyArchitectAI features. This is hands-on product building: not pure research, and not a pure inference/infrastructure job. - In your first 30 days you ship a meaningful improvement, scoped with a founder: a new AI capability, a quality or speed gain, an evaluation system, or automation of manual work. You back it with visual examples and numbers. - By 60 days you find an opportunity yourself (new models, user data, weak spots in our pipeline), propose it and ship it. - By 90 days you have three or more shipped contributions and own the loop: find → evaluate → build → validate → ship → learn. - You keep a clear view of new models, techniques and competitors without chasing novelty for its own sake.

We offer: - Working directly with the founders, with real impact on the product.- GPU access. - Remote work; Tallinn optional. - Employment contract or contractor agreement, as you prefer. - English is our working language; Estonian is not required. - Salary negotiable.

Other requirements: You have:- Hands-on work with generative image or video models (not only LLMs, RAG or agents). - At least one shipped product, deployed feature, meaningful open-source contribution, or convincing end-to-end project, and you can say exactly what you built. - Experience running experiments and making quality vs. speed vs. cost decisions. - The engineering skills to take a notebook or demo into a real product (Python, production-quality code). - Good written English (our working language). Estonian is not required. Nice to have: Diffusers, ComfyUI, ControlNet-style conditioning, inpainting and editing, LoRA and fine-tuning, video models, upscaling; your own evaluation datasets or benchmarks; GPU deployment and optimisation; 3D, AEC, CAD, rendering or interiors; public code, demos, models or write-ups.

Option to work from home: Yes

jobs.title: Junior AI Engineer (image & video generation)
jobs.description:
Working language: English (Estonian not required). Remote; Tallinn optional

Work tasks: MyArchitectAI is AI rendering software for architects and interior designers. Users upload a design and get a photorealistic render in seconds that keeps their geometry and materials. Then they can swap materials, change lighting and objects, upscale, or turn the still into a video. We're a small founder-led team and we move fast. Our working language is English. We're looking for an early-career engineer who is already building things with generative image or video models on their own initiative. We care more about how fast you're improving than about your CV, and we want someone to grow with us for the long term. - In your first month you learn the product, the model pipelines and the quality bar, and ship a small but real improvement with a founder: a workflow, an evaluation script, a fix for a failing case, or an automation that removes manual work. - By three months you own a recurring piece of work end to end, such as maintaining an evaluation set, triaging generation failures, or keeping a model pipeline current. You ship several contributions, at least one you proposed yourself. - You read the research and release notes, try things, measure them, and report what they're worth. - After 6–12 months you take on features with just a goal and a deadline.

We offer: - Daily mentoring from the founders and real tasks from week one.- GPU access. - Remote work; Tallinn optional. - Employment contract or contractor agreement, as you prefer. - English is our working language; Estonian is not required. - Room to grow with us for years. - Salary about €3,000 net per month (approx. €3,700–3,900 gross).

Other requirements: You have: - Public things you built yourself with image or video models: code, LoRAs, ComfyUI workflows, small apps or documented experiments. - Meaningful work in the last six months, with a trail going back at least a few months. - You're early in your career: student, self-taught, bootcamp, first or second job, or changing careers. - You can explain what you built, why it failed the first time, and how you knew it improved. - Written English good enough to work with two founders every day (our working language). Estonian is not required. Big plus: Comparisons or small benchmarks you ran yourself, with a conclusion; running models on modest hardware (quantisation, memory, speed); reimplementing a paper or technique; helpful, precise answers in GitHub issues or Discord; small things with real users (a Hugging Face Space, a bot, a plugin).

Option to work from home: Yes

jobs.title: Outcomes Architect Manager
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Notion is reimagining how customers adopt, expand, and realize value from software in an AI-native world. As a first-line leader directly managing a team of Outcomes Architects, you’ll own your team’s execution across workflow adoption, value realization, renewal readiness, expansion qualification, and at-risk account recovery — accountable for both the customer outcomes and the quality of execution that produces them.

This isn’t a traditional Customer Success management role. The best OA Managers are coaches first: they know what great workflow discovery looks like, can review a mutual success plan and identify where value realization is breaking down, can inspect an executive business review and sharpen the value narrative, and can help an OA turn account activity into measurable customer and commercial outcomes.

You’ll run an inspection cadence and cultivate a coaching culture that make consistent execution possible across the team. You’ll partner closely with Solutions Consultant leaders, Sales, Services, Support, Product, and RevOps to ensure customers move from workflow design to adoption, value realization, expansion, and renewal readiness.

If you’re a builder who loves developing people as much as driving customer impact — and you want to lead a team in a post-sales motion that’s being redefined for the AI era — this is the role.

 


WHAT YOU’LL ACHIEVE

 - Own the Net Revenue Growth performance of your team’s book of business, accountable for both headline outcomes and the quality of execution that drives workflow adoption, value realization, renewal readiness, and expansion.

 - Coach OAs on the OA builder motion: AI Transformation Plans, build-beside workshops, value reviews, use-case consultations, and renewal processes.

 - Build and run the operating cadence for the team: metrics reviews, account support sessions, adoption and renewal-risk reviews, call coaching against the OA quality rubric, and forecast calls with senior leadership.

 - Hire, onboard, and certify new OAs to the GTM builder motion, driving readiness from ramp through consistent execution and managing performance with clarity when expectations are not met.

 - Partner closely with Solutions Consultant managers and leaders on strategy for expansion and renewal across shared accounts, ensuring clear ownership for flat and at-risk renewals.

 - Partner with Services leadership to identify complex implementation needs early, create clear handoffs, and ensure Services delivery accelerates workflow adoption and measurable value.

 - Set the standard for product, AI, and workflow fluency across the team so OAs can help customers navigate new ways of working and build durable systems in Notion.

 - Represent your team or region in leadership forums with clear signal on what's working, what needs investment, and where execution is breaking down

 - Uphold excellence by coaching to the global OA methodology, quality rubric, and activity KPIs.
   
    


SKILLS YOU’LL NEED TO BRING

 - Frontline management experience leading customer-facing GTM teams in B2B software, ideally across Customer Success, Solutions Consulting, Technical Account Management, Professional Services, Account Management, or post-sales strategy.

 - Direct experience coaching teams through customer discovery, workflow design, adoption planning, value realization, renewals, expansion, or technical/workflow implementation.

 - Strong coaching orientation: you can review a customer call, account plan, mutual success plan, or executive value narrative and identify specifically what needs to change — not just whether the outcome was good, but why and how to improve it.

 - Commercial instincts at the team level: able to read account health, renewal risk, adoption depth, expansion potential, and customer sentiment, then drive urgency without micromanaging every account.

 - Deep customer-facing discovery instincts, with the ability to understand business problems, map workflows, and translate goals into practical adoption and implementation plans.

 - Experience operating in a shared account ownership model with Sales, Solutions, Services, Support, or Implementation teams.

 - Operational rigor: you know how to build inspection cadences, coaching rituals, performance standards, and accountability systems that improve execution across a team.

 - Ability to develop talent from onboarding through consistent performance, including hiring to profile, setting clear expectations, coaching skill gaps, and managing performance with clarity.

 - Executive communication skills: able to synthesize account patterns, customer risks, team performance, and cross-functional asks into clear signal for leadership.

 - Technical fluency and presence as a trusted advisor. You do not need to build every workflow yourself, but you should be able to understand Notion systems, coach workflow design, and help your team troubleshoot adoption blockers.

 - You operate with agency, urgency, and customer empathy, bringing structure to ambiguous problems and helping teams move from ideas to working systems.

 - You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious, hands-on, and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter, coach better, and help customers deliver better outcomes.
   
    


NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience managing in a consumption, usage-based, or product-led business where adoption signals matter as much as renewal or expansion outcomes.

 - Track record building high-performing frontline teams from an early stage: hiring to profile, structured onboarding, certification, coaching, and performance management.

 - Experience leading teams through GTM motion changes, coverage-model shifts, or evolving commercial ownership.

 - Experience working with flat, at-risk, or complex renewal accounts and helping teams return customers to a clear value path.

 - Experience partnering closely with Solutions Consulting, Sales, Services, or Implementation teams in a shared customer lifecycle model.

 - Familiarity with AI transformation, workflow automation, agents, or collaboration/work management software.

The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role's scope and complexity, and the candidate's experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. jobs.description:
Vi søger en erfaren 1.assistent til Fyn

Er du serviceminded og kan lide et job med meget kørsel?

SMP Rengøringsservice er i rivende udvikling og søger derfor en erfaren medarbejder på fuldtid (37t), til vores i forvejen stærke team på Fyn.

Som 1.assistent er dit ansvar at sikre afviklingen af den daglige rengøring i samarbejde med din Serviceinspektør

Andre opgaver kan også forekomme.

Du vil have direkte reference til din Serviceinspektør hos SMP rengøringsservice. Jobbet indebærer b.la. følgende arbejdsområder:

•   Skal stå for rengøring af egne pladser og øvrig bemanding iht. rengøringskalenderen

•   Skabe god relation til kunderne

•   Være behjælpelig med afløsning ved. ferie/sygdom

•   Hjælpe ved opstart af nye kunder og opgaver sammen med Serviceinspektør

Det skal forventes, at timer kan ligge både tidlig morgen, eftermiddag og aften.

 

Hvem er du?

 

Vi søger dig, som trives i en omskiftelig hverdag, hvor opgaverne og dagene aldrig er ens.

Det er ikke vigtigt for dig, at du har faste rammer mandag-fredag fra 8-16, men tværtimod trives du med en flydende hverdag, hvor arbejdsugen kan variere med forskellige tidspunkter på dagen.

Som person kan du nikke genkendende til, at du:

•   Har erfaring med erhvervsrengøring

•   deler telefonvagt efter forudgående aftale

•   Kan håndtere og omgås forskellige kulturer

Du får stillet en firmabil til rådighed, samt firmatelefon- iPad, og arbejdsbeklædning.

Vi glæder os meget til at lære dig at kende - så hvis du kan se dig selv i denne stilling, bedes du sende din ansøgning til: job@smpservice.dk  - husk at mærke ansøgningen ” 1.assistent Fyn”

SMP er en velrenommeret virksomhed i rengøringsbranchen, - og det vil vi gerne blive ved med at være

jobs.title: Udviklingscenter for Børn og Familier søger familieplejekonsulent.
jobs.description:
Udviklingscenter for Børn og Familier søger familieplejekonsulent.

Vil du være med til at skabe de bedst mulige rammer for børn og unge, der er anbragt i plejefamilie? Og trives du i et arbejde, hvor faglighed, relationer, koordinering og tæt tværfagligt samarbejde går hånd i hånd, så er det måske dig, vi søger som vores nye familieplejekonsulent.

Familieplejen er en del af Udviklingscenter for Børn og Familier (UBF) og består af fire familieplejekonsulenter. Vores fælles mål er at finde de bedst mulige løsninger for det enkelte barn eller unge, når der er behov for anbringelse i plejefamilie.

I Familieplejen i Næstved Kommune arbejder vi ud fra en vision om, at alle anbragte børn og unge skal sikres et godt børneliv og have bedre muligheder i deres voksenliv. Vi har samtidig et stærkt fokus på, at børn og unge får mulighed for at udfolde og udvikle deres evner og kompetencer – både individuelt og i fællesskab med andre.

Vi arbejder ud fra, at børn og unge, der har behov for en familieanbringelse, fortrinsvis skal anbringes i netværkspleje eller plejefamilie frem for på institution, når det er den rette løsning for barnet.

Et tæt samarbejde med myndighed er en central del af jobbet

Som familieplejekonsulent bliver du en vigtig del af det samlede arbejde omkring barnet eller den unge. Du vil derfor have et tæt og forpligtende samarbejde med Børn- og unge rådgivere i Næstved Kommune.

Familieplejekonsulenter og sagsbehandleren har forskellige roller og ansvarsområder, men skal kunne arbejde tæt sammen om at skabe sammenhæng i indsatsen. Det kræver, at du kan indgå i en åben, konstruktiv og professionel dialog – også når sagerne er komplekse, eller perspektiverne er forskellige.

Du skal kunne koordinere, følge op, dele relevante faglige observationer og bidrage aktivt til fælles løsninger, samtidig med at du kan fastholde dit eget faglige ansvar og perspektiv.

Det er derfor vigtigt for os, at du har gode samarbejdsevner, er tydelig i din kommunikation og kan skabe tillidsfulde relationer til både myndighedssagsbehandlere, plejefamilier, børn og unge samt øvrige samarbejdspartnere.

Støtte, råd og vejledning til plejefamilierne

En central del af opgaven som familieplejekonsulent er at understøtte plejefamilierne i deres vigtige og til tider krævende opgave med at skabe trygge og udviklende rammer for de anbragte børn og unge. Du skal kunne tilbyde løbende støtte, faglig rådgivning og vejledning med udgangspunkt i det enkelte barns behov og plejefamiliens aktuelle udfordringer. Det indebærer blandt andet at hjælpe plejefamilierne med at forstå og håndtere barnets reaktioner, adfærd og følelsesmæssige behov samt understøtte deres kompetencer i at skabe stabilitet, trivsel og udvikling i hverdagen. Du skal kunne skabe et tillidsfuldt samarbejde med plejefamilierne, facilitere faglig refleksion og bidrage med konkrete pædagogiske perspektiver og handlemuligheder. Derudover skal du kunne identificere behov for yderligere støtte og indgå i en tæt dialog med relevante samarbejdspartnere for at sikre en helhedsorienteret indsats omkring barnet eller den unge. Rollen indebærer derfor også at være bindeled mellem myndighed og plejefamilien.

Vi forventer, at du

  • Er uddannet pædagog, socialrådgiver eller har anden relevant socialfaglig uddannelse – gerne med relevant efteruddannelse, 
  • Arbejder helhedsorienteret og har blik for at inddrage relevante ressourcer omkring barnet, den unge og plejefamilien.
  • Har erfaring med tæt tværfagligt samarbejde og trives med at samarbejde med rådgivere og andre fagprofessionelle.
  • Kan skabe og vedligeholde professionelle relationer – også i komplekse og krævende situationer.
  • Er tydelig og anerkendende i din kommunikation og kan håndtere forskellige faglige perspektiver på en konstruktiv måde.
  • Kan formidle komplekse problemstillinger både mundtligt og skriftligt og udarbejde præcis og fagligt velfunderet dokumentation.
  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt, struktureret og ansvarsfuldt og samtidig være en aktiv del af et kollegialt fællesskab.
  • Har et skarpt blik for børn og unges trivsel og udvikling.
  • Har kørekort og kan stille egen bil til rådighed.

Plejefamilierne modtager supervision i grupper. Det forventes, at du har erfaring med supervision og kan supervisere minde gruppe. Hvis du ikke allerede har denne erfaring, skal du gennemføre relevant kursus eller supervisoruddannelse som en del af din ansættelse.

Vi tilbyder

  • Et fagligt stærkt team med fire familieplejekonsulenter
  • En arbejdsplads, hvor et godt arbejdsmiljø prioriteres højt.
  • Mulighed for faglig udvikling, supervision og løbende faglig sparring
  • Stor fleksibilitet og indflydelse på din arbejdstilrettelæggelse.
  • En arbejdsplads med høj aktivitet, hvor dagene aldrig er ens.
  • Et kollegialt fællesskab, hvor faglige refleksioner og videndeling er en naturlig del af hverdagen.
  • Samarbejde med vore mange plejefamilier.
  • Mulighed for at deltage i temadage og kompetenceudvikling for plejefamilier i samarbejde med andre kommuner.

Løn og ansættelsesforholdLøn- og ansættelsesvilkår sker i henhold til gældende overenskomst mellem den forhandlingsberettigede organisation.  

Oplysninger om startløn og forventet løninterval  

Via linket her kan ses oplysninger om relevant løninterval for den konkrete stilling. I oversigten vælges Næstved Kommune, hvilken stillingskategori (overenskomst) du ansøger til og yderligere hvilken stilling du søger. I tabellen derunder kan ses de relevante oplysninger for den konkrete stilling.

jobs.title: Senior Electrical Engineer, Technical Lead; DK - Frederikshavn
jobs.description:
Do you have a strong electrical background and are you motivated by technical leadership and the opportunity to help shape the construction of Denmark’s new Arctic ships? As Senior Electrical Engineer, Technical Lead at Semco Maritime, you will take ownership of the electrical installation scope in a nationally significant naval project.Your position In this role, you will be part of a multidisciplinary team working closely with design, procurement, fabrication, and quality control. You will help turn technical requirements and design into practical, high-quality installation solutions and ensure efficient production throughout all phases of shipbuilding, in compliance with naval and classification standards. The final title will depend on your experience and qualifications.Your work will have a direct impact on the successful delivery of the Arctic ships and on the continued development of the Danish naval shipbuilding industry.The position will be based in Frederikshavn, where the Arctic ships will be assembled, and is a full-time, permanent position.Your tasks & responsibilities As Senior Electrical Engineer, Technical Lead you will plan, coordinate, and lead the electrical installation scope throughout ship production, ensuring alignment between engineering, procurement, suppliers, and production teams.Your tasks will include, but are not limited to:
  • Defining and planning electrical installation methods from design through production, including installation sequencing, equipment installation, and coordination with relevant stakeholders
  • Participating in the production engineering process to support quality, safety, and efficiency
  • Supporting the development of electrical discipline project plans and resource estimates
  • Lead parts of the installations scope when in construction
  • Acting as the technical point of contact internally and with suppliers for electrical and instrumentation matters
  • Providing technical input to procurement and defining requirements for electrical installation equipment and tools
  • Ensuring compliance with naval, military, and classification standards as well as health, safety, and environmental requirements
Your profile & qualificationsWe are looking for a proactive and responsible engineer who can act as lead by combining strong technical understanding with hands-on problem-solving skills.You work in a structured and quality-focused way, communicate clearly across disciplines, and bring high personal integrity and strong safety awareness.Even if you do not meet all the desired experience requirements, we encourage you to apply if you believe you are a talented individual with the right mindset, strong motivation, and a willingness to learn and grow in the roleTo succeed in this role, we expect that you have:
  • A BSc or MSc in marine or electrical engineering
  • Solid experience in shipbuilding, heavy industry or offshore projects (oil and gas / wind)
  • Min. 5 years relevant experience
  • Familiarity with international classification rules, such as DNV or ABS
  • Fluency in English, written and spoken
  • Danish language skills
  • Knowledge of naval or defence standards would be an advantage

jobs.title: Vil du arbejde med salg, hvor det handler mere om at hjælpe end at sælge?
jobs.description:
Vi søger en elevrådgiver til Vinduespudserskolen – deltid eller fuldtid

Kunne du tænke dig at arbejde med mennesker og hjælpe dem med at finde ud af, om de skal tage springet og starte deres egen forretning?

På Vinduespudserskolen hjælper vi personer med at skifte deres nuværende job ud med deres egen vinduespudserforretning. Eleverne lærer håndværket fysisk på skolen i København og modtager grundig undervisning i forretningsudvikling. Tilsammen giver det dem fundamentet til at bygge en succesfuld vinduespudserforretning.

Vi søger nu en ny kollega, der skal tale med de mange personer, som henvender sig til os med interesse for skolen, og hjælpe dem med at finde ud af, om det er det rigtige valg for dem.

Dine primære opgaver bliver at:

  • Tale med potentielle elever, der allerede har vist interesse for Vinduespudserskolen.

  • Sætte dig ind i deres nuværende situation, baggrund, ambitioner og hvad de gerne vil opnå.

  • Rådgive dem om vores undervisningsforløb, og hvad det kræver at starte sin egen vinduespudserforretning.

  • Hjælpe dem med at vurdere, om skolen og livet som selvstændig er det rigtige match for dem.

  • Følge op på interesserede elever via telefon, SMS og e-mail.

  • Hjælpe de rette personer videre med tilmeldingen til skolen.

Du kommer til at tale med mennesker med vidt forskellige baggrunde og livssituationer. Nogle har været lønmodtagere hele livet, andre driver allerede virksomhed, og nogle står måske midt i et større skifte i deres liv.

For mange er det en stor beslutning, både personligt og økonomisk. Derfor handler jobbet ikke om at overtale nogen til at starte, men om at forstå deres situation og rådgive dem ordentligt.

Vi optager heller ikke nødvendigvis alle, der ønsker at starte. Vores elever bliver en del af et fællesskab, hvor vi kommer til at bruge mange timer sammen, både under undervisningen og efterfølgende. Derfor er det vigtigt for os, at vi lærer folk ordentligt at kende, inden de starter.

Du kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med Asger og Malte, som også står for din oplæring. Vi forventer ikke, at du kender noget til vinduespudsning på forhånd, men du skal have lyst til at sætte dig grundigt ind i vores forløb, så du med tiden kan rådgive potentielle elever på egen hånd.

Vi forventer, at du:

  • Har erfaring med rådgivning, salg eller anden form for kundekontakt, eller blot har lyst til at lære det.

  • Kan lide at tale i telefon og gerne tager mange samtaler i løbet af en dag.

  • Er god til at forstå forskellige mennesker og deres situation.

  • Er god til at lytte, stille spørgsmål og give ærlig rådgivning, også når skolen ikke er det rigtige valg for personen.

  • Kan arbejde fysisk fra vores kontor i København.

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for dine egne opgaver.

  • Trives i en virksomhed, der arbejder som en startup med mange selvstændige og engagerede mennesker.

  • Føler dig hjemme i jargonen på en skole med over 500 elever, som nok bedst kan beskrives som ”en masse meget friske fyre”.

Du behøver ikke have mange års erfaring med salg eller rådgivning. Det vigtigste er, at du er god til mennesker, nysgerrig og har lyst til at lære.

Arbejdstid og praktisk information

Vi er åbne for både deltids- og fuldtidsansættelse, men forestiller os især, at stillingen kunne passe godt til en studerende, der gerne vil have et fleksibelt job ved siden af studiet.

Arbejdstiden ligger mellem kl. 9 og 18 på hverdage, og vi er meget fleksible med planlægningen. Det betyder eksempelvis, at du sagtens kan arbejde 10 timer den ene uge og 30 timer den næste, alt efter hvordan det passer med dit studie eller andre forpligtelser.

Arbejdet foregår fysisk på vores kontor på Vestergade i København, hvor du bliver en del af teamet og får en grundig oplæring.

Løn efter kvalifikationer med mulighed for bonusordning.

Er du ikke selv den rette, men kender du en, så anbefal endelig vedkommende. Vi ansætter, så snart vi finder den rigtige, med opstart hurtigst muligt.

Læs mere og ansøg på linket her https://www.vinduespudserskolen.dk/job-key-account-manager

jobs.title: Vi søger betonchauffør til Unicon i Trekantsområdet
jobs.description:
Vil du køre nogle af Danmarks mest ikoniske lastbiler og være med til at levere fundamentet for fremtidens byggeri?

Hos Unicon søger vi en betonchauffør til vores fabrikker i Trekantsområdet. Som betonchauffør hos os er du meget mere end chauffør. Du er en vigtig del af støbningen og den, der sikrer, at betonen kommer sikkert frem, i den rette kvalitet og på det rigtige tidspunkt.

Du trives naturligvis bag rattet i en stor bil, men mindst lige så vigtigt er det, at du kan samarbejde med kollegerne på fabrikken og med kunderne på byggepladserne. Alle dage afsluttes på fabrikken, så du slipper for overnatninger i bilen.

Du bliver en vigtig del af byggepladsen

 

Som betonchauffør hos Unicon kører du betonen fra fabrikken til byggepladsen, hvor du samarbejder med både kunden, pumpechaufføren og kollegerne om at få støbningen til at forløbe som planlagt.

Du leverer ikke bare et produkt – du er med til at sikre, at byggeriet kan fortsætte.

Nogle leverancer losses direkte fra bilens bånd, mens andre overføres til en betonpumpe. Derfor er det vigtigt, at du kan samarbejde med de mennesker, der modtager betonen, og bidrage til, at arbejdet udføres sikkert og effektivt.

Du kommer til at navigere på byggepladser, hvor pladsen ofte er trang, og hvor præcision og overblik er afgørende. Det kræver gode køreevner, sikkerhedsfokus og evnen til at holde hovedet koldt, når forholdene er udfordrende.

Mere byggeplads end landevej

 

Hvis du drømmer om lange ture gennem Europa, er dette nok ikke det rette job.

Som betonchauffør hos Unicon kører du typisk mange korte ture mellem fabrikken og lokale byggepladser. Til gengæld bliver du en del af byggeprojekterne og får en hverdag med tæt kontakt til kunder, kolleger og samarbejdspartnere.

Det er et job for dig, der kan lide variation, ansvar og en arbejdsdag, hvor du gør en synlig forskel.

Hvem er du?

 

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har stort kørekort inkl. hænger/trailer (CE)

  • Har EU-bevis

  • Har fokus på din egen og andres sikkerhed

  • Trives med at køre og manøvrere store køretøjer under krævende forhold

  • Er serviceminded og professionel i mødet med kunderne

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for dine leverancer

  • Har fysik til rengøring og vedligeholdelse af bilen

  • Holder orden omkring dig og dit materiel

Det er en fordel, hvis du har krancertifikat eller erfaring fra bygge-, entreprenør- eller transportbranchen, men det er ikke et krav.

Derfor skal du vælge Unicon

 

Hos Unicon bliver du en del af Danmarks førende betonproducent og et stærkt fagligt fællesskab, hvor sikkerhed, kvalitet og samarbejde går hånd i hånd.

Vi tilbyder:

  • Branchens bedste ansættelsesforhold

  • Grundig oplæring og introduktion til jobbet

  • Moderne materiel og gode arbejdsforhold

  • Betalt arbejdstøjsordning inklusive vask

  • Gode udviklingsmuligheder – både fagligt og personligt

  • En unik holdånd og stærkt kollegialt fællesskab

  • Overenskomst gennem Dansk Industri og 3F

  • En hverdag med selvstændighed og ansvar

En arbejdsdag, hvor kunderne er med til at sætte dagsordenen

 

Som betonchauffør er din arbejdsdag styret af byggepladsernes behov og dagens leverancer.

Du får typisk besked om mødetid den følgende dag om eftermiddagen, når næste dags produktion og leverancer er planlagt. Arbejdsdagen slutter, når den sidste tur er kørt og bilen er vasket. Du kommer derfor hjem hver dag og slipper for overnatninger i bilen. Derfor er det ikke et traditionelt 7-15-job, og nogle dage kan blive kortere end forventet, mens andre dage bliver længere. Overarbejde forekommer jævnligt, men bliver naturligvis honoreret, og vi har gode muligheder for både udbetaling og opsparing af afspadsering, som mange af vores chauffører bruger til hele fridage.

Hvis du trives med variation, ansvar og en hverdag, hvor opgaven bliver gjort færdig, vil du passe godt ind hos os.

Sådan bliver du en del af holdet

 

Med udgangspunkt fra en eller flere af vores fabrikker i Trekantsområdet bliver du en del af et stærkt team af chauffører og kolleger, som hver dag arbejder sammen om at levere beton til nogle af områdets vigtigste byggeprojekter.

Du refererer til fabrikkens daglige leder.

Kan du se dig selv i rollen, hører vi gerne fra dig.

Send din ansøgning og dit CV hurtigst muligt. Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte fabriksleder Tobias Meier Jørgensen på telefon 2871 4678 eller områdechef Kent Florczak på telefon 29254481.

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi finder den rette kandidat.

 

Om Unicon 

Unicon Danmark tilbyder lige muligheder for alle og har aktivt fokus på at fremme et arbejdsmiljø, der er fri for diskrimination, og hvor medarbejdere behandles med værdighed og respekt. I vores virksomhed er ansættelse baseret på den enkeltes fortjenester og kvalifikationer, som er direkte relateret til kompetencekrav i jobbet. Vi diskriminerer ikke nogen medarbejder eller jobansøger baseret på race, etnicitet, nationalitet, herkomst, genetiske oplysninger, statsborgerskab, religion, alder, køn, kønsidentitet/udtryk, seksuel orientering, graviditet, civilstand, handicap eller andre beskyttede karakteristika efter gældende love eller regler. Vi overholder disse principper i alle aspekter af ansættelse, herunder rekruttering, ansættelse, uddannelse, kompensation, forfremmelse og fordele.

jobs.title: 2 Mekanikere/montører søges til spændende automotive virksomhed i Horsens N, Gedved
jobs.description:
RENTEQ Automotive søger efter praktiske og dygtige mekanikere/montører, der kan tage hånd om den mekaniske/eltekniske montage på vores fabrik i Gedved, og som har det rette mindset til at arbejde i en produktion, hvor processerne løbende optimeres.

Om RENTEQ Automotive

RENTEQ Automotive er en ung dansk virksomhed med en ambition om at reducere CO₂-udledningen ved at elektrificere varebiler og entreprenørmaskiner og opbygge batteritrailere. Vi har udvikling i Dragør og produktion på vores fabrik i Gedved, og vi tager hele rejsen på os – fra ingeniørarbejde og udvikling helt frem til serieproduktion.

Jobbet

Som mekaniker/montør hos os arbejder du med den praktiske montage på produktionslinjen – primært opbygning af vores Vanteq, på sigt også entreprenørmaskiner og vores batteritrailer.

Produktionen er stadig ung, så der er masser af plads til at forbedre den. Du arbejder tæt sammen med ingeniør- og produktionsteamet, bidrager til problemløsning tidligt og hjælper os med at bygge klogere fra gang til gang. Du er med til at sikre, at hver eneste komponent behandles korrekt og dokumenteres præcist, idet dit arbejde er fundamentet for hele konverteringsprojektet.

Dine typiske opgaver vil være:

●      Montage af Vanteq på produktionslinjen – efter fastlagte arbejdsinstruktioner

●      Montering af elektriske komponenter, kabelføring og drivline i chassis og karosseri

●      Tilpasning og fejlfinding på komponenter i tæt samarbejde med elektronik- og software-teamet

●      Kvalitetskontrol og dokumentation af alle monteringssteps og fund undervejs i produktionen

●      Løbende forbedring af proces og arbejdsgange – du kan bidrage til de guider og checklister, vi udvikler

●      Primært arbejde med Vanteq – og også entreprenørmaskiner kommer nok også ind i Gedved

●      Sammen holder vi altid produktionen organiseret, udstyr vedligeholdt og processer dokumenteret for at sikre den højest mulige kvalitet.

Er det dig?

Vi leder efter en person med solid praktisk erfaring og en tilgang, der kombinerer præcision med fleksibilitet. Vigtigst er, at du kan arbejde selvstændigt, men også er dygtig til at samarbejde i et team, der hele tiden lærer og udvikler sig. Det vil være en fordel, hvis du kan nikke ja til nedenstående:

●      Erfaring med montering og demontering af motor, hydrauliksystem og brændstofkomponenter på landbrugsmaskiner, entreprenørmaskiner eller varebiler

●      Solidt kendskab til mekaniske systemer, væskesystemer og elektriske grundelementer

●      Ideelt set en stærk interesse for elektrificering

●      AC-kursus eller tilsvarende (ikke obligatorisk, men en stor fordel)

●      Evnen til at arbejde struktureret og dokumentere dit arbejde

●      Selvstændighed og ansvar, men også åbenhed over for feedback og samarbejde

●      Tålmodighed og en positiv tilgang til arbejde i et udviklingsmiljø, hvor vi hele tiden forfiner processen

●      Dansk på højt niveau; fungerende engelsk er en fordel, da vi er et internationalt team.

Vi tilbyder

●      En central rolle i vores produktionsteam, hvor din praktiske viden sætter direkte aftryk på, hvordan vi konverterer maskiner

●      Mulighed for at påvirke og udforme arbejdsprocesserne – dine idéer og erfaringer bliver hørt

●      En fast rytme i produktionen med arbejde på Vanteq og på sigt flere maskintyper

●      Tæt samarbejde med dygtige ingeniører og et uformelt, kollegialt team

●      Ordentlige faciliteter, godt værktøj og en støttende arbejdskultur

●      Løn: 190-240 kr./t afhængig af kompetencer og erfaring

●      Reelle muligheder for at vokse fagligt og personligt i takt med, at virksomheden udvikler sig.

Sådan søger du

Send dit CV og et par linjer om dig selv og din erfaring til kasper@ren-teq.com. Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende og inviterer relevante kandidater til en uformel første samtale – så vent ikke for længe med at tage kontakt.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte fabrikschef Kasper Nissen på kasper@ren-teq.com eller på 25414020

jobs.title: Senior Authorised Person (SAP) – Switching Leader
jobs.description:
Senior Authorised Person (SAP) – Electrical Operations / Switching Leader

Location: DenmarkEmployment type: Full-timeEmployer: Global Nordics

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Senior Authorised Person (SAP) / Switching Leader (Koblingsleder) to support electrical operations on a major engineering project in Denmark.

The successful candidate will be responsible for coordinating safe switching operations, electrical isolations and safety procedures across high-voltage (HV) and low-voltage (LV) electrical systems.

The position operates within an established electrical safety management structure, under the designated Operation Manager (Driftsansvarlig Person), and in accordance with applicable Danish electrical safety regulations and EN 50110-1.

Key Responsibilities

  • Plan, coordinate and oversee HV and LV switching operations.

  • Prepare and review switching schedules and electrical safety documentation.

  • Coordinate electrical isolations, earthing and safe access procedures.

  • Prepare, issue and cancel safety documents within the scope of assigned authorisation.

  • Coordinate with Control Engineers and electrical work teams during operational activities.

  • Ensure appropriate safety precautions are implemented before electrical work begins.

  • Supervise and coordinate personnel involved in electrical operational activities.

  • Support commissioning, energisation and electrical system handover.

  • Maintain accurate switching records, operational logs and safety documentation.

  • Participate in safety audits, risk assessments and toolbox talks.

  • Ensure compliance with site-specific electrical safety procedures and applicable Danish regulations.

Qualifications and Experience

  • Relevant qualification in electrical engineering or equivalent professional experience.

  • Extensive experience working with HV and LV electrical systems.

  • Previous experience as a Senior Authorised Person, Switching Leader, Control Engineer or equivalent.

  • Strong understanding of electrical switching, isolation, earthing and safe working procedures.

  • Knowledge of EN 50110-1 and electrical safety management systems.

  • Experience preparing switching schedules and electrical safety documentation.

  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate electrical work teams and operational activities.

  • Strong communication, organisational and safety leadership skills.

  • Good command of English.

Electrical Safety Requirements

The successful candidate will undergo a competence assessment and receive the necessary written operational appointment and authorisation under the project's Danish electrical safety management arrangements (KLS-D) before undertaking regulated electrical activities.

The role does not include statutory Operation Manager responsibilities or electrical installation work requiring separate company authorisation.

Application

Please submit your CV, relevant qualifications and details of your professional experience.

 - Curiosity to learn country-specific requirements as Notion expands.

We want People Ops that feels like a great mechanical watch: you never think about it, and it's never wrong.

Imagine the first day at a company where every laptop, login, and handshake worked on the first try. That's the bar.

We're looking for a Head of People Operations to lead that work. You'll shape the strategy across People Operations and Total Rewards operations, making everyday work simpler, more reliable, and increasingly agent-enabled.

This is a player-coach role. You'll develop the team, set direction, and stay hands-on, especially as you learn Notion. You'll combine operational craft with thoughtful automation, keeping care and human judgment at the center of every sensitive decision.

 - Build the experience behind the experience. Every hire, change, leave, and farewell runs through the systems you design.

 - Lead a team that wears many hats. You'll coach, set the roadmap, and still get your hands dirty. No boredom guaranteed.

 - Join at a moment of growth. Notion is scaling, and there's a real green field to build something simple and lasting.

 - Work across the whole company. Partner with People, Finance, Payroll, Legal, IT, and BizTech to make handoffs smooth and change stick.

 - Put agents to work, thoughtfully. Test and scale useful workflows with validation and human review. (Automate the busy work, never the judgment.)

 - Lead the team and set the roadmap. Clear ownership, clear priorities, and room for people to grow.

 - Build reliable lifecycle workflows. Onboarding, employee changes, leaves, and offboarding, with clear intake, service standards, and escalation paths.

 - Run Total Rewards operations. Own routine compensation and benefits operations, from cycle readiness and data changes to Payroll handoffs, with accuracy and good judgment on exceptions.

 - Measure what matters. Use service, quality, and adoption data to keep improving, with data integrity and audit readiness built in.

 - Make change stick. Align partners across the company and drive adoption.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - You've led a People Operations team in a shared services model and built scalable processes in a growing company, while staying hands-on.

 - You've built People programs and operational processes from the ground up.

 - You know compensation administration and benefits well, with sound judgment on approvals and exceptions.

  • Follow all process control documentation.

  • Report any unsanitary practice and/or unsafe condition.

  • Follow all food safety, health and safety, company rules and standards.

  • Regular and timely attendance is expected for the position.

Remote   |   Independent Contractor   

Prove your skills. Get certified. 

Robotics AI is advancing rapidly, and high-quality video data helps intelligent systems better understand the world around them. We are inviting detail-oriented professionals to complete our certification process for potential robotics AI projects.

As part of the certification process, you will demonstrate your ability to:

  • Assess the clarity and plausibility of movements.

  • Apply instructions consistently and identify potential quality issues.

▌ What you bring

  • Strong attention to detail and analytical thinking.

  • Strong written English and the ability to follow detailed instructions independently.

  • A commitment to accuracy and consistency.

  • No previous AI or robotics experience required.

You may review short videos and be asked to tag objects or actions, rate video clarity or camera angles on a 1 to 10 scale, or assess whether movements are clearly visible and plausible.

jobs.title: Head of the Nordic-Baltic Cyber Consortium (NBCC)
jobs.description:
About the positionThe Danish Resilience Agency (SAMSIK) is seeking a highly experienced and strategic leader to serve as Head of the Nordic-Baltic Cyber Consortium (NBCC).The NBCC is a Danish-hosted, EU-supported cybersecurity initiative established under the EU Cyber Solidarity Act. The consortium brings together Denmark, Estonia, Finland, Iceland, Latvia, Lithuania and Norway to build and operate a regional cyber hub that strengthens situational awareness and analytical capacity across the Nordic-Baltic region.As Head of the NBCC, you will be responsible for establishing and leading a new international organisation of strategic importance to both regional and European cybersecurity. While formally employed by the Danish Resilience Agency, you will report to the NBCC Executive Board, composed of senior representatives from the participating national cybersecurity authorities, and operate in close coordination with EU institutions.The position is based in Copenhagen, Denmark.Key responsibilitiesStrategic leadership and governance

  • Provide overall strategic direction and leadership of the NBCC in line with EU objectives, consortium agreements and national mandates.

  • Develop, implement and continuously adjust the NBCC’s strategic roadmap, including the phased build-up from initial deployment to full operational capability.

  • Ensure alignment between the NBCC activities, EU cybersecurity policies and the strategic interests of participating member states.

Management, organisation and budget

  • Act as head of the NBCC organisation, including direct line management of up to eight permanent staff based in Denmark and professional oversight of national analysts located in each participating member state.

  • Build and lead a cohesive multinational organisation with a shared operational culture, while managing differing national frameworks and practices.

  • Ensure sound financial management, reporting and documentation in accordance with EU and national requirements.

Operational responsibility

  • Hold overall responsibility for the NBCC’s operational delivery, including the secure and reliable operation of platforms for cyber threat intelligence sharing, analytical collaboration and communication.

  • Ensure structured and timely sharing of relevant cyber threat information and contribution to regional and European situational awareness.

About youTo succeed in this role, we expect that you:

  • Have proven experience leading multinational or international cooperation involving multiple stakeholders and governance layers; experience from Nordic-Baltic cooperation is a strong advantage.

  • Possess a strong understanding of cyber threat intelligence, incident response ecosystems and information-sharing mechanisms at national and international level.

  • Have demonstrated experience with EU cooperation, preferably including EU-funded projects and engagement with EU institutions.

  • Are able to operate confidently at senior political and administrative levels, nationally and internationally.

  • Can demonstrate strong regional insight and experience, for example from a Nordic or Baltic cybersecurity authority or a comparable organisation.

In addition, you:

  • Exercise strong strategic judgement and are able to balance political, operational and technical considerations.

  • Have excellent leadership and communication skills and are able to build trust across national and organisational boundaries.

  • Are fully proficient in English; knowledge of one or more Nordic or Baltic languages is an advantage. Danish language skills are not required.

About the Danish Resilience AgencyThe Danish Resilience Agency is under the authority of the Danish Ministry for Resilience and Preparedness. The agency is responsible for tasks related to cybersecurity, crisis management, physical security and protection of critical infrastructure.We advise and support authorities, companies and key societal functions in preventing and managing incidents and crises. The agency currently employs approximately 300 staff members working across disciplines in a highly engaged and mission-driven environment.About the NBCCThe NBCC is a Nordic-Baltic cybersecurity cooperation supported by the EU. Through the NBCC, the participating countries jointly establish and operate a regional cyber hub that enhances collective situational awareness and analytical capacity.The NBCC will jointly procure cybersecurity capabilities with the EU, employ analysts in Copenhagen and across the member states, and contribute to the European Cybersecurity Shield. The NBCC is organised as a distinct entity within the Danish Resilience Agency and is accountable to its Executive Board.As Head of the NBCC, you will be responsible for building this organisation from the ground up and for strengthening collective regional resilience against cyber threats.Salary and terms of employmentSalary and terms of employment will depend on qualifications and experience and will be determined in accordance with the collective agreements applicable to employees in the Danish state. The area of employment is the Danish Ministry for Resilience and Preparedness.Employment is conditional on obtaining and maintaining a Danish security clearance at SECRET (DK: HEMMELIGT) level for the duration of employment.The position is a fixed-term appointment for a period of 4 years, with the possibility of extension.The position is full-time 37-hours per week, and the duty station is Holsteinsgade 63, 2100 Copenhagen.To be eligible for employment EU/EEA Citizens are required to obtain an EU residence document as proof of your right to reside and work in Denmark. Non-EU/EEA Citizens must hold a valid residence and work permit before you can begin working in Denmark. Citizens of Sweden, Norway, Finland, or Iceland do not require a residence or work permit to live and work in Denmark. For more detailed information regarding the regulations for your specific citizenship, please visit: New to Denmark and/or Info Norden | Nordisk SamarbejdeIf the position is filled by an applicant not currently residing in Denmark, the Danish Resilience Agency is prepared to offer a relocation package of up to 45.000 DKK. Any other costs related to relocation or housing must be covered by the employee.Are you interested?Please submit your application via the “Apply” button on this page. Your application must be received by the recruitment system no later than 15th November 2026 and must include a CV and relevant diplomas of education.For further information about the position, please contact Kia Slæbæk Jensen at +45 2134 1851 or Morten Bro at +45 2178 4257.All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply regardless of personal background.Applications may be shared with participants from the employment committee from all participating countries.

jobs.title: Declaration of interest regarding PhD project: The Department of Psychology at University of Southern Denmark (SDU) is looking for applicants for a PhD fellowship within the field of philosophy
jobs.description:
Declaration of interest regarding PhD project:

The Department of Psychology at University of Southern Denmark (SDU) is looking for applicants for a PhD fellowship within the field of philosophy, with background in one or more of the following areas: philosophy of psychiatry, philosophy of emotion, phenomenology.We are looking for a person with a relevant degree (M.A., MSc. etc.) in philosophy or a related field. Starting date is September 1st, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter. The position is fully funded, full-time, for three years. The PhD degree will be awarded by the Faculty of Health Sciences.

 

Research environment

The PhD student will be based in the research group of Applied and Interdisciplinary Phenomenology in the Department of Psychology, SDU, at the Odense campus. The research group develops, disseminates, and applies methods to support cutting-edge research into subjectivity and the nature of human experience. Current group members have backgrounds in philosophy, psychology, anthropology, neuroscience, environmental studies, and pain research.

The group directly supports the professional development of its members, most of whom are postdocs or PhD students. In addition to receiving support from the project team, the PhD student will be supported by the broader group to develop their research, presentation, and teaching skills, as well as other academic skills, including those required for organizing academic activities such as workshops and conferences and for successful grant-writing. The PhD student will therefore be provided with the requisite knowledge and skills for pursuing an academic career in Europe or abroad.

The PhD student will also be provided with a work computer and a dedicated workspace at the Department of Psychology.

 

Project description

The PhD student will be part of the project, Understanding Experiences of Mood Disturbances in Depression (DEPMOOD), led by Anthony Vincent Fernandez. The project is funded by Independent Research Fund Denmark and runs for four years, starting September 1st, 2026. The PhD student will join the project for the final three years, collaborating with the PI, a psychology postdoc, and several external partners in Europe and the US, including philosophers, clinical psychologists, and psychiatrists.

The aim of the project is to establish a taxonomy of the variety of mood disturbances experienced by people diagnosed with depression, providing more precise characterizations of symptoms than those currently offered by concepts such as “depressed mood” or “anhedonia”. The project combines philosophical and qualitative methods, and includes in-depth interviews with people diagnosed with depression. The PhD student will not be expected to carry out interviews, as these will be conducted by the postdoc and external project partners. The PhD student’s primary role will be to help analyze the interview data using a combination of qualitative and philosophical methods. Their PhD thesis will therefore be a theoretical contribution, but will build upon the project’s empirical dataset.

In addition to producing a thesis, the PhD student will be required to take a variety of short PhD courses, carry out an international research stay, and fulfil light teaching duties.

The PhD student will be provided with DKK 10,000 per year for travel. Additional funds may be available.

 

Qualifications

Before the start date of September 1st, 2027, the applicant should have a master’s degree in philosophy or a related field and total course credits equivalent to 300 ECTS. Typically, this is a total of at least five years of education combined between bachelor’s and master’s degrees, with 60 ECTS obtained for every full year of study.

The candidate should have a background in philosophy of psychiatry, philosophy of emotion, and/or phenomenology. Familiarity with qualitative research methods (especially analysis methods) is an advantage, but by no means required.

The candidate should be proficient in English. Proficiency in Danish or another Scandinavian language may be an advantage, but is not required.

For further information about the project, please contact:Anthony Vincent Fernandez

Department of Psychology

University of Southern Denmark (SDU)

E-mail: afernandez@health.sdu.dk

Please note that while we are happy to provide answers to questions about the position and application process, direct feedback on application materials cannot be provided.

Applications must include (in English, or with a certified English translation):

 

  1. A letter stating the interest, motivation and qualifications for the project (max. 2 pages) - upload under “Application form”.

  2. Detailed CV, including personal contact information as well as any publications or presentations

  3. Certified copy of diploma and transcripts (Master’s degree in a relevant field). If the applicant is in the process of completing their master’s degree, they should provide transcripts along with a letter from their supervisor confirming expected completion of their degree before September 1st, 2027.

  4. Writing sample of maximum 10,000 words (e.g., publication, conference paper, selection from a master’s thesis). If the sample exceeds this length, please indicate which section should be read.

  5. A document listing 2-3 references, with contact information and a brief note about your relation to the reference. Note that reference letters will only be requested for candidates invited to interview. 

At this stage, no project proposal is required. Candidates invited to interview will be asked to prepare a brief project plan.

Please do not use generative AI in the formulation of any application materials. The purpose of these materials is to gain a clear sense of you and your abilities.

Shortlisting and interviews may be used in the assessment process. 

For purposes of evaluation and assessment, application materials may be shared with external members of the project team at Aarhus University and Amsterdam University Medical Center.

Further information about the PhD-study can be found at the homepage of the University.

Applications must be submitted electronically using the link "Apply now". Attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.Incomplete applications and applications received after the deadline will neither be considered nor evaluated

 

Closing date January 15th, 2027 

We expect to conduct interviews within two months of the application closing date.Successful candidates will be asked to send an application to the PhD Secretariat, Faculty of Health Sciences, to be enrolled as PhD students. 

The PhD programme will be carried out in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order)

 

Salary and Working Conditions at SDU

PhD students employed at SDU are employed as PhD fellows according to the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations in public employment (AC) agreement.Salary and any salary supplement are paid according to your seniority level and as negotiated with your union representative. The base salary (excluding 18.07% pension contribution) is DKK 374,912.98   per year.

The Faculty of Health Sciences at the University of Southern Denmark is one of Denmark’s leading faculties of health sciences. With nine departments, internationally top‑class research, and a broad range of health‑related study programmes, we contribute to developing the knowledge, treatments, and healthcare system of the future.

As an employee at the faculty, you become part of an ambitious and interdisciplinary environment characterised by high academic standards, strong collaborations, and excellent opportunities for professional development. The faculty has activities in Odense, Esbjerg, and Copenhagen. In Esbjerg and Copenhagen, strong academic communities provide the framework for research and education, while our modern faculty building in Odense brings research, education, and administration together under one roof and is directly connected to Odense University Hospital.The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

Together with a colleague, you will be responsible for operating one of MELITEK's extrusion lines, where polymer compounds for medical-device applications are manufactured.The length of the training period depends on your progress. When you and MELITEK assess that you are ready, you will complete an internal qualification. After passing, you will become a Machine Operator and may help train new colleagues.YOUR MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES:? Operate and monitor an extrusion production line together with a colleague? Clean production equipment and prepare it for the next production run? Carry out changeovers between production batches? Perform ongoing checks of products and equipment? Package finished goods? Complete batch, production and quality records in accordance with MELITEK's ISO 13485:2016 quality management system? Use production equipment, auxiliary equipment and the warehouse management system (WMS) after trainingYOUR QUALIFICATIONS:? Experience from a manufacturing or production company? Practical interest in technology and mechanics? Experience using IT systems? Experience working with a quality management system (QMS)? Ability to read and write Danish - the role includes batch documentation in Danish? A valid Category B forklift certificate is preferred but not requiredYOUR PERSONAL PROFILE:? You are quality-conscious and take pride in your work? You are reliable, committed and maintain good order and structure? You work well both in a team and independently? You approach different tasks with a positive and flexible mindset? You are physically fit for production workWORKING HOURS AND CONDITIONS:The production teams work three 12-hour shifts per week on either day shift from 06:00 to 18:00 or night shift from 18:00 to 06:00. Production currently runs six days per week.Allowances, pension and other employment conditions follow the Danish Industry Collective Agreement and local agreements. MELITEK also offers health insurance and a food and fruit scheme.Start date: By agreement.MELITEK OFFERS:? Individual training with a clear development path from Production Operator to Machine Operator? A position in a modern production facility manufacturing materials for medical-device applications? Close cooperation with experienced colleagues? Employment conditions governed by the Danish Industry Collective Agreement and local agreements? A workplace that values service, flexibility, learning, continuous improvement and professional pride? A strong team spirit across the whole organization with social events throughout the yearABOUT MELITEK:MELITEK is a privately owned Danish company with administration and production in Nørre Alslev on Falster. The company specialises in the development, production and sale of elastomer and polymer compounds for the medical industry.The modern factory was established as a greenfield site in 2003 and has since been expanded several times in line with MELITEK's growth.Learn more at www.melitek.comHOW TO APPLY:Send your application and CV to job@melitek.com.Please write "Machine Operator" in the subject line. Applications are reviewed continuously, and interviews are held on an ongoing basis. MELITEK is willing to wait for the right candidates.CONTACT:Kim Berggren Smidt, Production ManagerTelephone: +45 54 46 44 20LIVING AND WORKING IN DENMARK:Information about living and working in Denmark and the Danish application process is available at workindenmark.dk.

jobs.title: Kundeservicemedarbejder til international virksomhed i Sofia, Bulgarien
jobs.description:
Drømmer du om nye oplevelser, internationale kolleger og en hverdag i en spændende europæisk storby? Så har du nu muligheden for at kombinere et fast job med et nyt kapitel i Sofia!

Sofia byder på det bedste fra flere verdener: et levende byliv med hyggelige caféer, gode restauranter, kultur og et internationalt miljø. Samtidig får du en overkommelig leveomkostning, smuk natur lige uden for byen og gode muligheder for at udforske resten af Europa.

Vi varetager rekrutteringen til stillingen, og ansættelsen sker direkte hos vores kunde i Bulgarien.

 

Om jobbet

Vi søger dansktalende kundeservicemedarbejdere til en international virksomhed i Sofia.

Du bliver en del af et multikulturelt team, hvor du hjælper dansktalende kunder over telefonen med spørgsmål om mobilabonnementer og forskellige services.

Stillingen er uden salg, og tidligere erfaring med kundeservice er ikke et krav. Du får grundig oplæring, så du er godt klædt på til jobbet.

 

Hvad kan du se frem til?

  • Fast fuldtidsstilling med arbejdstid mandag–fredag kl. 10.00–19.00

  • Attraktiv lønpakke set i forhold til det lokale lønniveau samt mulighed for bonus.

  • Relocation package med midlertidig bolig og økonomisk støtte til flytningen

  • Sundhedsforsikring og andre personalegoder

  • Et internationalt arbejdsmiljø med kolleger fra forskellige lande

  • Muligheder for både personlig og faglig udvikling

  • Fri i weekenderne til at opleve Sofia og resten af Bulgarien

 

Hvem er du?

  • Du taler dansk på et højt professionelt niveau og kan kommunikere på engelsk

  • Er serviceminded og trives med at tale med mennesker

  • Har lyst til at bo og arbejde i udlandet

  • Er nysgerrig, fleksibel og klar til nye oplevelser

Uanset om du er i starten af din karriere, ønsker et miljøskifte eller drømmer om at prøve noget helt nyt, kan dette være muligheden for dig.

 

Arbejdssted: Sofia, Bulgarien (arbejde fra kontoret)

Opstart: 30. november 2026

 

Interesseret i stillingen?

Ser du muligheder i at kombinere et fast job i en international virksomhed med en hverdag i Sofia, vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig. 

Send os din ansøgning, eller kontakt os, hvis du ønsker at høre mere om stillingen og mulighederne for at flytte til Bulgarien.

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig!
